```jsx
                <div className="text-center py-10 px-6 rounded-2xl border-2 border-dashed border-border-theme bg-surface-muted/20">
                  <div className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-3 rounded-2xl bg-surface-muted flex items-center justify-center text-text-secondary">
                    <PhotoIcon className="w-6 h-6" />
                  </div>
                  <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground mb-1">
                    No portfolio projects added yet
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-text-secondary max-w-sm mx-auto mb-5 leading-relaxed">
                    Add your best reels, videos, dedicated reviews, or posts so brands can evaluate your content quality.
                  </p>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleOpenAddProject}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-neutral-950 text-white hover:bg-neutral-800 dark:bg-neutral-100 dark:text-neutral-950 dark:hover:bg-neutral-200 font-sans font-semibold text-xs sm:text-sm shadow-xs transition-all cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <PlusIcon className="w-4 h-4" />
                    <span>Add Your First Project</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* =========================================================
              PAGE 3: IDENTITY VERIFICATION
          ========================================================= */}
          {currentStep === 3 && (
            <div className="space-y-6">
              <div>
                <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-serif font-medium tracking-tight text-foreground mb-2">
                  Identity & Demographics
                </h1>
                <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-text-secondary leading-relaxed">
                  Provide your demographic background and language proficiencies. This information helps match you with brand campaigns looking for specific creator perspectives.
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* 1. Date of Birth */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <label
                  htmlFor="dob"
                  className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-foreground font-sans block"
                >
                  Date of Birth *
                </label>
                <div className="relative flex items-center">
                  <span className="absolute left-3.5 text-text-secondary pointer-events-none">
                    <CalendarIcon className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </span>
                  <input
                    id="dob"
                    name="dob"
                    type="date"
                    disabled={isSubmitting}
                    max={new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0]}
                    value={formData.dob}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, dob: e.target.value }));
                      setValidationError(null);
                    }}
                    className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-3 rounded-xl bg-background border border-border-theme text-foreground text-sm font-sans focus:outline-none focus:border-secondary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-secondary transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-60"
                  />
                </div>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-text-secondary">
                  Your birth date is kept private and used for demographic and campaign eligibility verification.
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* 2. Gender Identity */}
              <div className="space-y-2.5">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <label className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-foreground font-sans block">
                    Gender Identity *
                  </label>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-text-secondary">
                    {formData.gender
                      ? GENDER_OPTIONS.find((g) => g.id === formData.gender)?.label
                      : "Required"}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2.5">
                  {GENDER_OPTIONS.map((g) => {
                    const isSelected = formData.gender === g.id;
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={g.id}
                        type="button"
                        disabled={isSubmitting}
                        onClick={() => {
                          setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, gender: g.id }));
                          setValidationError(null);
                        }}
                        className={`text-left p-3 rounded-xl border transition-all cursor-pointer flex flex-col justify-between ${
                          isSelected
                            ? "bg-secondary/10 border-secondary ring-1 ring-secondary/40 text-foreground"
                            : "bg-surface-muted/40 border-border-theme hover:bg-surface-muted hover:border-secondary/50 text-foreground"
                        } ${isSubmitting ? "opacity-60 cursor-not-allowed" : ""}`}
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1 w-full">
                          <span className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold truncate text-foreground">
                            {g.label}
                          </span>
                          {isSelected && (
                            <span className="w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-secondary text-white flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                              <CheckIcon className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-[11px] text-text-secondary mt-1 block">
                          {g.desc}
                        </span>
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* 3. Languages Spoken / Content Languages */}
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <label className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-foreground font-sans block">
                    Languages (Spoken & Content) *
                  </label>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-text-secondary">
                    {formData.languages.length} selected
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* Selected Language Chips */}
                {formData.languages.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    {formData.languages.map((lang) => (
                      <span
                        key={lang}
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-secondary/10 border border-secondary/30 text-secondary text-xs font-medium"
                      >
                        <span>{lang}</span>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          disabled={isSubmitting}
                          onClick={() => handleRemoveLanguage(lang)}
                          className="hover:opacity-75 cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          <XMarkIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </span>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Language Input Form */}
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    disabled={isSubmitting}
                    value={languageInput}
                    onChange={(e) => setLanguageInput(e.target.value)}
                    onKeyDown={(e) => {
                      if (e.key === "Enter") {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        handleAddLanguage(e);
                      }
                    }}
                    placeholder="Type a language (e.g. English, Hindi, Spanish) and press Enter"
                    className="flex-1 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-background border border-border-theme text-foreground placeholder:text-text-secondary/50 text-xs sm:text-sm font-sans focus:outline-none focus:border-secondary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-secondary transition-all disabled:opacity-60"
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleAddLanguage}
                    disabled={isSubmitting || !languageInput.trim()}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-surface-muted hover:bg-background border border-border-theme text-foreground text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                  >
                    <PlusIcon className="w-4 h-4" />
                    <span>Add</span>
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* Suggested Language Chips */}
                <div>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-text-secondary block mb-1.5">
                    Popular suggestions:
                  </span>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                    {POPULAR_LANGUAGES.map((lang) => {
                      const isAdded = formData.languages.includes(lang);
                      return (
                        <button
                          key={lang}
                          type="button"
                          disabled={isSubmitting || isAdded}
                          onClick={() => {
                            if (!isAdded) {
                              if (formData.languages.length >= 10) {
                                setValidationError("You can add up to 10 languages.");
                                return;
                              }
                              setFormData((prev) => ({
                                ...prev,
                                languages: [...prev.languages, lang],
                              }));
                              setValidationError(null);
                            }
                          }}
                          className={`text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border transition-all ${
                            isAdded
                              ? "bg-secondary/10 border-secondary/30 text-secondary cursor-default opacity-60"
                              : "bg-surface-muted/40 border-border-theme text-text-secondary hover:text-foreground hover:bg-surface-muted cursor-pointer"
                          }`}
                        >
                          + {lang}
                        </button>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* 4. Ethnicity (Optional) */}
              <div className="space-y-2 pt-2 border-t border-border-theme">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <label
                    htmlFor="ethnicity"
                    className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-foreground font-sans block"
                  >
                    Ethnicity / Cultural Background (Optional)
                  </label>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-text-secondary">Optional</span>
                </div>

                <select
                  id="ethnicity"
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                  value={
                    ETHNICITY_OPTIONS.includes(formData.ethnicity)
                      ? formData.ethnicity
                      : formData.ethnicity
                      ? "Other"
                      : ""
                  }
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    const val = e.target.value;
                    if (val === "Other") {
                      setFormData((prev) => ({
                        ...prev,
                        ethnicity: prev.ethnicity && !ETHNICITY_OPTIONS.includes(prev.ethnicity) ? prev.ethnicity : "Other",
                      }));
                    } else {
                      setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, ethnicity: val }));
                    }
                    setValidationError(null);
                  }}
                  className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl bg-background border border-border-theme text-foreground text-sm font-sans focus:outline-none focus:border-secondary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-secondary transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-60"
                >
                  <option value="">Select ethnicity (optional) / Prefer not to disclose</option>
                  {ETHNICITY_OPTIONS.map((eth) => (
                    <option key={eth} value={eth}>
                      {eth}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                  <option value="Other">Other / Self-described</option>
                </select>

                {/* If Other or custom */}
                {(formData.ethnicity === "Other" ||
                  (formData.ethnicity && !ETHNICITY_OPTIONS.includes(formData.ethnicity))) && (
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    maxLength={100}
                    disabled={isSubmitting}
                    value={formData.ethnicity === "Other" ? "" : formData.ethnicity}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setFormData((prev) => ({
                        ...prev,
                        ethnicity: e.target.value || "Other",
                      }))
                    }
                    placeholder="Please specify your ethnicity (optional)"
                    className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-background border border-border-theme text-foreground placeholder:text-text-secondary/50 text-xs sm:text-sm font-sans focus:outline-none focus:border-secondary transition-all mt-2"
                  />
                )}

                <p className="text-[11px] text-text-secondary">
                  Brands frequently seek diverse creator voices for inclusive storytelling. This field is completely optional.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* =========================================================
              PAGE 4: SERVICES & PACKAGES
          ========================================================= */}
          {currentStep === 4 && (
            <div className="space-y-6">
              <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
                <div>
                  <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-serif font-medium tracking-tight text-foreground mb-1">
                    Services & Packages
                  </h1>
                  <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-text-secondary leading-relaxed">
                    Set up your standard packages, deliverables, and rates. Brands can hire you directly using these offerings. Add at least 1 service to complete onboarding.
                  </p>
                </div>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleOpenAddService}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-neutral-950 text-white hover:bg-neutral-800 dark:bg-neutral-100 dark:text-neutral-950 dark:hover:bg-neutral-200 font-sans font-semibold text-xs sm:text-sm shadow-xs transition-all cursor-pointer self-start sm:self-auto shrink-0"
                >
                  <PlusIcon className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Add Service</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Services Counter */}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-text-secondary pt-2">
                <span>Services Created ({services?.length || 0})</span>
                <span className="text-secondary font-medium">
                  {services?.some((s) => s.isActive !== false)
                    ? "✓ Active service requirement met"
                    : "* At least 1 active service required"}
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Services List / Cards */}
              {Array.isArray(services) && services.length > 0 ? (
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 max-h-[520px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                  {services.map((service) => {
                    const serviceId = service._id || service.id;
                    const validDeliverables = getDeliverablesList(service.deliverables);
                    const formattedPrice = formatPrice(service);

                    return (
                      <div
                        key={serviceId}
                        className="bg-surface border border-border-theme hover:border-secondary/50 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-xs hover:shadow-md transition-all flex flex-col justify-between group"
                      >
                        <div>
                          {/* Service Cover with Platform & Status Badges */}
                          <ServiceCardCover coverImage={service.coverImage} title={service.title}>
                            {/* Platform Badge */}
                            <div className="absolute top-2.5 left-2.5 z-10 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-white/95 dark:bg-neutral-900/90 backdrop-blur-xs shadow-xs border border-white/20">
                              {getPlatformIcon(service.platform)}
                              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold tracking-wider uppercase text-foreground">
                                {getPlatformLabel(service.platform)}
                              </span>
                            </div>

                            {/* Active Status Badge */}
                            <div className="absolute top-2.5 right-2.5 z-10 inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-white/95 dark:bg-neutral-900/90 backdrop-blur-xs shadow-xs border border-white/20 text-[10px] font-semibold">
                              <span
                                className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${
                                  service.isActive !== false ? "bg-emerald-500" : "bg-amber-500"
                                }`}
                              />
                              <span
                                className={
                                  service.isActive !== false
                                    ? "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"
                                    : "text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400"
                                }
                              >
                                {service.isActive !== false ? "Active" : "Inactive"}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          </ServiceCardCover>

                          {/* Card Content */}
                          <div className="p-4 space-y-2.5">
                            <div>
                              <h3 className="font-sans font-bold text-sm sm:text-base text-foreground line-clamp-1 tracking-tight">
                                {service.title}
                              </h3>
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap mt-0.5">
                                <p className="text-[11px] text-text-secondary line-clamp-1">
                                  {service.category || "Social Media Campaign"}
                                </p>
                                {service.contentType && (
                                  <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-secondary/10 text-secondary text-[10px] font-semibold">
                                    {service.quantity && service.quantity > 1
                                      ? `${service.quantity}x `
                                      : ""}
                                    {getContentTypeLabel(
                                      service.platform,
                                      service.contentType
                                    )}
                                  </span>
                                )}
                              </div>
                              {service.description && (
                                <p className="text-xs text-text-secondary leading-relaxed line-clamp-2 mt-1">
                                  {service.description}
                                </p>
                              )}
                            </div>

                            {/* Pricing Row */}
                            <div className="p-2.5 sm:p-3 rounded-xl bg-surface-muted/50 border border-border-theme flex items-center justify-between">
                              <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-text-secondary">
                                {service.pricingType === "custom"
                                  ? "Custom Quote"
                                  : service.pricingType === "starting_from"
                                  ? "Starting from"
                                  : "Fixed Rate"}
                              </span>
                              <span className="font-bold text-sm sm:text-base text-secondary">
                                {formattedPrice}
                              </span>
                            </div>

                            {/* Meta info (deliveryTime, revisions) */}
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-[11px] text-text-secondary">

                                <span>{service.deliveryTime || 7} Days Delivery</span>

                              <span>
                                {service.revisions != null ? service.revisions : 1} Revisions
                              </span>
                            </div>

                            {/* Deliverables tags */}
                            {validDeliverables.length > 0 && (
                              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 pt-1">
                                {validDeliverables.slice(0, 3).map((deliv, idx) => (
                                  <span
                                    key={idx}

                                  </span>
                                ))}
                                {validDeliverables.length > 3 && (
                                  <span className="text-[10px] text-text-secondary self-center">
                                    +{validDeliverables.length - 3} more
                                  </span>
                                )}
                              </div>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* Card Actions */}
                        <div className="px-4 py-3 border-t border-border-theme bg-surface-muted/30 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleOpenEditService(service)}
                            className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-border-theme bg-surface hover:bg-surface-muted text-text-secondary hover:text-foreground text-xs font-medium inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                          >
                            <PencilIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            <span>Edit</span>
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            disabled={Boolean(deletingServiceId)}
                            onClick={() => handleDeleteService(serviceId)}
                            className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-border-theme bg-surface hover:bg-red-500/10 hover:border-red-500/30 text-text-secondary hover:text-red-500 text-xs font-medium inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
```

```jsx
export default function CreatorHeader({ setMobileOpen = () => {} }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const dispatch = useDispatch();

  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [dropdownOpen, setDropdownOpen] = useState(false);
  const [notificationOpen, setNotificationOpen] = useState(false);
  const [loadedAvatarUrl, setLoadedAvatarUrl] = useState(null);
  const [failedAvatarUrl, setFailedAvatarUrl] = useState(null);
  const dropdownRef = useRef(null);

  const { profile, loading: profileLoading, error: profileError } = useSelector(
    (state) => state.profile || {}
  );
  const { user: authUser } = useSelector(
    (state) => state.auth || {}
  );

  const isNotFoundError =
    Boolean(profileError) &&
    (typeof profileError === "string"
      ? profileError.toLowerCase().includes("not found")
      : typeof profileError === "object" && typeof profileError?.message === "string"
        ? profileError.message.toLowerCase().includes("not found")
        : false);

  const hasAttemptedFetch = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!profile && !profileLoading && !isNotFoundError && !hasAttemptedFetch.current) {
      hasAttemptedFetch.current = true;
      dispatch(getCreatorProfile());
    }
  }, [dispatch, profile, profileLoading, isNotFoundError]);

  const userObj = profile?.user || (authUser?.user ? authUser.user : authUser);

  const displayName =
    userObj?.name ||
    authUser?.name ||
    profile?.name ||
    "Creator";

  const displayRole =
    profile?.category ||
    profile?.designation ||
    profile?.role ||
    "Content Creator";

  const displayEmail =
    userObj?.email ||
    authUser?.email ||
    profile?.email ||
    "";

  // Initial letter (matching the reference pink circular avatar styling)
  const initial = (displayName && displayName.trim().length > 0)
    ? displayName.trim()[0].toUpperCase()
    : "C";

  // Avatar URL and safe image states
  const rawAvatarUrl = profile?.profileImage || profile?.avatar || userObj?.avatar || "";
  const cleanAvatarUrl = typeof rawAvatarUrl === "string" ? rawAvatarUrl.trim() : "";
  const isLoaded = Boolean(cleanAvatarUrl) && loadedAvatarUrl === cleanAvatarUrl;
  const isFailed = Boolean(cleanAvatarUrl) && failedAvatarUrl === cleanAvatarUrl;
  const hasValidAvatar = Boolean(cleanAvatarUrl) && !isFailed;

  const handleLogout = async () => {
    setDropdownOpen(false);
    setNotificationOpen(false);
    hasAttemptedFetch.current = false;
    dispatch(clearProfile());
    await dispatch(logout());
    router.push("/login");
  };

  const handleDropdownToggle = () => {
    if (!profile && !profileLoading && profileError && !isNotFoundError) {
      hasAttemptedFetch.current = true;
      dispatch(getCreatorProfile());
    }
    setDropdownOpen((prev) => {
      if (!prev) setNotificationOpen(false);
      return !prev;
    });
  };

  const handleSearch = () => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return;
    const q = searchQuery.trim();
    router.push(`/creator/campaigns/discover?search=${encodeURIComponent(q)}`);
  };

  // Close dropdown on click outside or Escape key
  useEffect(() => {
    function handleClickOutside(event) {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
        setDropdownOpen(false);
      }
    }

    function handleKeyDown(event) {
      if (event.key === "Escape") {
        setDropdownOpen(false);
        setNotificationOpen(false);
      }
    }

    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <header className="sticky top-0 z-40 w-full bg-surface/95 backdrop-blur-md text-foreground border-b border-border-theme shadow-xs px-2.5 sm:px-6 py-2 sm:py-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5 sm:gap-6 transition-colors duration-200 min-w-0 max-w-full">
      {/* Left Section: Mobile Menu Toggle + Modern White Searchbar */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-3 flex-1 min-w-0 max-w-xl">
        {/* Mobile Hamburger Button */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setMobileOpen(true)}
          className="lg:hidden p-1.5 sm:p-2 rounded-xl text-text-secondary hover:text-foreground hover:bg-surface-muted transition-colors shrink-0"
```

```jsx
import React from "react";

function formatCurrency(amount, currency = "INR") {
  const numericAmount =
    amount === undefined || amount === null || isNaN(Number(amount))
      ? 0
      : Number(amount);
  const currCode =
    (currency && typeof currency === "string" ? currency.trim().toUpperCase() : "INR") || "INR";

  try {
    if (currCode === "INR") {
      return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN", {
        style: "currency",
        currency: "INR",
        maximumFractionDigits: 0,
      }).format(numericAmount);
    }
    return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", {
      style: "currency",
      currency: currCode,
      maximumFractionDigits: 0,
    }).format(numericAmount);
  } catch {
    return `${currCode} ${numericAmount.toLocaleString()}`;
  }
}

function CurrencyIcon({ className = "w-5 h-5" }) {

    <svg className={className} fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.75}>

    </svg>
  );
}

function ClockIcon({ className = "w-5 h-5" }) {

  const unpaidWorkspacesCount = metrics?.pendingPayments?.unpaidWorkspacesCount ?? 0;

  const submitted = metrics?.activeCollaborations?.breakdown?.submitted ?? 0;
  const revisionRequested = metrics?.activeCollaborations?.breakdown?.revisionRequested ?? 0;
  const completedWorkspaces = metrics?.completedCollaborations?.total ?? 0;

  // 4. Reviews & Rating

          : unpaidWorkspacesCount > 0

          : "Awaiting milestone clearance",
      secondaryNote: "Disbursed upon completion",
```

```jsx
function getStageStyle(stageId, count) {
  // Neutral styling for inactive stages (count === 0)
  if (count === 0) {
    return {
      border: "border-border-theme",
      bg: "bg-surface",
      pill: "text-text-secondary/70 bg-surface-muted border-border-theme/60",
      pillText: "0 active",
      countColor: "text-foreground/75",
    };
  }

  // Completed work: subtle green accent
  if (stageId === "completed") {
    return {
      border: "border-emerald-500/30 dark:border-emerald-500/40",
      bg: "bg-emerald-500/[0.04] dark:bg-emerald-500/[0.08]",
      pill: "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 bg-transparent border border-emerald-500/30",
      pillText: `${count} done`,
      countColor: "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400",
    };
  }

  // Active in-flight stages
  switch (stageId) {
    case "proposals":
      return {
        border: "border-amber-500/30 dark:border-amber-500/40",
        bg: "bg-amber-500/[0.04] dark:bg-amber-500/[0.08]",
        pill: "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 bg-transparent border border-amber-500/30",
        pillText: `${count} active`,
        countColor: "text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400",
      };
    case "in_progress":
      return {
        border: "border-blue-500/30 dark:border-blue-500/40",
        bg: "bg-blue-500/[0.04] dark:bg-blue-500/[0.08]",
        pill: "text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 bg-transparent border border-blue-500/30",
        pillText: `${count} active`,
        countColor: "text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400",
      };
    case "under_review":
      return {
        border: "border-purple-500/30 dark:border-purple-500/40",
        bg: "bg-purple-500/[0.04] dark:bg-purple-500/[0.08]",
        pill: "text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300 bg-transparent border border-purple-500/30",
        pillText: `${count} active`,
        countColor: "text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400",
      };
    case "revisions":
      return {
        border: "border-rose-500/30 dark:border-rose-500/40",
        bg: "bg-rose-500/[0.04] dark:bg-rose-500/[0.08]",
        pill: "text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 bg-transparent border border-rose-500/30",
        pillText: `${count} active`,
        countColor: "text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400",
      };
    default:
      return {
        border: "border-border-theme",
        bg: "bg-surface",
        pill: "text-text-secondary bg-transparent border border-border-theme",
        pillText: `${count} active`,
        countColor: "text-foreground",
      };
  }
}
```

```jsx
import React, { useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";

function WorkspaceCoverBadge({ title, coverImage, fallbackText }) {
  const [hasError, setHasError] = useState(false);
  const rawSrc = typeof coverImage === "string" ? coverImage.trim() : null;
  const showImage = Boolean(rawSrc && !hasError);

  if (showImage) {
    return (
      <div className="w-9 h-9 sm:w-10 sm:h-10 rounded-xl bg-surface-muted/60 border border-border-theme overflow-hidden shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center mt-0.5 sm:mt-0">
        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
        <img
          key={rawSrc}
          src={rawSrc}
          alt={title || "Campaign"}
          className="w-full h-full object-cover"
          onError={() => setHasError(true)}
        />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div
      className="w-9 h-9 sm:w-10 sm:h-10 rounded-xl bg-surface-muted text-foreground/90 border border-border-theme/70 flex items-center justify-center font-sans font-semibold text-xs sm:text-sm shrink-0 group-hover:border-pink-200/80 dark:group-hover:border-pink-500/30 transition-colors mt-0.5 sm:mt-0 select-none"
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      {fallbackText}
    </div>
  );
}

function formatCurrency(amount, currency = "INR") {
  const numericAmount =
    amount === undefined || amount === null || isNaN(Number(amount))
      ? 0
      : Number(amount);
  const currCode =
    (currency && typeof currency === "string" ? currency.trim().toUpperCase() : "INR") || "INR";

  try {
    if (currCode === "INR") {
      return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN", {
        style: "currency",
        currency: "INR",
        maximumFractionDigits: 0,
      }).format(numericAmount);
    }
    return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", {
      style: "currency",
      currency: currCode,
      maximumFractionDigits: 0,
    }).format(numericAmount);
  } catch {
    return `${currCode} ${numericAmount.toLocaleString()}`;
  }
}

function formatDate(dateStr) {
  if (!dateStr) return "N/A";
  const date = new Date(dateStr);
  if (isNaN(date.getTime())) return dateStr;
  return date.toLocaleDateString("en-IN", {
    day: "numeric",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
  });
}

function getWorkspaceStatusBadge(status) {
  const normalized = typeof status === "string" ? status.trim().toLowerCase() : "";
  switch (normalized) {
    case "submitted":
      return {
        label: "Under Review",
        color: "bg-transparent text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 border border-purple-500/30",
      };
    case "in_progress":
      return {
        label: "In Production",
        color: "bg-transparent text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/30",
      };
    case "revision_requested":
      return {
        label: "Revision Requested",
        color: "bg-transparent text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/30",
      };
    case "completed":
      return {
        label: "Completed",
        color: "bg-transparent text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30",
      };
    default:
      return {
        label: status
          ? String(status).replace(/_/g, " ").toLowerCase().replace(/\b\w/g, (l) => l.toUpperCase())
          : "Active",
        color: "bg-transparent text-text-secondary border border-border-theme",
      };
  }
}

function ArrowRightIcon({ className = "w-4 h-4" }) {
  return (

      <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M13.5 4.5L21 12m0 0l-7.5 7.5M21 12H3" />

}

    </svg>
  );
}

      />
```

```jsx
}

function StarRating({ rating = 0, max = 5 }) {
  const rawRating = Number(rating);
  const rounded = Number.isFinite(rawRating)
    ? Math.min(max, Math.max(0, Math.round(rawRating)))
    : 0;
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5" aria-label={`Rating: ${rating} out of ${max}`}>
      {Array.from({ length: max }, (_, i) => (
        <StarIcon key={i} filled={i < rounded} className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
function SidebarContent({

}) {

    <div
      className={`flex flex-col h-full bg-surface text-foreground border-r border-border-theme select-none transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out ${

          <>
            <Link

            >
              <span>CREATORLINK</span>
              <span className="text-secondary text-lg leading-none">✦</span>
            </Link>

            {/* Desktop 3-bar toggle button */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={toggleCollapsed}
              className="hidden lg:flex p-1.5 rounded-xl text-text-secondary hover:text-foreground hover:bg-surface-muted transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Collapse sidebar"
              aria-label="Collapse sidebar"
            >
              <HamburgerIcon className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>

            {/* Mobile Close Button */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setMobileOpen(false)}
              className="lg:hidden p-1.5 rounded-lg text-text-secondary hover:text-foreground hover:bg-surface-muted transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              aria-label="Close sidebar"
            >
              <CloseIcon />
            </button>
          </>
        ) : (
          /* Collapsed Header: Centered 3-bar Toggle Button */
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={toggleCollapsed}
            className="hidden lg:flex p-2 rounded-xl text-text-secondary hover:text-foreground hover:bg-surface-muted transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            title="Expand sidebar"
            aria-label="Expand sidebar"
          >
            <HamburgerIcon className="w-5 h-5 text-secondary" />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Navigation Items List */}
      <nav
        className={`flex-1 space-y-0.5 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar transition-all ${
          collapsed ? "px-2 py-2.5" : "px-3 py-3"
        }`}
      >
        {navItems.map((item) => {
          const Icon = item.icon;
          const isActive =
            pathname === item.href ||
            (item.href !== "/creator/dashboard" &&
              item.href !== "/creator/campaigns" &&
              pathname?.startsWith(item.href + "/")) ||
            (item.href === "/creator/campaigns" &&
              pathname?.startsWith("/creator/campaigns/") &&
              !pathname?.startsWith("/creator/campaigns/discover"));

          const badgeCount = (item.categories || []).reduce(
            (sum, cat) => sum + (countsByCategory[cat] || 0),
            0
          );

          return (
            <Link
              key={item.name}
              href={item.href}
              onClick={() => setMobileOpen(false)}
              title={item.name}
              className={`flex items-center rounded-xl font-sans font-medium text-[13px] sm:text-[13.5px] transition-all duration-150 group ${
                collapsed
                  ? `justify-center w-full h-10 ${
                      isActive
                        ? "bg-[#fff0f4] dark:bg-[#2a171f] text-[#ff2d6c] font-semibold"
                        : "text-text-secondary hover:text-foreground hover:bg-surface-muted"
                    }`
                  : `gap-2.5 px-3 py-2 ${
                      isActive
                        ? "bg-[#fff0f4] dark:bg-[#2a171f] text-[#ff2d6c] font-semibold"
                        : "text-text-secondary hover:text-foreground hover:bg-surface-muted"
                    }`
              }`}
            >
              <div className="relative flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                <Icon
                  className={`w-[18px] h-[18px] shrink-0 transition-colors ${
                    isActive ? "text-[#ff2d6c]" : "text-text-secondary group-hover:text-foreground"
                  }`}
                />
                {collapsed && badgeCount > 0 && (
                  <span className="absolute -top-1.5 -right-2 px-1 min-w-[14px] h-[14px] flex items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[9px] font-bold bg-[#ff2d6c] text-white leading-none shrink-0 shadow-2xs">
                    {badgeCount > 99 ? "99+" : badgeCount}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
              {!collapsed && (
                <>
                  <span className="truncate flex-1">{item.name}</span>
                  {badgeCount > 0 && (
                    <span className="ml-auto px-1.5 py-0.5 min-w-[18px] h-[18px] flex items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-[#ff2d6c] text-white leading-none shrink-0 shadow-2xs">
                      {badgeCount > 99 ? "99+" : badgeCount}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </>
              )}
            </Link>
          );
        })}
      </nav>

      {/* Footer / Logout */}
      <div className={`border-t border-border-theme transition-all ${collapsed ? "p-2" : "p-3"}`}>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleLogout}
          title="Log Out"
          className={`w-full flex items-center rounded-xl font-sans font-medium text-[13px] sm:text-[13.5px] text-text-secondary hover:text-red-500 hover:bg-red-500/10 transition-all duration-150 cursor-pointer text-left ${
            collapsed ? "justify-center h-10" : "gap-2.5 px-3 py-2"
          }`}
        >
          <LogoutIcon className="w-[18px] h-[18px] shrink-0" />
          {!collapsed && <span>Log Out</span>}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// Persistent memory across client-side page navigation to prevent flicker
let isGlobalCreatorSidebarCollapsed = false;
if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
  try {
    isGlobalCreatorSidebarCollapsed = localStorage.getItem("creator_sidebar_collapsed") === "true";
  } catch {
    // ignore
  }
}

export default function CreatorSidebar({ mobileOpen = false, setMobileOpen = () => {} }) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const router = useRouter();
  const dispatch = useDispatch();

  const countsByCategory = useSelector(
    (state) => state.creatorNotifications?.countsByCategory || {}
  );

  // Fetch unread notification counts on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    dispatch(fetchCreatorUnreadNotificationCount());
  }, [dispatch]);

  // Automatically mark module notifications as read when the module is actively viewed
  const lastMarkedRef = useRef("");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pathname) return;

    const matchingItem = navItems.find((item) => {
      if (!item.categories || item.categories.length === 0) return false;
      if (pathname === item.href) return true;
      if (item.href === "/creator/campaigns") {
        return (
          pathname.startsWith("/creator/campaigns/") &&
          !pathname.startsWith("/creator/campaigns/discover")
        );
      }
      return pathname.startsWith(item.href + "/");
    });

    if (!matchingItem) return;

    const unreadCountForModule = matchingItem.categories.reduce(
      (sum, cat) => sum + (countsByCategory[cat] || 0),
      0
    );

    const markKey = `${pathname}:${matchingItem.categories.join(",")}`;

    if (unreadCountForModule > 0 && lastMarkedRef.current !== markKey) {
      lastMarkedRef.current = markKey;
      dispatch(markCreatorCategoryNotificationsRead(matchingItem.categories.join(",")));
    }
  }, [pathname, countsByCategory, dispatch]);

  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState(() => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      try {
        const saved = localStorage.getItem("creator_sidebar_collapsed");
        if (saved !== null) {
          return saved === "true";
        }
      } catch {
        // ignore
      }
    }
    return isGlobalCreatorSidebarCollapsed;
  });

  // Ensure body class is synchronized
  useEffect(() => {
    if (collapsed) {
      document.body.classList.add("creator-sidebar-collapsed");
    } else {
      document.body.classList.remove("creator-sidebar-collapsed");
    }
  }, [collapsed]);

  const toggleCollapsed = () => {
    setCollapsed((prev) => {
      const next = !prev;
      isGlobalCreatorSidebarCollapsed = next;
      try {
        localStorage.setItem("creator_sidebar_collapsed", String(next));
      } catch {
        // ignore
      }
      if (next) {
        document.body.classList.add("creator-sidebar-collapsed");
      } else {
        document.body.classList.remove("creator-sidebar-collapsed");
      }
      return next;
    });
  };

  const handleLogout = async () => {
    setMobileOpen(false);
    dispatch(clearProfile());
    await dispatch(logout());
    router.push("/login");
  };

  return (
    <>
      {/* Desktop Fixed Sidebar with Expand / Collapse Transition */}
      <aside
        className={`hidden lg:flex fixed top-0 left-0 bottom-0 z-30 shrink-0 transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out ${
          collapsed ? "w-[72px]" : "w-64"
        }`}
      >
        <SidebarContent
          pathname={pathname}
          setMobileOpen={setMobileOpen}
          handleLogout={handleLogout}
          collapsed={collapsed}
          toggleCollapsed={toggleCollapsed}
          countsByCategory={countsByCategory}
        />
      </aside>

      {/* Mobile Drawer Backdrop & Menu */}
      {mobileOpen && (
        <div className="lg:hidden fixed inset-0 z-50 flex">
          <div
            className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-xs transition-opacity"
            onClick={() => setMobileOpen(false)}
          />
          <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col w-64 max-w-full h-full shadow-2xl">
            <SidebarContent
              pathname={pathname}
              setMobileOpen={setMobileOpen}
              handleLogout={handleLogout}
              collapsed={false}
              toggleCollapsed={() => {}}
              countsByCategory={countsByCategory}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```

```jsx
import React, { useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";

function getInitials(title, fallback = "DL") {
  if (!title || typeof title !== "string") return fallback;
  const clean = title.trim();
  if (!clean) return fallback;
  const words = clean.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (words.length >= 2) {
    const first = words[0][0] || "";
    const second = words[1][0] || "";
    return (first + second).toUpperCase();
  }
  return clean.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
}

function DeliverableCoverBadge({ title, coverImage, fallbackText = "DL" }) {
  const [hasError, setHasError] = useState(false);
  const initials = getInitials(title, fallbackText);
  const rawSrc = typeof coverImage === "string" ? coverImage.trim() : null;
  const showImage = Boolean(rawSrc && !hasError);

  if (showImage) {
    return (
      <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-surface-muted/60 border border-border-theme overflow-hidden shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center mt-0.5 sm:mt-0">
        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
        <img
          key={rawSrc}
          src={rawSrc}
          alt={title || "Deliverable"}
          className="w-full h-full object-cover"
          onError={() => setHasError(true)}
        />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div
      className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-secondary/5 border border-secondary/10 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 font-semibold text-xs text-secondary tracking-wider font-sans select-none mt-0.5 sm:mt-0"
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      {initials}
    </div>
  );
}

function formatCurrency(amount, currency = "INR") {
  const numericAmount =
    amount === undefined || amount === null || isNaN(Number(amount))
      ? 0
      : Number(amount);
  const currCode =
    (currency && typeof currency === "string" ? currency.trim().toUpperCase() : "INR") || "INR";

  try {
    if (currCode === "INR") {
      return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN", {
        style: "currency",
        currency: "INR",
        maximumFractionDigits: 0,
      }).format(numericAmount);
    }
    return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", {
      style: "currency",
      currency: currCode,
      maximumFractionDigits: 0,
    }).format(numericAmount);
  } catch {
    return `${currCode} ${numericAmount.toLocaleString()}`;
  }
}

function formatDate(dateStr) {
  if (!dateStr) return "N/A";
  const date = new Date(dateStr);
  if (isNaN(date.getTime())) return dateStr;
  return date.toLocaleDateString("en-IN", {
    day: "numeric",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
  });
}

function getTimeRemaining(deadlineStr) {
  if (!deadlineStr) return null;
  const target = new Date(deadlineStr);
  const now = new Date();
  const diffMs = target.getTime() - now.getTime();
  if (isNaN(diffMs)) return null;

  const diffDays = Math.ceil(diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
  if (diffDays < 0) return { label: "Past due", type: "past_due" };
  if (diffDays === 0) return { label: "Due today", type: "today" };
  if (diffDays === 1) return { label: "Due tomorrow", type: "tomorrow" };
  if (diffDays <= 3) return { label: `${diffDays} days left`, type: "urgent" };
  return { label: `${diffDays} days left`, type: "normal" };
}

function getSourceBadge(sourceType) {
  const normalized = typeof sourceType === "string" ? sourceType.trim().toLowerCase() : "";
  switch (normalized) {
    case "workspace":
      return {
        label: "Workspace Deliverable",
        color: "bg-transparent text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/30",
      };
    case "brand_proposal":
      return {
        label: "Brand Proposal",
        color: "bg-transparent text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30",
      };
    case "campaign_application":
      return {
        label: "Campaign Pitch",
        color: "bg-transparent text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 border border-purple-500/30",
      };
    default:
      return {
        label: sourceType
          ? String(sourceType).replace(/_/g, " ").toLowerCase().replace(/\b\w/g, (l) => l.toUpperCase())
          : "Deadline",
        color: "bg-transparent text-text-secondary border border-border-theme",
      };
  }
}

function getSourceLink(sourceType, id) {
  const normalized = typeof sourceType === "string" ? sourceType.trim().toLowerCase() : "";
  switch (normalized) {
    case "workspace":
      return id ? `/creator/workspace/${id}` : "/creator/workspace";
    case "brand_proposal":
    case "campaign_application":
    default:
      return "/creator/campaigns";
  }
}

function ArrowRightIcon({ className = "w-4 h-4" }) {

        </Link>
      </div>

      {/* Content */}
      {safeDeadlines.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="py-6 px-4 rounded-2xl bg-surface-muted/30 border border-border-theme/60 text-center flex flex-col items-center justify-center space-y-2">
          <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 flex items-center justify-center">

          </h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-text-secondary font-sans max-w-xs leading-relaxed">
            No pending deliverables or campaign milestones require your attention today.
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (

          {safeDeadlines.map((item, idx) => {
            const normalizedSourceType =
              typeof item.sourceType === "string"
                ? item.sourceType.trim().toLowerCase()
                : "";
            const sourceBadge = getSourceBadge(item.sourceType);
            const remaining = getTimeRemaining(item.deadline);
            const itemId = item.id || item._id;
            const targetLink = getSourceLink(item.sourceType, itemId);
            const price = item.agreedPrice ?? item.budget ?? item.compensation;
            const title =
              (typeof item.title === "string" && item.title.trim()) ||
              (typeof item.campaign?.title === "string" && item.campaign.title.trim()) ||
              (normalizedSourceType === "workspace"
                ? "Workspace Deliverable"
                : normalizedSourceType === "brand_proposal"
                ? "Brand Proposal"
                : normalizedSourceType === "campaign_application"
                ? "Campaign Pitch"
                : "Milestone Deliverable");
            const brandName = item.brandName || item.brand?.name || "";
            const platform = item.platform || item.campaign?.platform || "";
            const deliverablesCount = item.deliverablesCount;

            // Subtle urgency pill
            let urgencyClass = "bg-transparent text-text-secondary border border-border-theme/60";
            if (remaining?.type === "today" || remaining?.type === "past_due") {
              urgencyClass = "bg-transparent text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/30 font-semibold";
            } else if (remaining?.type === "tomorrow" || remaining?.type === "urgent") {
              urgencyClass = "bg-transparent text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30 font-semibold";
            }

            const coverImage =
              item.coverImage ||
              item.campaign?.coverImage ||
              item.thumbnail ||
              item.image ||
              "";

            return (
              <Link
                key={itemId || idx}
                href={targetLink}
                className="group flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 p-3.5 sm:p-4 rounded-2xl border border-border-theme/60 bg-surface hover:bg-surface-muted/40 hover:border-pink-200/80 dark:hover:border-pink-500/30 transition-all duration-200"
              >
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <DeliverableCoverBadge
                    title={title}
                    coverImage={coverImage}
                    fallbackText="DL"
                  />
                  <div className="space-y-1.5 min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                      <span
                        className={`inline-block px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-sans font-semibold border ${sourceBadge.color}`}
                      >
                        {sourceBadge.label}
                      </span>
                      {remaining && (
                        <span
                          className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-sans border ${urgencyClass}`}
                        >
                          {remaining.type === "today" && (
                            <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-rose-500 animate-pulse" />

                          <span>{remaining.label}</span>
                        </span>
                      )}
                      {typeof deliverablesCount === "number" && deliverablesCount > 0 && (
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-text-secondary font-sans font-medium">
                          · {deliverablesCount} deliverable{deliverablesCount === 1 ? "" : "s"}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <h4
                      className="font-sans font-semibold text-xs sm:text-sm text-foreground truncate group-hover:text-secondary transition-colors"
                      title={title}
                    >
                      {title}
                    </h4>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-text-secondary font-sans truncate">
                      {brandName ? <span className="font-medium text-foreground">{brandName}</span> : ""}
                      {brandName && (platform || item.deadline) ? " · " : ""}
                      {platform ? `${platform} · ` : ""}
                      Due {formatDate(item.deadline)}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex sm:flex-col items-center sm:items-end justify-between sm:justify-center shrink-0 pt-2 sm:pt-0 border-t sm:border-t-0 border-border-theme/40 pl-0 sm:pl-3">
                  {price !== undefined && price !== null && (
                    <span className="font-sans font-semibold text-xs sm:text-sm text-foreground tabular-nums">
                      {formatCurrency(price, item.currency || "INR")}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-sans font-medium text-secondary inline-flex items-center gap-1 group-hover:translate-x-0.5 transition-transform mt-0.5">
                    <span>View milestone</span>
                    <ArrowRightIcon className="w-3 h-3" />
                  </span>
                </div>
              </Link>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
  } = useSelector((state) => state.creatorDashboard || {});

  const { profile } = useSelector((state) => state.profile || {});
  const { user } = useSelector((state) => state.auth || {});

  // Dashboard API fetch handler with retry support
  const handleFetchDashboard = useCallback(() => {
    dispatch(getCreatorDashboardOverview({ recentLimit: 5, deadlinesLimit: 5 }));
  }, [dispatch]);

  // Initial dashboard fetch on mount (independent of profile)
  useEffect(() => {
    handleFetchDashboard();
  }, [handleFetchDashboard]);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-background text-foreground flex flex-col font-sans">
      {/* Sidebar Component */}
      <CreatorSidebar mobileOpen={mobileOpen} setMobileOpen={setMobileOpen} />

      {/* Main Content Area Offset by Desktop Sidebar */}
      <div className="flex-1 lg:ml-64 flex flex-col min-w-0 transition-all duration-300">
        {/* Header Bar Component */}
        <CreatorHeader setMobileOpen={setMobileOpen} />

        {/* Dashboard Main Container */}
        <main className="flex-1 p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-8 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto">
          {/* Case 1: First request failed and no cached data exists */}
          {error && !dashboard ? (
            <div className="bg-surface border border-red-500/20 rounded-2xl p-8 sm:p-12 text-center space-y-4 shadow-xs">
              <div className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto rounded-full bg-red-500/10 text-red-500 flex items-center justify-center">
                <svg className="w-6 h-6" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.75}>
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M12 9v3.75m9-.75a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0zm-9 3.75h.008v.008H12v-.008z" />
                </svg>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <h3 className="font-serif font-medium text-lg sm:text-xl text-foreground">
                  Unable to load creator dashboard data
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-text-secondary max-w-md mx-auto">
                  {typeof error === "string"
                    ? error
                    : "Something went wrong while fetching your dashboard overview. Please check your connection and try again."}
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="pt-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleFetchDashboard}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-red-500 hover:bg-red-600 text-white text-xs font-semibold cursor-pointer transition-colors shadow-xs"
                >
                  <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2}>
                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M16.023 9.348h4.992v-.001M2.985 19.644v-4.992m0 0h4.992m-4.993 0l3.181 3.183a8.25 8.25 0 0013.803-3.7M4.031 9.865a8.25 8.25 0 0113.803-3.7l3.181 3.182m0-4.991v4.99" />
                  </svg>
                  <span>Retry</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : !dashboard ? (
            /* Case 2: Initial render or request in flight before data arrives */
            <CreatorDashboardSkeleton />
          ) : (
            /* Case 3: Dashboard data successfully loaded */
            <>
              {/* If subsequent update failed but we already have dashboard data, show top warning */}
              {error && (
                <div className="bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/20 text-red-500 rounded-2xl p-4 text-xs font-sans flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
                  <span>{typeof error === "string" ? error : "Unable to refresh dashboard data."}</span>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleFetchDashboard}
                    className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-red-500 hover:bg-red-600 text-white text-xs font-semibold cursor-pointer shrink-0 transition-colors"
                  >
                    Retry
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* 1. Welcome Banner */}
              <CreatorWelcomeBanner
                user={user}
                creator={creator}
                profile={profile}
                metrics={metrics}
              />

              {/* 2. 4 Core Aggregate Metric Cards */}
              <CreatorMetricsGrid metrics={metrics} />

              {/* 3. Production Workflow Pipeline & Quick Action Tools */}
              <CreatorQuickActions metrics={metrics} />

              {/* 4. 2-Column Section: Deadlines & Active Collaborations */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6 items-start">
                <CreatorUpcomingDeadlines deadlines={upcomingDeadlines} />
                <CreatorRecentCollaborations collaborations={recentWorkspaces} />
              </div>

              {/* 5. Recent Reviews & Testimonials */}
              <CreatorRecentReviews reviews={reviews} />
            </>
          )}
        </main>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function CreatorDashboardPage() {
  return (
    <ReduxProvider>
      <CreatorDashboardContent />
    </ReduxProvider>
  );
}
```

```javascript
import {
    createAsyncThunk,
    createSlice
} from "@reduxjs/toolkit";

import {
    getCreatorDashboardOverview as getCreatorDashboardOverviewApi
} from "./dashboard_api";

import {
    login,
    logout,
    clearAuth
} from "../../auth/auth_slice";

// Handles fetching creator dashboard overview metrics, upcoming deadlines, recent collaborations, and reviews.
const getCreatorDashboardOverview = createAsyncThunk(
    "creatorDashboard/getCreatorDashboardOverview",
    async (params = {}, { rejectWithValue }) => {
        try {
            return await getCreatorDashboardOverviewApi(params);
        } catch (error) {
            return rejectWithValue(
                error.response?.data?.message ||
                "Unable to fetch creator dashboard overview"
            );
        }
    }
);

const initialState = {
    dashboard: null,
    metrics: null,
    upcomingDeadlines: [],
    recentWorkspaces: [],
    reviews: null,
    creator: null,
    loading: false,
    error: null
};

const creatorDashboardSlice = createSlice({
    name: "creatorDashboard",
    initialState,
    reducers: {
        clearCreatorDashboard: () => initialState,
        clearCreatorDashboardError: (state) => {
            state.error = null;
        }
    },
    extraReducers: (builder) => {
        builder
            // Fetch Creator Dashboard Overview
            .addCase(getCreatorDashboardOverview.pending, (state) => {
                state.loading = true;
                state.error = null;
            })
            .addCase(getCreatorDashboardOverview.fulfilled, (state, action) => {
                state.loading = false;
                const dashboardData = action.payload?.data || null;
                state.dashboard = dashboardData;
                state.metrics = dashboardData?.metrics || null;
                state.upcomingDeadlines = dashboardData?.upcomingDeadlines || [];
                state.recentWorkspaces = dashboardData?.recentWorkspaces || [];
                state.reviews = dashboardData?.reviews || null;
                state.creator = dashboardData?.creator || null;
                state.error = null;
            })
            .addCase(getCreatorDashboardOverview.rejected, (state, action) => {
                state.loading = false;
                state.error = action.payload || "Unable to fetch creator dashboard overview";
            })

            // Reset state on authentication changes
            .addCase(login.fulfilled, () => initialState)
            .addCase(logout.fulfilled, () => initialState)
            .addCase(clearAuth, () => initialState);
    }
});

export const {
    clearCreatorDashboard,
    clearCreatorDashboardError
} = creatorDashboardSlice.actions;

export {
    getCreatorDashboardOverview,
    getCreatorDashboardOverview as fetchCreatorDashboardOverview
};

export default creatorDashboardSlice.reducer;
```
