import mongoose from "mongoose";

import Booking from "./booking.model.js";
import Campaign from "../brand/campaigns/campaign.model.js";
import CreatorService from "../creator/services/services.model.js";
import Auth from "../auth/auth.model.js";
import CreatorProfile from "../creator/profile/profile.model.js";
import {
    createWorkspaceForAcceptedBooking,
    cleanupWorkspaceForBooking
} from "../workspace/workspace.service.js";
import { createNotificationSafe } from "../notifications/notification.service.js";
import createApiError from "../../utils/ApiError.js";

import {
    getPagination,
    getPaginationData
} from "../../utils/pagination.js";


// Creates a new booking / campaign application from a creator.
const createBookingService = async (creatorId, bookingData) => {

    const {
        campaignId,
        serviceId,
        proposedPrice,
        message
    } = bookingData;


    // 1. Verify selected creator service exists, is active, and belongs to creator.
    const service = await CreatorService.findOne({
        _id: serviceId,
        creator: creatorId,
        isActive: true
    });

    if (!service) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Selected service does not exist, is inactive, or does not belong to you"
        );
    }


    // 2. Verify campaign exists and is published.
    const campaign = await Campaign.findOne({
        _id: campaignId,
        status: "published"
    });

    if (!campaign) {
        throw createApiError(
            404,
            "Campaign not found or is not open for applications"
        );
    }


    const brandId = campaign.brand;


    // 3. Prevent self-booking/applying.
    if (creatorId.toString() === brandId.toString()) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "You cannot apply to your own campaign"
        );
    }


    // 4. Prevent duplicate booking for the same creator + campaign.
    const existingBooking = await Booking.findOne({
        campaign: campaignId,
        creator: creatorId
    });

    if (existingBooking) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "You have already applied to this campaign"
        );
    }


    // 5. Determine agreed price (proposedPrice if provided, otherwise service default price).
    const finalPrice = (proposedPrice !== undefined && proposedPrice !== null && proposedPrice !== "")
        ? Number(proposedPrice)
        : service.price;


    // 6. Create booking copying deliverables and deadline from campaign.
    const booking = await Booking.create({
        brand: brandId,
        creator: creatorId,
        campaign: campaignId,
        service: serviceId,
        agreedPrice: finalPrice,
        currency: service.currency || "INR",
        message: message ? message.trim() : "",
        deliverables: campaign.deliverables,
        deadline: campaign.deadline,
        status: "pending"
    });

    await createNotificationSafe({
        recipient: brandId,
        sender: creatorId,
        type: "booking:application_received",
        title: "New Campaign Application",
        message: `A creator submitted an application for "${campaign.title || 'Campaign'}".`,
        entityType: "booking",
        entityId: booking._id,
        destination: "/brand/bookings",
        metadata: {
            campaignId: campaign._id,
            campaignTitle: campaign.title,
            serviceId: serviceId,
            agreedPrice: finalPrice
        },
        idempotencyKey: `booking:application_received:${booking._id}`
    });

    return booking;
};


// Gets bookings belonging to the authenticated creator.
const getCreatorBookingsService = async (creatorId, query = {}) => {

    const {
        page = 1,
        limit = 10,
        status
    } = query;


    const {
        page: currentPage,
        limit: itemsPerPage,
        skip
    } = getPagination(page, limit);


    const filter = {
        creator: creatorId
    };


    if (status && status.trim()) {
        filter.status = status.trim();
    }


    const [bookings, totalItems] = await Promise.all([
        Booking.find(filter)
            .populate("brand", "name email")
            .populate("campaign", "title category budget deadline platform coverImage")
            .populate("service", "title price deliveryTime")
            .sort({ createdAt: -1 })
            .skip(skip)
            .limit(itemsPerPage),

        Booking.countDocuments(filter)
    ]);


    return {
        bookings,
        pagination: getPaginationData(
            currentPage,
            itemsPerPage,
            totalItems
        )
    };
};


// Gets a single booking belonging to the authenticated creator.
const getCreatorBookingByIdService = async (creatorId, bookingId) => {

    if (!mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(bookingId)) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Invalid booking ID"
        );
    }


    const booking = await Booking.findOne({
        _id: bookingId,
        creator: creatorId
    })
        .populate("brand", "name email")
        .populate("campaign")
        .populate("service");


    if (!booking) {
        throw createApiError(
            404,
            "Booking not found"
        );
    }


    return booking;
};


// Cancels a pending booking by creator.
const cancelCreatorBookingService = async (creatorId, bookingId) => {

    if (!mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(bookingId)) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Invalid booking ID"
        );
    }


    const booking = await Booking.findOne({
        _id: bookingId,
        creator: creatorId
    });


    if (!booking) {
        throw createApiError(
            404,
            "Booking not found"
        );
    }


    if (booking.status !== "pending") {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            `Cannot cancel booking with status '${booking.status}'. Only pending bookings can be cancelled.`
        );
    }


    const updatedBooking = await Booking.findOneAndUpdate(
        {
            _id: booking._id,
            creator: creatorId,
            status: "pending"
        },
        {
            $set: { status: "cancelled" }
        },
        { new: true }
    );

    if (!updatedBooking) {
        const recheck = await Booking.findOne({
            _id: bookingId,
            creator: creatorId
        });

        if (!recheck) {
            throw createApiError(
                404,
                "Booking not found"
            );
        }

        if (recheck.status === "cancelled") {
            return recheck;
        }

        throw createApiError(
            400,
            `Cannot cancel booking with status '${recheck.status}'. Only pending bookings can be cancelled.`
        );
    }

    await cleanupWorkspaceForBooking(updatedBooking._id);

    await createNotificationSafe({
        recipient: updatedBooking.brand,
        sender: creatorId,
        type: "booking:cancelled",
        title: "Application Withdrawn",
        message: "A creator has withdrawn their application for your campaign.",
        entityType: "booking",
        entityId: updatedBooking._id,
        destination: "/brand/bookings",
        metadata: {
            bookingId: updatedBooking._id,
            campaignId: updatedBooking.campaign
        },
        idempotencyKey: `booking:cancelled:${updatedBooking._id}`
    });

    return updatedBooking;
};


// Helper to enrich bookings with CreatorProfile (profileImage)
const isMongooseObjectId = (val) =>
    Boolean(val && (val instanceof mongoose.Types.ObjectId || val?._bsontype === "ObjectID"));

const attachBookingCreatorProfiles = async (bookings) => {
    if (!bookings) return bookings;
    const isSingle = !Array.isArray(bookings);
    const bookingList = isSingle ? [bookings] : bookings;
    if (bookingList.length === 0) return bookings;

    const creatorIds = new Set();
    const extractCreatorId = (creator) => {
        if (!creator) return null;
        if (typeof creator === "object" && !isMongooseObjectId(creator)) {
            const rawId = creator._id || creator.id;
            if (rawId) {
                return rawId.toString ? rawId.toString() : String(rawId);
            }
            return null;
        }
        if (isMongooseObjectId(creator)) {
            return creator.toString();
        }
        if (typeof creator === "string") {
            const trimmed = creator.trim();
            if (mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(trimmed)) {
                return trimmed;
            }
        }
        if (mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(creator)) {
            return creator.toString ? creator.toString() : String(creator);
        }
        return null;
    };

    bookingList.forEach((b) => {
        const bObj = b?.toObject ? b.toObject() : b;
        if (!bObj) return;
        const cId = extractCreatorId(bObj.creator);
        if (cId) creatorIds.add(cId);
    });

    const isDbConnected = mongoose.connection?.readyState === 1;
    const creatorProfiles = creatorIds.size > 0 && isDbConnected
        ? await CreatorProfile.find({
            user: { $in: Array.from(creatorIds).map((id) => new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(id)) }
        })
            .select("user profileImage")
            .lean()
        : [];

    const creatorMap = new Map();
    creatorProfiles.forEach((cp) => {
        if (cp?.user) creatorMap.set(cp.user.toString(), cp.profileImage || "");
    });

    const enriched = bookingList.map((b) => {
        const bObj = b?.toObject ? b.toObject() : { ...b };
        const cId = extractCreatorId(bObj.creator);
        const profileImage = cId ? (creatorMap.get(cId) || "") : "";

        if (bObj.creator) {
            const isPopulated = typeof bObj.creator === "object" && !isMongooseObjectId(bObj.creator);
            if (isPopulated) {
                const creatorBase = bObj.creator.toObject ? bObj.creator.toObject() : { ...bObj.creator };
                bObj.creator = {
                    ...creatorBase,
                    profileImage: profileImage || creatorBase.profileImage || "",
                    avatar: profileImage || creatorBase.avatar || "",
                    image: profileImage || creatorBase.image || ""
                };
            } else if (cId) {
                bObj.creator = {
                    _id: bObj.creator,
                    profileImage,
                    avatar: profileImage,
                    image: profileImage
                };
            }
        }

        return bObj;
    });

    return isSingle ? enriched[0] : enriched;
};


// Gets bookings received by the authenticated brand for their campaigns.
const getBrandBookingsService = async (brandId, query = {}) => {

    const {
        page = 1,
        limit = 10,
        status,
        campaignId
    } = query;


    const {
        page: currentPage,
        limit: itemsPerPage,
        skip
    } = getPagination(page, limit);


    const filter = {
        brand: brandId
    };


    if (status && status.trim()) {
        filter.status = status.trim();
    }


    if (campaignId && mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(campaignId)) {
        filter.campaign = campaignId;
    }


    const [bookings, totalItems] = await Promise.all([
        Booking.find(filter)
            .populate("creator", "name email")
            .populate("campaign", "title category budget deadline platform coverImage")
            .populate("service", "title price deliveryTime")
            .sort({ createdAt: -1 })
            .skip(skip)
            .limit(itemsPerPage),

        Booking.countDocuments(filter)
    ]);

    const enrichedBookings = await attachBookingCreatorProfiles(bookings);

    return {
        bookings: enrichedBookings,
        pagination: getPaginationData(
            currentPage,
            itemsPerPage,
            totalItems
        )
    };
};


// Gets a single booking belonging to the authenticated brand.
const getBrandBookingByIdService = async (brandId, bookingId) => {

    if (!mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(bookingId)) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Invalid booking ID"
        );
    }


    const booking = await Booking.findOne({
        _id: bookingId,
        brand: brandId
    })
        .populate("creator", "name email")
        .populate("campaign")
        .populate("service");


    if (!booking) {
        throw createApiError(
            404,
            "Booking not found"
        );
    }

    const bObj = booking.toObject ? booking.toObject() : { ...booking };
    return await attachBookingCreatorProfiles(bObj);
};


// Updates a booking status (accept/reject) by brand.
const updateBrandBookingStatusService = async (brandId, bookingId, newStatus) => {

    if (!mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(bookingId)) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Invalid booking ID"
        );
    }


    const booking = await Booking.findOne({
        _id: bookingId,
        brand: brandId
    });


    if (!booking) {
        throw createApiError(
            404,
            "Booking not found"
        );
    }


    if (booking.status !== "pending") {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            `Cannot update status for booking that is already '${booking.status}'`
        );
    }


    if (booking.initiatedBy === "brand") {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "You cannot accept or reject a booking proposal initiated by your own brand"
        );
    }


    if (newStatus === "accepted") {
        try {
            await createWorkspaceForAcceptedBooking(booking);
        } catch (wsErr) {
            if (wsErr?.statusCode) {
                throw wsErr;
            }
            throw createApiError(
                500,
                `Failed to initialize collaboration workspace: ${wsErr?.message || "Workspace creation failed"}`
            );
        }
    }

    const updatedBooking = await Booking.findOneAndUpdate(
        {
            _id: booking._id,
            brand: brandId,
            status: "pending"
        },
        {
            $set: { status: newStatus }
        },
        { new: true }
    );

    if (!updatedBooking) {
        const recheck = await Booking.findOne({
            _id: bookingId,
            brand: brandId
        });

        if (!recheck) {
            throw createApiError(
                404,
                "Booking not found"
            );
        }

        if (recheck.status === newStatus) {
            return recheck;
        }

        if (newStatus === "accepted" && recheck.status !== "accepted") {
            await cleanupWorkspaceForBooking(booking._id);
        }

        throw createApiError(
            400,
            `Cannot update status for booking that is already '${recheck.status}'`
        );
    }

    if (newStatus === "rejected") {
        await cleanupWorkspaceForBooking(updatedBooking._id);
    }

    await createNotificationSafe({
        recipient: updatedBooking.creator,
        sender: brandId,
        type: newStatus === "accepted" ? "booking:accepted" : "booking:rejected",
        title: newStatus === "accepted" ? "Application Accepted!" : "Application Declined",
        message: newStatus === "accepted"
            ? "Your campaign application was accepted! Collaboration workspace has been created."
            : "Your campaign application was declined.",
        entityType: "booking",
        entityId: updatedBooking._id,
        destination: newStatus === "accepted" ? "/creator/workspace" : "/creator/campaigns",
        metadata: {
            bookingId: updatedBooking._id,
            campaignId: updatedBooking.campaign,
            status: newStatus
        },
        idempotencyKey: `booking:${newStatus}:${updatedBooking._id}`
    });

    return updatedBooking;
};


// Creates a new booking / direct hire proposal from a brand.
const createBrandBookingService = async (brandId, bookingData) => {

    const {
        creatorId,
        serviceId,
        campaignId,
        proposedPrice,
        message
    } = bookingData;


    // 1. Verify campaign exists, belongs to this brand, and is published or in_progress.
    const campaign = await Campaign.findOne({
        _id: campaignId,
        brand: brandId
    });

    if (!campaign) {
        throw createApiError(
            404,
            "Campaign not found or does not belong to your brand"
        );
    }

    if (campaign.status !== "published" && campaign.status !== "in_progress") {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Campaign is not open for bookings"
        );
    }


    // 2. Prevent self-booking.
    if (brandId.toString() === creatorId.toString()) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "You cannot book yourself"
        );
    }


    // 3. Verify creator account exists with role 'creator'.
    const creatorUser = await Auth.findOne({
        _id: creatorId,
        role: "creator"
    });

    if (!creatorUser) {
        throw createApiError(
            404,
            "Creator account not found or is not a creator"
        );
    }


    // 4. Verify creator has an active, public profile.
    const creatorProfile = await CreatorProfile.findOne({
        user: creatorId,
        isPublic: true
    });

    if (!creatorProfile) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Creator profile not found or is private"
        );
    }


    // 5. Verify selected creator service exists, is active, and belongs to creator.
    const service = await CreatorService.findOne({
        _id: serviceId,
        creator: creatorId,
        isActive: true
    });

    if (!service) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Selected service does not exist, is inactive, or does not belong to this creator"
        );
    }


    // 6. Prevent duplicate booking/application for the same campaign + creator.
    const existingBooking = await Booking.findOne({
        campaign: campaignId,
        creator: creatorId
    });

    if (existingBooking) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            `A booking or application already exists for this creator on this campaign (current status: ${existingBooking.status})`
        );
    }


    // 7. Determine agreed price (proposedPrice if provided, otherwise service default price).
    const finalPrice = (proposedPrice !== undefined && proposedPrice !== null && proposedPrice !== "")
        ? Number(proposedPrice)
        : service.price;


    // 8. Create booking copying deliverables and deadline from campaign.
    const booking = await Booking.create({
        brand: brandId,
        creator: creatorId,
        campaign: campaignId,
        service: serviceId,
        agreedPrice: finalPrice,
        currency: service.currency || "INR",
        message: message ? message.trim() : "",
        deliverables: campaign.deliverables,
        deadline: campaign.deadline,
        status: "pending",
        initiatedBy: "brand"
    });

    await createNotificationSafe({
        recipient: creatorId,
        sender: brandId,
        type: "booking:proposal_received",
        title: "New Collaboration Proposal",
        message: `You received a new collaboration proposal for "${campaign.title || 'Campaign'}".`,
        entityType: "booking",
        entityId: booking._id,
        destination: "/creator/campaigns",
        metadata: {
            campaignId: campaign._id,
            campaignTitle: campaign.title,
            serviceId: serviceId,
            agreedPrice: finalPrice
        },
        idempotencyKey: `booking:proposal_received:${booking._id}`
    });

    return booking;
};


// Updates a brand-initiated booking status (accept/reject) by creator.

import mongoose from "mongoose";
import createApiError from "../../utils/ApiError.js";

// Allowed booking status values.
const allowedStatuses = [
    "pending",
    "accepted",
    "rejected",
    "cancelled",
    "in_progress",
    "completed"
];

// Valid statuses that a brand can set when updating a booking application.
const brandAllowedStatuses = [
    "accepted",
    "rejected"
];


// Validates booking creation data from creator.
const validateCreateBooking = (req, res, next) => {

    const {
        campaignId,
        serviceId,
        proposedPrice,
        message
    } = req.body;


    // Check required fields.
    if (!campaignId || !serviceId) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "campaignId and serviceId are required"
        );
    }


    // Validate campaignId.
    if (!mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(campaignId)) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Invalid campaignId"
        );
    }


    // Validate serviceId.
    if (!mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(serviceId)) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Invalid serviceId"
        );
    }


    // Validate proposedPrice if provided.
    if (proposedPrice !== undefined && proposedPrice !== null && proposedPrice !== "") {
        const parsedPrice = Number(proposedPrice);
        if (Number.isNaN(parsedPrice) || parsedPrice < 0) {
            throw createApiError(
                400,
                "Proposed price must be a non-negative number"
            );
        }
    }


    // Validate message if provided.
    if (
        message !== undefined &&
        (typeof message !== "string" || message.length > 2000)
    ) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Message must be a string with maximum 2000 characters"
        );
    }


    next();
};


// Validates brand status update data.
const validateUpdateBookingStatus = (req, res, next) => {

    const { status } = req.body;


    if (!status) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Status is required"
        );
    }


    if (!brandAllowedStatuses.includes(status)) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            `Invalid status update. Allowed values: ${brandAllowedStatuses.join(", ")}`
        );
    }


    next();
};


// Validates query parameters for listing bookings.
const validateGetBookingsQuery = (req, res, next) => {

    const {
        page,
        limit,
        status,
        campaignId
    } = req.query;


    if (page !== undefined) {
        const parsedPage = Number(page);
        if (!Number.isInteger(parsedPage) || parsedPage < 1) {
            throw createApiError(
                400,
                "Page must be a valid positive integer"
            );
        }
    }


    if (limit !== undefined) {
        const parsedLimit = Number(limit);
        if (!Number.isInteger(parsedLimit) || parsedLimit < 1) {
            throw createApiError(
                400,
                "Limit must be a valid positive integer"
            );
        }
    }


    if (
        campaignId !== undefined &&
        campaignId.trim() !== "" &&
        !mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(campaignId.trim())
    ) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Invalid campaignId"
        );
    }


    if (
        status !== undefined &&
        status.trim() !== "" &&
        !allowedStatuses.includes(status.trim())
    ) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Invalid status filter"
        );
    }


    next();
};


// Validates booking / proposal creation data from brand.
const validateCreateBrandBooking = (req, res, next) => {

      <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M14.74 9l-.346 9m-4.788 0L9.26 9m9.968-3.21c.342.052.682.107 1.022.166m-1.022-.165L18.16 19.673a2.25 2.25 0 01-2.244 2.077H8.084a2.25 2.25 0 01-2.244-2.077L4.772 5.79m14.456 0a48.108 48.108 0 00-3.478-.397m-12 .562c.34-.059.68-.114 1.022-.165m0 0a48.11 48.11 0 013.478-.397m7.5 0v-.916c0-1.18-.91-2.164-2.09-2.201a51.964 51.964 0 00-3.32 0c-1.18.037-2.09 1.022-2.09 2.201v.916m7.5 0a48.667 48.667 0 00-7.5 0" />
    </svg>
  );
}

function CheckCircleIcon({ className = "w-4 h-4" }) {
  return (
    <svg className={className} fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.75}>
      <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M9 12.75L11.25 15 15 9.75M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z" />
    </svg>
  );
}

// Allowed MIME types and size thresholds
const ALLOWED_IMAGE_TYPES = [
  "image/jpeg",
  "image/jpg",
  "image/png",
  "image/webp",
];

const ALLOWED_VIDEO_TYPES = [
  "video/mp4",
  "video/webm",
  "video/quicktime",
  "video/mov",
  "video/x-m4v",
];

const isValidHttpUrl = (str) => {
  if (!str || typeof str !== "string") return false;
  const trimmed = str.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return false;
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(trimmed);
    return parsed.protocol === "http:" || parsed.protocol === "https:";
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
};

const detectMediaType = (url) => {
  if (!url || typeof url !== "string") return null;
  const trimmed = url.trim();
  const cleanUrl = trimmed.split("?")[0].split("#")[0].toLowerCase();
  if (
    cleanUrl.includes("/video/upload/") ||
    cleanUrl.endsWith(".mp4") ||
    cleanUrl.endsWith(".webm") ||
    cleanUrl.endsWith(".mov") ||
    cleanUrl.endsWith(".m4v")
  ) {
    return "video";
  }
  if (
    cleanUrl.includes("/image/upload/") ||
    cleanUrl.endsWith(".webp") ||
    cleanUrl.endsWith(".jpg") ||
    cleanUrl.endsWith(".jpeg") ||
    cleanUrl.endsWith(".png") ||
    cleanUrl.endsWith(".gif") ||
    cleanUrl.endsWith(".avif")
  ) {
    return "image";
  }
  return null;
};

const MAX_IMAGE_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024; // 5 MB
const MAX_VIDEO_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024; // 50 MB
const DELIVERABLES_FOLDER = "creatorlink/deliverables";

function formatFileSize(bytes) {
  if (!bytes || bytes <= 0) return "0 B";
  if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) {
    return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
  }
  return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`;
}

export default function CreatorSubmitWorkModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  workspaceId,
  isResubmission = false,
  targetDeliverable = null,
}) {
  const dispatch = useDispatch();
  const { submitting, error } = useSelector(
    (state) => state.creatorWorkspace
  );

  const fileInputRef = useRef(null);

  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [link, setLink] = useState("");
  const [fileUrl, setFileUrl] = useState("");
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState("");
  const [validationError, setValidationError] = useState(null);

  // File upload and preview state
  const [isUploading, setIsUploading] = useState(false);
  const [uploadError, setUploadError] = useState(null);
  const [selectedFile, setSelectedFile] = useState(null);
  const [previewUrl, setPreviewUrl] = useState(null);
  const [mediaType, setMediaType] = useState(null); // "image" | "video" | null
  const [uploadedMediaUrl, setUploadedMediaUrl] = useState(null);

  const prevIsOpenRef = useRef(false);

  // Clean up object URLs on modal close or unmount
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (previewUrl && previewUrl.startsWith("blob:")) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl);
      }
    };
  }, [previewUrl]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen && !prevIsOpenRef.current) {
      const initialTitle = targetDeliverable?.title || "";
      queueMicrotask(() => {
        setTitle(initialTitle);
      });
    } else if (!isOpen && prevIsOpenRef.current) {
      if (previewUrl && previewUrl.startsWith("blob:")) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl);
      }
      queueMicrotask(() => {
        setTitle("");
        setLink("");
        setFileUrl("");
        setNotes("");
        setValidationError(null);
        setUploadError(null);
        setIsUploading(false);
        setSelectedFile(null);
        setPreviewUrl(null);
        setMediaType(null);
        setUploadedMediaUrl(null);
      });
    }
    prevIsOpenRef.current = isOpen;
  }, [isOpen, targetDeliverable, previewUrl]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleClose = () => {
    if (submitting || isUploading) return;
    if (previewUrl && previewUrl.startsWith("blob:")) {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl);
    }
    setTitle("");
    setLink("");
    setFileUrl("");
    setNotes("");
    setValidationError(null);
    setUploadError(null);
    setIsUploading(false);
    setSelectedFile(null);
    setPreviewUrl(null);
    setMediaType(null);
    setUploadedMediaUrl(null);
    onClose();
  };

  const handleFileSelect = async (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    setUploadError(null);
    setValidationError(null);

    const fileType = file.type?.toLowerCase();
    const isImage = ALLOWED_IMAGE_TYPES.includes(fileType);
    const isVideo = ALLOWED_VIDEO_TYPES.includes(fileType);

    if (!isImage && !isVideo) {
      setUploadError("Only JPEG, PNG, WebP photos and MP4, WebM, MOV videos are allowed.");
      if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = "";
      return;
    }

    if (isImage && file.size > MAX_IMAGE_SIZE) {
      setUploadError("Photo size must not exceed 5 MB.");
      if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = "";
      return;
    }

    if (isVideo && file.size > MAX_VIDEO_SIZE) {
      setUploadError("Video size must not exceed 50 MB.");
      if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = "";
      return;
    }

    // Preserve previous media states in case the replacement upload fails
    const previousPreviewUrl = previewUrl;
    const previousMediaType = mediaType;
    const previousSelectedFile = selectedFile;
    const previousUploadedMediaUrl = uploadedMediaUrl;
    const previousFileUrl = fileUrl;

    // Create temporary local preview (previous blob is kept until upload succeeds)
    const localPreviewUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
    setPreviewUrl(localPreviewUrl);
    setMediaType(isImage ? "image" : "video");
    setSelectedFile(file);
    setIsUploading(true);

    try {
      let uploadRes;
      if (isImage) {
        uploadRes = await uploadSingleImageApi(file, DELIVERABLES_FOLDER);
      } else {
        uploadRes = await uploadSingleVideoApi(file, DELIVERABLES_FOLDER);
      }

      const uploadedUrl =
        uploadRes?.data?.url ||
        uploadRes?.url ||
        uploadRes?.secure_url ||
        uploadRes?.data?.secure_url;

      if (!uploadedUrl) {
        throw new Error("Uploaded media URL was not returned by server.");
      }

      // Clean up previous blob if any, and the local preview blob
      if (previousPreviewUrl && previousPreviewUrl.startsWith("blob:")) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(previousPreviewUrl);
      }
      if (localPreviewUrl && localPreviewUrl.startsWith("blob:")) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(localPreviewUrl);
      }

      setPreviewUrl(uploadedUrl);
      setUploadedMediaUrl(uploadedUrl);
      setFileUrl(uploadedUrl);
      setUploadError(null);
    } catch (err) {
      if (localPreviewUrl && localPreviewUrl.startsWith("blob:")) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(localPreviewUrl);
      }

      // Check if previous fileUrl was linked to the previous uploaded media
      const wasLinkedToUpload = Boolean(
        previousUploadedMediaUrl && previousFileUrl === previousUploadedMediaUrl
      );

      if (wasLinkedToUpload) {
        setPreviewUrl(previousPreviewUrl);
        setMediaType(previousMediaType);
        setSelectedFile(previousSelectedFile);
        setUploadedMediaUrl(previousUploadedMediaUrl);
        setFileUrl(previousFileUrl);
      } else {
        // If fileUrl was changed to a different external URL or not linked to the upload,
        // preserve the valid external fileUrl without restoring a preview that no longer matches the active asset.
        const activeMediaType =
          isValidHttpUrl(previousFileUrl) ? detectMediaType(previousFileUrl) : null;
        setPreviewUrl(activeMediaType ? previousFileUrl.trim() : null);
        setMediaType(activeMediaType);
        setSelectedFile(null);
        setUploadedMediaUrl(null);
        setFileUrl(previousFileUrl);
      }

      setUploadError(
        err?.response?.data?.message ||
        err?.message ||
        "Failed to upload media. Please try again."
      );
    } finally {
      setIsUploading(false);
      if (fileInputRef.current) {
        fileInputRef.current.value = "";
      }
    }
  };

  const handleRemoveMedia = () => {
    if (isUploading) return;
    if (previewUrl && previewUrl.startsWith("blob:")) {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl);
    }
    // Only clear fileUrl if it corresponds to the currently uploaded media or active direct media preview
    if (
      (uploadedMediaUrl && fileUrl === uploadedMediaUrl) ||
      (previewUrl && fileUrl === previewUrl)
    ) {
      setFileUrl("");
    }
    setPreviewUrl(null);
    setMediaType(null);
    setSelectedFile(null);
    setUploadedMediaUrl(null);
    setUploadError(null);
    if (fileInputRef.current) {
      fileInputRef.current.value = "";
    }
  };

  const handleTriggerFileInput = () => {
    if (isUploading) return;
    fileInputRef.current?.click();
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (isUploading) {
      setValidationError("Please wait for your media file to finish uploading before submitting.");
      return;
    }
    setValidationError(null);

    const trimmedTitle = title.trim();
    const trimmedLink = link.trim();
    const trimmedFileUrl = fileUrl.trim();
    const trimmedNotes = notes.trim();

    // Ensure a submission cannot be accepted with notes or title alone if an actual content link or asset is required
    if (!trimmedLink && !trimmedFileUrl) {
      setValidationError("Please provide deliverable content by uploading media, entering an asset URL, or providing a live content link.");
      return;
    }

    // Explicitly validate content link as a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL
    if (trimmedLink && !isValidHttpUrl(trimmedLink)) {
      setValidationError("Please enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS content link (e.g. https://instagram.com/p/...).");
      return;
    }

    // Explicitly validate asset/file URL as a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL
    if (trimmedFileUrl && !isValidHttpUrl(trimmedFileUrl)) {
      setValidationError("Please enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS file URL (e.g. https://...).");
      return;
    }

    const deliverableId = targetDeliverable?._id;

    const action = await dispatch(
      submitCreatorDeliverableWork({
        workspaceId,
        deliverableId,
        submissionData: {
          title: trimmedTitle,
          link: trimmedLink,
          fileUrl: trimmedFileUrl,
          notes: trimmedNotes,
        },
      })
    );

    if (submitCreatorDeliverableWork.fulfilled.match(action)) {
      if (previewUrl && previewUrl.startsWith("blob:")) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl);
      }
      setTitle("");
      setLink("");
      setFileUrl("");
      setNotes("");
      setValidationError(null);
      setUploadError(null);
      setSelectedFile(null);
      setPreviewUrl(null);
      setMediaType(null);
      setUploadedMediaUrl(null);
      dispatch(clearSuccessMessage());
      onClose();
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      {/* Backdrop */}
      <div className="fixed inset-0" onClick={handleClose} />

      {/* Modal Container */}
      <div className="relative z-10 bg-surface border border-border-theme rounded-2xl max-w-lg w-full shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[90vh]">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="p-5 sm:p-6 border-b border-border-theme flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <span className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-black text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-black shadow-2xs">
              <UploadIcon className="w-5 h-5" />
            </span>
            <div>
              <h2 className="font-serif font-semibold text-lg text-foreground tracking-tight">
                {isResubmission ? "Resubmit Deliverable Work" : "Submit Deliverable Work"}
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-text-secondary mt-0.5">
                {targetDeliverable?.title
                  ? `Deliverable: ${targetDeliverable.title}`
                  : "Provide your completed content links or file references for brand review."}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleClose}
            disabled={submitting || isUploading}
            className="p-2 rounded-xl text-text-secondary hover:text-foreground hover:bg-surface-muted transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          >
            <CloseIcon />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Body Form */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-5 sm:p-6 overflow-y-auto space-y-4 flex-1 custom-scrollbar">
          {/* Global Submission Error */}
          {error && (
            <div className="bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/30 text-red-500 p-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium">
              {typeof error === "string" ? error : "Submission failed. Please try again."}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Local Validation Error */}
          {validationError && (
            <div className="bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/30 text-red-500 p-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium">
              {validationError}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Submission Title */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground block">
              Submission Title / Deliverable Name
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              maxLength={200}
              value={title}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setTitle(e.target.value);
                setValidationError(null);
              }}
              placeholder="e.g. Final Reel Link & Post Assets - Version 1"
              disabled={submitting || isUploading}
              className="w-full text-xs px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-surface-muted border border-border-theme text-foreground placeholder:text-text-secondary focus:outline-none focus:border-secondary transition-colors disabled:opacity-60"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Content Link */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground block">
              Live Content / Post Link (URL)
            </label>
            <input
              type="url"
              value={link}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setLink(e.target.value);
                setValidationError(null);
              }}
              placeholder="https://instagram.com/p/... or https://youtube.com/watch?v=..."
              disabled={submitting || isUploading}
              className="w-full text-xs px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-surface-muted border border-border-theme text-foreground placeholder:text-text-secondary focus:outline-none focus:border-secondary transition-colors disabled:opacity-60"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Deliverable Media Upload (Photo or Video) */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground block">
                Deliverable Media (Photo or Video)
              </label>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-text-secondary">
                Photo ≤ 5 MB • Video ≤ 50 MB
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Hidden file input */}
            <input
              ref={fileInputRef}
              type="file"
              accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp,video/mp4,video/webm,video/quicktime"
              onChange={handleFileSelect}
              className="hidden"
              disabled={submitting || isUploading}
            />

            {/* Upload Area or Preview Card */}
            {previewUrl ? (
              <div className="rounded-xl border border-border-theme bg-surface-muted/40 p-3 space-y-2.5">
                {/* Media Preview Player/Viewer */}
                <div className="relative rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-black/80 flex items-center justify-center max-h-52">
                  {mediaType === "video" ? (
                    <video
                      src={previewUrl}
                      controls
                      playsInline
                      className="w-full max-h-52 object-contain"
                    />
                  ) : (
                    /* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */
                    <img
                      src={previewUrl}
                      alt="Deliverable asset preview"
                      className="w-full max-h-52 object-contain"
                    />
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Status Bar & Actions */}
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-0.5">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0 flex-1">
                    {isUploading ? (
                      <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-amber-500 text-[11px] font-medium">
                        <div className="w-3 h-3 border-2 border-amber-500 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin shrink-0" />
                        <span className="truncate">Uploading to Cloudinary...</span>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 text-[11px] font-medium truncate">
                        <CheckCircleIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
                        <span className="truncate">
                          {selectedFile?.name || "Deliverable Media Ready"}
                        </span>
                        {selectedFile?.size && (
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-text-secondary shrink-0">
                            ({formatFileSize(selectedFile.size)})
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={handleTriggerFileInput}
                      disabled={isUploading || submitting}
                      className="text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border border-border-theme bg-surface hover:bg-surface-muted text-foreground font-medium transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                    >
                      Replace
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={handleRemoveMedia}
                      disabled={isUploading || submitting}
                      className="text-[11px] p-1.5 rounded-lg border border-red-500/30 bg-red-500/10 hover:bg-red-500/20 text-red-500 transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                      title="Remove media"
                    >
                      <TrashIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div
                onClick={handleTriggerFileInput}
                className="group border border-dashed border-border-theme hover:border-secondary/60 bg-surface-muted/30 hover:bg-surface-muted/70 rounded-xl p-4 text-center cursor-pointer transition-all space-y-1.5"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-text-secondary group-hover:text-secondary transition-colors">
                  <PhotoIcon className="w-5 h-5" />
                  <VideoIcon className="w-5 h-5" />
                </div>
                <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground group-hover:text-secondary transition-colors">
                  Click to choose Deliverable Photo or Video
                </div>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-text-secondary leading-relaxed">
                  JPEG, PNG, WebP (up to 5 MB) or MP4, WebM, MOV (up to 50 MB)
                </p>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Media Upload Error */}
            {uploadError && (
              <div className="bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/30 text-red-500 p-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium">
                {uploadError}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Asset File URL */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground block">
                Cloud Storage / Asset File URL (Optional)
              </label>
              {uploadedMediaUrl && fileUrl === uploadedMediaUrl && (
                <span className="text-[10px] text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-medium">
                  Linked to uploaded file
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <input
              type="url"
              value={fileUrl}
              onChange={(e) => {
                const newUrl = e.target.value;
                setFileUrl(newUrl);
                setValidationError(null);
                // When manually changing the URL away from the uploaded media,
                // keep the preview consistent with the active asset
                if (uploadedMediaUrl && newUrl.trim() !== uploadedMediaUrl) {
                  if (previewUrl && previewUrl.startsWith("blob:")) {
                    URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl);
                  }
                  const activeType = isValidHttpUrl(newUrl) ? detectMediaType(newUrl) : null;
                  setPreviewUrl(activeType ? newUrl.trim() : null);
                  setMediaType(activeType);
                  setSelectedFile(null);
                  setUploadedMediaUrl(null);
                } else if (!uploadedMediaUrl) {
                  const activeType = isValidHttpUrl(newUrl) ? detectMediaType(newUrl) : null;
                  setPreviewUrl(activeType ? newUrl.trim() : null);
                  setMediaType(activeType);
                }
              }}
              placeholder="https://drive.google.com/file/d/... or Dropbox link"
              disabled={submitting || isUploading}
              className="w-full text-xs px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-surface-muted border border-border-theme text-foreground placeholder:text-text-secondary focus:outline-none focus:border-secondary transition-colors disabled:opacity-60"
            />
            <p className="text-[10px] text-text-secondary">
              Directly uploads populate this URL, or you can paste an external Google Drive / Dropbox link.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Notes / Comments */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground block">
                Submission Notes / Comments
              </label>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-text-secondary">
                {notes.length}/2000
              </span>
            </div>
            <textarea
              rows={4}
              maxLength={2000}
              value={notes}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setNotes(e.target.value);
                setValidationError(null);
              }}
              placeholder="Add details about your submission, posting schedule, or response to brand feedback..."
              disabled={submitting || isUploading}
              className="w-full text-xs p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-surface-muted border border-border-theme text-foreground placeholder:text-text-secondary focus:outline-none focus:border-secondary transition-colors resize-none disabled:opacity-60"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Footer Actions */}
          <div className="pt-3 border-t border-border-theme flex items-center justify-end gap-3">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleClose}
              disabled={submitting || isUploading}
              className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-border-theme bg-surface hover:bg-surface-muted text-foreground text-xs font-semibold transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={submitting || isUploading}
              className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-black hover:bg-neutral-800 text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-black dark:hover:bg-neutral-200 text-xs font-semibold transition-all shadow-xs cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
            >
              {submitting ? (
                <>
                  <div className="w-3.5 h-3.5 border-2 border-white dark:border-black border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
                  <span>Submitting...</span>
                </>
              ) : isUploading ? (
                <>
                  <div className="w-3.5 h-3.5 border-2 border-white dark:border-black border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
                  <span>Uploading media...</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <span>{isResubmission ? "Submit Revision" : "Submit Work"}</span>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useDispatch, useSelector } from "react-redux";
