                      <div className="relative pl-3 space-y-5 before:absolute before:top-3 before:bottom-3 before:left-[17px] before:w-0.5 before:bg-gray-100 dark:before:bg-zinc-800">
                        {/* 1. Latest Submission */}
                        {submissions.slice(0, 1).map((sub, idx) => {
                          const matchedDeliv = findDeliverableForSubmission(sub, deliverables);
                          const subTitle =
                            sub.title ||
                            sub.deliverableTitle ||
                            matchedDeliv?.title ||
                            (sub.submittedAt ? `Submission (${formatDate(sub.submittedAt)})` : "Deliverable Submission");
                          const delivBadge = matchedDeliv
                            ? getDeliverableStatusBadge(matchedDeliv.status)
                            : getDeliverableStatusBadge("submitted");
                          const validFileUrl = isValidExternalUrl(sub.fileUrl) ? sub.fileUrl.trim() : null;
                          const validLink = isValidExternalUrl(sub.link) ? sub.link.trim() : null;
                          const mediaType = validFileUrl ? detectMediaType(validFileUrl) : null;
                          const secondaryLabel =
                            mediaType === "video" ? "Video" : mediaType === "image" ? "Image" : "File";

                          return (
                            <div key={sub._id || idx} className="relative group">
                              {/* Timeline Marker */}
                              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                                  <div className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-[#E11D48] ring-4 ring-pink-100 dark:ring-pink-950/60 shrink-0 z-10" />
                                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[#E11D48] dark:text-[#FB7185] text-xs font-bold">
                                    <FolderIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                    <span>Latest Submission</span>
                                  </div>
                                </div>
                                <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 dark:text-zinc-500 font-medium">
                                  {formatDateTime(sub.submittedAt)}
                                </span>
                              </div>

                              {/* Submission Card */}
                              <div className="ml-5 mt-2 bg-gray-50/70 dark:bg-zinc-800/40 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/70 border border-gray-100 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl p-3 flex items-center gap-3.5 transition-all shadow-2xs">
                                {/* Thumbnail */}
                                {validFileUrl ? (
                                  mediaType === "video" ? (
                                    <div className="w-24 h-16 sm:w-28 sm:h-20 rounded-xl overflow-hidden relative shrink-0 bg-black/90 border border-gray-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
                                      <video
                                        src={validFileUrl}
                                        preload="metadata"
                                        className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                                      />
                                      <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/25">
                                        <div className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-white/90 text-gray-900 flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs">
                                          <PlayIcon className="w-3 h-3 translate-x-0.5 fill-current" />
                                        </div>
                                      </div>
                                    </div>
                                  ) : mediaType === "image" ? (
                                    <div className="w-24 h-16 sm:w-28 sm:h-20 rounded-xl overflow-hidden relative shrink-0 bg-gray-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 border border-gray-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
                                      {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                                      <img
                                        src={validFileUrl}
                                        alt={subTitle}
                                        className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                                        loading="lazy"
                                      />
                                    </div>
                                  ) : (
                                    /* Neutral File Preview for non-image/non-video file types */
                                    <div className="w-24 h-16 sm:w-28 sm:h-20 rounded-xl bg-gray-50 dark:bg-zinc-800 border border-gray-100 dark:border-zinc-700 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-gray-400 shrink-0">
                                      <DocumentIcon className="w-5 h-5 text-gray-400 mb-0.5" />
                                      <span className="text-[9px] font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                        {secondaryLabel}
                                      </span>
                                    </div>
                                  )
                                ) : validLink ? (
                                  <div className="w-24 h-16 sm:w-28 sm:h-20 rounded-xl bg-pink-50/50 dark:bg-pink-950/20 border border-pink-100 dark:border-pink-900/40 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-[#FF4F87] shrink-0">
                                    <ExternalLinkIcon className="w-5 h-5 mb-0.5" />
                                    <span className="text-[9px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">Link</span>
                                  </div>
                                ) : (
                                  <div className="w-24 h-16 sm:w-28 sm:h-20 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-800 border border-gray-100 dark:border-zinc-700 flex items-center justify-center text-gray-400 shrink-0">
                                    <DocumentIcon className="w-5 h-5" />
                                  </div>
                                )}

                                {/* Details */}
                                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-1">
                                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                                    <span className="font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm text-gray-900 dark:text-white truncate block">
                                      {subTitle}
                                    </span>
                                    <span
                                      className={`px-2 py-0.2 rounded-full text-[9px] font-bold border uppercase tracking-wider ${delivBadge.color}`}
                                    >
                                      {delivBadge.label}
                                    </span>
                                  </div>

                                  {sub.notes && (
                                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 truncate block">
                                      {sub.notes}
                                    </p>
                                  )}

                                  {/* View Asset & View Content Links with HTTP/HTTPS URL Validation */}
                                  <div className="pt-0.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                                    {validFileUrl && (
                                      <a
                                        href={validFileUrl}
                                        target="_blank"
                                        rel="noopener noreferrer"
                                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold text-[#E11D48] dark:text-[#FB7185] hover:opacity-85 transition-opacity"
                                      >
                                        <ExternalLinkIcon className="w-3 h-3" />
                                        <span>View Asset</span>
                                        <span className="text-[9px] font-medium px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-gray-200/70 dark:bg-zinc-700 text-gray-600 dark:text-zinc-300 ml-1">
                                          {secondaryLabel}
                                        </span>
                                      </a>
                                    )}
                                    {validLink && (
                                      <a
                                        href={validLink}
                                        target="_blank"
                                        rel="noopener noreferrer"
                                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold text-[#E11D48] dark:text-[#FB7185] hover:opacity-85 transition-opacity"
                                      >
                                        <ExternalLinkIcon className="w-3 h-3" />
                                        <span>View Content</span>
                                        <span className="text-[9px] font-medium px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-gray-200/70 dark:bg-zinc-700 text-gray-600 dark:text-zinc-300 ml-1">
                                          Open Link
                                        </span>
                                      </a>
                                    )}
                                  </div>
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          );
                        })}

                        {/* 2. Previous Version */}
                        {submissions.slice(1, 2).map((sub, idx) => {
                          const matchedDeliv = findDeliverableForSubmission(sub, deliverables);
                          const subTitle =
                            sub.title ||
                            sub.deliverableTitle ||
                            matchedDeliv?.title ||
                            (sub.submittedAt ? `Submission (${formatDate(sub.submittedAt)})` : "Deliverable Submission");
                          const delivBadge = matchedDeliv
                            ? getDeliverableStatusBadge(matchedDeliv.status)
                            : getDeliverableStatusBadge("submitted");
                          const validFileUrl = isValidExternalUrl(sub.fileUrl) ? sub.fileUrl.trim() : null;
                          const validLink = isValidExternalUrl(sub.link) ? sub.link.trim() : null;
                          const mediaType = validFileUrl ? detectMediaType(validFileUrl) : null;
                          const secondaryLabel =
                            mediaType === "video" ? "Video" : mediaType === "image" ? "Image" : "File";

                          return (
                            <div key={sub._id || idx} className="relative group">
                              {/* Timeline Marker */}
                              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                                  <div className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-gray-400 dark:bg-zinc-600 ring-4 ring-gray-100 dark:ring-zinc-800 shrink-0 z-10" />
                                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 text-xs font-semibold">
                                    <HistoryIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                    <span>Previous Version</span>
                                  </div>
                                </div>
                                <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 dark:text-zinc-500 font-medium">
                                  {formatDateTime(sub.submittedAt)}
                                </span>
                              </div>

                              {/* Submission Card */}
                              <div className="ml-5 mt-2 bg-gray-50/70 dark:bg-zinc-800/40 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/70 border border-gray-100 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl p-3 flex items-center gap-3.5 transition-all shadow-2xs">
                                {/* Thumbnail */}
                                {validFileUrl ? (
                                  mediaType === "video" ? (
                                    <div className="w-24 h-16 sm:w-28 sm:h-20 rounded-xl overflow-hidden relative shrink-0 bg-black/90 border border-gray-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
                                      <video
                                        src={validFileUrl}
                                        preload="metadata"
                                        className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                                      />
                                      <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/25">
                                        <div className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-white/90 text-gray-900 flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs">
                                          <PlayIcon className="w-3 h-3 translate-x-0.5 fill-current" />
                                        </div>
                                      </div>
                                    </div>
                                  ) : mediaType === "image" ? (
                                    <div className="w-24 h-16 sm:w-28 sm:h-20 rounded-xl overflow-hidden relative shrink-0 bg-gray-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 border border-gray-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
                                      {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                                      <img
                                        src={validFileUrl}
                                        alt={subTitle}
                                        className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                                        loading="lazy"
                                      />
                                    </div>
                                  ) : (
                                    /* Neutral File Preview for non-image/non-video file types */
                                    <div className="w-24 h-16 sm:w-28 sm:h-20 rounded-xl bg-gray-50 dark:bg-zinc-800 border border-gray-100 dark:border-zinc-700 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-gray-400 shrink-0">
                                      <DocumentIcon className="w-5 h-5 text-gray-400 mb-0.5" />
                                      <span className="text-[9px] font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                        {secondaryLabel}
                                      </span>
                                    </div>
                                  )
                                ) : validLink ? (
                                  <div className="w-24 h-16 sm:w-28 sm:h-20 rounded-xl bg-pink-50/50 dark:bg-pink-950/20 border border-pink-100 dark:border-pink-900/40 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-[#FF4F87] shrink-0">
                                    <ExternalLinkIcon className="w-5 h-5 mb-0.5" />
                                    <span className="text-[9px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">Link</span>
                                  </div>
                                ) : (
                                  <div className="w-24 h-16 sm:w-28 sm:h-20 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-800 border border-gray-100 dark:border-zinc-700 flex items-center justify-center text-gray-400 shrink-0">
                                    <DocumentIcon className="w-5 h-5" />
                                  </div>
                                )}

                                {/* Details */}
                                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-1">
                                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                                    <span className="font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm text-gray-900 dark:text-white truncate block">
                                      {subTitle}
                                    </span>
                                    <span
                                      className={`px-2 py-0.2 rounded-full text-[9px] font-bold border uppercase tracking-wider ${delivBadge.color}`}
                                    >
                                      {delivBadge.label}
                                    </span>
                                  </div>

                                  {sub.notes && (
                                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 truncate block">
                                      {sub.notes}
                                    </p>
                                  )}

                                  {/* View Asset & View Content Links with HTTP/HTTPS URL Validation */}
                                  <div className="pt-0.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                                    {validFileUrl && (
                                      <a
                                        href={validFileUrl}
                                        target="_blank"
                                        rel="noopener noreferrer"
                                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold text-[#E11D48] dark:text-[#FB7185] hover:opacity-85 transition-opacity"
                                      >
                                        <ExternalLinkIcon className="w-3 h-3" />
                                        <span>View Asset</span>
                                        <span className="text-[9px] font-medium px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-gray-200/70 dark:bg-zinc-700 text-gray-600 dark:text-zinc-300 ml-1">
                                          {secondaryLabel}
                                        </span>
                                      </a>
                                    )}
                                    {validLink && (
                                      <a
                                        href={validLink}
                                        target="_blank"
                                        rel="noopener noreferrer"
                                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold text-[#E11D48] dark:text-[#FB7185] hover:opacity-85 transition-opacity"
                                      >
                                        <ExternalLinkIcon className="w-3 h-3" />
                                        <span>View Content</span>
                                        <span className="text-[9px] font-medium px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-gray-200/70 dark:bg-zinc-700 text-gray-600 dark:text-zinc-300 ml-1">
                                          Open Link
                                        </span>
                                      </a>
                                    )}
                                  </div>
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          );
                        })}

                        {/* 3. Older Submissions (Accordion) */}
                        <div className="pt-2 border-t border-gray-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setIsOlderSubmissionsOpen((prev) => !prev)}
                            disabled={submissions.length <= 2}
                            className={`w-full flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 py-1 transition-colors ${submissions.length > 2 ? "cursor-pointer hover:text-gray-900 dark:hover:text-white" : "cursor-default opacity-80"
                              }`}
                          >
                            <span className="flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold">
                              Older Submissions ({Math.max(0, submissions.length - 2)})
                            </span>
                            <ChevronDownIcon
                              className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 transition-transform duration-200 ${isOlderSubmissionsOpen ? "rotate-180" : ""
                                }`}
                            />
                          </button>

                          {/* Expanded Older Submissions */}
                          {isOlderSubmissionsOpen && submissions.length > 2 && (
                            <div className="space-y-4 pt-3">
                              {submissions.slice(2).map((sub, idx) => {
                                const matchedDeliv = findDeliverableForSubmission(sub, deliverables);
                                const subTitle =
                                  sub.title ||
                                  sub.deliverableTitle ||
                                  matchedDeliv?.title ||
                                  "Untitled Submission";
                                const delivBadge = matchedDeliv
                                  ? getDeliverableStatusBadge(matchedDeliv.status)
                                  : getDeliverableStatusBadge("submitted");
                                const validFileUrl = isValidExternalUrl(sub.fileUrl) ? sub.fileUrl.trim() : null;
                                const validLink = isValidExternalUrl(sub.link) ? sub.link.trim() : null;
                                const mediaType = validFileUrl ? detectMediaType(validFileUrl) : null;
                                const secondaryLabel =
                                  mediaType === "video" ? "Video" : mediaType === "image" ? "Image" : "File";

                                return (
                                  <div key={sub._id || idx} className="relative group">
                                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                                        <div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-gray-300 dark:bg-zinc-600 shrink-0 z-10 ml-0.5" />
                                        <span className="text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 text-xs font-medium">
                                          Historical Version
                                        </span>
                                      </div>
                                      <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">
                                        {formatDateTime(sub.submittedAt)}
                                      </span>
                                    </div>

                                    <div className="ml-5 mt-2 bg-gray-50/70 dark:bg-zinc-800/40 border border-gray-100 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl p-2.5 flex items-center gap-3">
                                      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-1">
                                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                          <span className="font-semibold text-xs text-gray-800 dark:text-gray-200 truncate">
                                            {subTitle}
                                          </span>
                                          <span className={`px-2 py-0.2 rounded-full text-[9px] font-bold border uppercase tracking-wider ${delivBadge.color}`}>
                                            {delivBadge.label}
                                          </span>
                                        </div>
                                        {sub.notes && (
                                          <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 truncate">
                                            {sub.notes}
                                          </p>
                                        )}
                                        <div className="pt-0.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                                          {validFileUrl && (
                                            <a
                                              href={validFileUrl}
                                              target="_blank"
                                              rel="noopener noreferrer"
                                              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-[#E11D48] dark:text-[#FB7185] hover:opacity-85"
                                            >
                                              <ExternalLinkIcon className="w-3 h-3" />
                                              <span>View Asset</span>
                                              <span className="text-[9px] font-medium px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-gray-200/70 dark:bg-zinc-700 text-gray-600 ml-1">
                                                {secondaryLabel}
                                              </span>
                                            </a>
                                          )}
                                          {validLink && (
                                            <a
                                              href={validLink}
                                              target="_blank"
                                              rel="noopener noreferrer"
                                              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-[#E11D48] dark:text-[#FB7185] hover:opacity-85"
                                            >
                                              <ExternalLinkIcon className="w-3 h-3" />
                                              <span>View Content</span>
                                              <span className="text-[9px] font-medium px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-gray-200/70 dark:bg-zinc-700 text-gray-600 ml-1">
                                                Open Link
                                              </span>
                                            </a>
                                          )}
                                        </div>
                                      </div>
                                    </div>
                                  </div>
                                );
                              })}
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* Card 2: Campaign Brief & Service Details */}
                  <div className="bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-gray-100/90 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-3xl p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-xs space-y-4">
                    <div className="pb-3 border-b border-gray-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
                      <h2 className="font-serif text-lg sm:text-xl font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight">
                        Campaign Brief &amp; Service Details
                      </h2>
                    </div>

                    {/* Campaign Overview */}
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                      <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-pink-50 dark:bg-pink-950/40 text-[#FF4F87] flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-0.5">
                        <DocumentIcon className="w-4 h-4 text-[#FF4F87]" />
                      </div>
                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        <h4 className="font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                          Campaign Description
                        </h4>
                        <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-line">
                          {campaign?.description || workspace?.brief || "No campaign overview provided."}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Deliverables & Requirements / Package Scope */}
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-3 pt-3 border-t border-gray-100 dark:border-zinc-800/80">
                      <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-pink-50 dark:bg-pink-950/40 text-[#FF4F87] flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-0.5">
                        <SparklesIcon className="w-4 h-4 text-[#FF4F87]" />
                      </div>
                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        <h4 className="font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                          Deliverables &amp; Requirements
                        </h4>
                        <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-line">
                          {service?.description || "No service package details provided."}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Delivery Time Footer */}
                    <div className="pt-3 border-t border-gray-100 dark:border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                      <span className="text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 flex items-center gap-2">
                        <ClockIcon className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-400" />
                        <span>Delivery Time</span>

                      <span className="font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                        {service?.deliveryTime ? `${service.deliveryTime} Days` : "Not specified"}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                  {/* Card 3: Revision History (if revisions exist) */}
                  {revisions.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-gray-100/90 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-3xl p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-xs space-y-3.5">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-gray-100 dark:border-zinc-800">

                          {revisions.length} Total

                      </div>
                      <div className="space-y-3">

                              &ldquo;{rev.feedback}&rdquo;
                            </p>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </main>
      </div>

      {/* Submit Work Modal */}
      <CreatorSubmitWorkModal
        isOpen={isSubmitModalOpen}
        onClose={handleCloseSubmitModal}
        workspaceId={workspaceId}
        targetDeliverable={selectedDeliverable}
        isResubmission={selectedDeliverable?.status === "revision_requested"}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

// =========================================================
// HELPER UTILITIES & STATUS CONFIG
// =========================================================
const STATUS_TABS = [
  { id: "All", label: "All Workspaces" },
  { id: "in_progress", label: "In Progress" },
  { id: "submitted", label: "Submitted" },
  { id: "revision_requested", label: "Revision Requested" },
  { id: "completed", label: "Completed" },
  { id: "cancelled", label: "Cancelled" },
];

const PLATFORM_MAP = {
  instagram: "Instagram",
  facebook: "Facebook",
  youtube: "YouTube",
  tiktok: "TikTok",
  website: "Website",
};

const formatPlatform = (val) => {
  if (!val) return "";
  return PLATFORM_MAP[val.toLowerCase()] || val;
};

const formatPrice = (amount, currency = "INR") => {
  if (typeof amount !== "number" || isNaN(amount)) return "N/A";
  const symbol = currency === "INR" ? "₹" : `${currency} `;
  return `${symbol}${new Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN").format(amount)}`;
};

const formatDate = (dateString) => {
  if (!dateString) return "N/A";
  try {
    const d = new Date(dateString);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return "N/A";
    return d.toLocaleDateString("en-IN", {
      day: "numeric",
      month: "short",
      year: "numeric",
    });
  } catch {
    return "N/A";
  }
};

const getStatusBadge = (status) => {
  switch (status) {
    case "in_progress":
      return {
        label: "In Progress",
        color: "text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400",
      };
    case "submitted":
      return {
        label: "Submitted",
        color: "text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400",
      };
    case "revision_requested":
      return {
        label: "Revision Requested",
        color: "text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400",
      };
    case "completed":
      return {
        label: "Completed",
        color: "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400",
      };
    case "cancelled":
      return {
        label: "Cancelled",
        color: "text-neutral-600 dark:text-neutral-400",
      };
    default:
      return {
        label: status ? status.replace(/_/g, " ").replace(/\b\w/g, (l) => l.toUpperCase()) : "Active",
        color: "text-neutral-600 dark:text-neutral-400",
      };
  }
};

export default function CreatorWorkspaceManager() {
  const dispatch = useDispatch();
  const { workspaces, pagination, loading, error } = useSelector(
    (state) => state.creatorWorkspace
  );

  const [mobileOpen, setMobileOpen] = useState(false);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("All");
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [allWorkspacesSummary, setAllWorkspacesSummary] = useState([]);
  const [failedCoverUrls, setFailedCoverUrls] = useState({});
  const [failedBrandAvatars, setFailedBrandAvatars] = useState({});

  // Fetch summary counts for the 4 header metric cards (unfiltered global count)
  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    const fetchSummary = async () => {
      try {
        const res = await getCreatorWorkspacesApi({ limit: 100 });
        if (isMounted && res?.data?.workspaces) {
          setAllWorkspacesSummary(res.data.workspaces);
        }
      } catch {
        // Silently fall back to loaded workspaces if initial fetch fails
      }
    };
    fetchSummary();
    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, []);

  // Fetch workspaces when page or status tab changes
  useEffect(() => {
    const params = {
      page: currentPage,
      limit: 9,
    };
    if (activeTab !== "All") {
      params.status = activeTab;
    }
    dispatch(fetchCreatorWorkspaces(params));
  }, [dispatch, currentPage, activeTab]);

  const handleTabChange = (tabId) => {
    setActiveTab(tabId);
    setCurrentPage(1);
  };

  const handleRetry = () => {
    const params = {
      page: currentPage,
      limit: 9,
    };
    if (activeTab !== "All") {
      params.status = activeTab;
    }
    dispatch(fetchCreatorWorkspaces(params));
  };

  const handlePageChange = (newPage) => {
    if (pagination && newPage >= 1 && newPage <= pagination.totalPages) {
      setCurrentPage(newPage);
    }
  };

  // Compute live summary statistics from actual data
  const summarySource = allWorkspacesSummary.length > 0 ? allWorkspacesSummary : workspaces;
  const totalCount = pagination?.totalItems ?? (allWorkspacesSummary.length > 0 ? allWorkspacesSummary.length : workspaces.length);
  const inProgressCount = summarySource.filter(
    (w) => w.status === "in_progress" || w.status === "submitted" || w.status === "revision_requested"
  ).length;
  const completedCount = summarySource.filter((w) => w.status === "completed").length;
  const cancelledCount = summarySource.filter((w) => w.status === "cancelled").length;

  // Search filter applied on top of the active workspace list
  const displayedWorkspaces = workspaces.filter((ws) => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return true;
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
    const title = (ws.campaign?.title || "").toLowerCase();
    const brand = (ws.brand?.name || ws.brand?.email || "").toLowerCase();
    const category = (ws.campaign?.category || "").toLowerCase();
    const brief = (ws.brief || "").toLowerCase();
    return (
      title.includes(q) ||
      brand.includes(q) ||
      category.includes(q) ||
      brief.includes(q)
    );
  });

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-background text-foreground flex flex-col font-sans">
      {/* Sidebar */}
      <CreatorSidebar mobileOpen={mobileOpen} setMobileOpen={setMobileOpen} />

      {/* Main Container Offset by Desktop Sidebar */}
      <div className="flex-1 lg:ml-64 flex flex-col min-w-0">
        {/* Header */}
        <CreatorHeader setMobileOpen={setMobileOpen} />

        {/* Page Content */}

          <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-[#fff5f8] via-[#fffbfd] to-[#fff0f5] dark:bg-gradient-to-r dark:from-surface dark:via-surface dark:to-pink-950/20 border border-pink-100/90 dark:border-pink-900/30 rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl p-4 sm:p-6 shadow-[0_4px_24px_rgba(255,45,108,0.05)] relative overflow-hidden space-y-3.5 sm:space-y-4">
            {/* Ambient Soft Blush Background Accents */}
            <div className="absolute -top-16 -left-16 w-64 h-64 bg-pink-200/25 dark:bg-pink-900/10 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />
            <div className="absolute -bottom-16 right-1/4 w-60 h-60 bg-rose-200/20 dark:bg-rose-900/10 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />

            {/* Top Row: Heading on Left & Deliverables Illustration on Right */}
            <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-start lg:justify-between gap-4 sm:gap-6">
              {/* Left Column: Heading moved up & aligned to top */}
              <div className="max-w-xl space-y-1.5 pt-0.5">
                <div>
                  <span className="font-bold text-[11px] tracking-wider uppercase text-[#ff2d6c] dark:text-[#ff4f87] font-sans">
                    CREATOR WORKSPACE
                  </span>
                </div>

                <h1 className="font-serif font-medium text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl text-neutral-950 dark:text-white tracking-tight">
                  Collaboration Workspaces
                </h1>

                <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-text-secondary leading-relaxed">
                  Track deliverables, submit campaign work, and review brand feedback.
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* Right Column: Polished Deliverables Illustration Matching Reference Screenshot */}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-center lg:justify-end w-full lg:w-auto shrink-0 select-none">
                <div className="relative w-[300px] sm:w-[350px] h-[155px] sm:h-[165px] scale-90 sm:scale-95 origin-top lg:origin-top-right">
                  {/* Dotted Accent Curve */}
                  <svg
                    className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full pointer-events-none"
                    viewBox="0 0 380 210"
                    fill="none"
                  >
                    <path
                      d="M 50 160 C 25 70, 140 25, 230 25 C 290 25, 360 45, 365 95"
                      stroke="rgba(244, 114, 182, 0.4)"
                      strokeWidth="1.5"
                      strokeDasharray="3 4"
                      strokeLinecap="round"
                    />
                  </svg>

                  {/* Decorative Sparkles */}
                  {/* Bottom-left black sparkle */}
                  <div className="absolute left-6 bottom-3 text-black dark:text-white pointer-events-none animate-pulse motion-reduce:animate-none">
                    <SparkleIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-current" />
                  </div>
                  {/* Top-center soft pink sparkle */}
                  <div className="absolute left-32 top-3 text-pink-300 dark:text-pink-400 pointer-events-none">
                    <SparkleIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-current" />
                  </div>
                  {/* Sparkle above Deliverables card */}
                  <div className="absolute left-52 top-1 text-black dark:text-white pointer-events-none">
                    <SparkleIcon className="w-3 h-3 fill-current" />
                  </div>
                  {/* Top-right sparkle 1 (black, larger) */}
                  <div className="absolute right-10 top-2 text-black dark:text-white pointer-events-none animate-pulse motion-reduce:animate-none [animation-delay:400ms]">
                    <SparkleIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-current" />
                  </div>
                  {/* Top-right sparkle 2 (black, smaller) */}
                  <div className="absolute right-3 top-8 text-black dark:text-white pointer-events-none opacity-80">
                    <SparkleIcon className="w-2.5 h-2.5 fill-current" />
                  </div>

                  {/* Floating Photo Icon Card (Top-Left) */}
                  <div className="absolute left-4 sm:left-6 top-1 w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-surface border border-neutral-100 dark:border-border-theme shadow-md shadow-black/[0.04] flex items-center justify-center text-black dark:text-white z-20 creator-float motion-reduce:animate-none">
                    <PhotoIcon className="w-4.5 h-4.5 fill-current" />
                  </div>

                  {/* Floating Send/Paper Airplane Card (Mid-Left) */}
                  <div className="absolute left-9 sm:left-12 bottom-6 sm:bottom-8 w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-surface border border-neutral-100 dark:border-border-theme shadow-md shadow-black/[0.04] flex items-center justify-center text-black dark:text-white z-20 creator-float motion-reduce:animate-none [animation-delay:600ms]">
                    <PaperAirplaneIcon className="w-4.5 h-4.5 -rotate-45" />
                  </div>

                  {/* Floating Message Card with 3 dots (Bottom-Right of Deliverables card) */}
                  <div className="absolute right-24 sm:right-28 bottom-2 sm:bottom-3 w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-surface border border-neutral-100 dark:border-border-theme shadow-md shadow-black/[0.04] flex items-center justify-center text-black dark:text-white z-20 creator-float motion-reduce:animate-none [animation-delay:1000ms]">
                    <ChatBubbleDotsIcon className="w-4.5 h-4.5 text-black dark:text-white" />
                  </div>

                  {/* Background Media Preview Card (Tilted Clockwise) */}
                  <div className="absolute right-2 sm:right-4 top-5 w-40 sm:w-44 bg-white/95 dark:bg-surface/95 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-2xl border border-pink-100/70 dark:border-border-theme shadow-lg shadow-black/[0.04] p-3 rotate-[8deg] z-5">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-pink-100/70 dark:bg-pink-950/50 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                        <svg className="w-4 h-4 text-pink-400 dark:text-pink-300 ml-0.5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2.5} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
                          <polygon points="5 3 19 12 5 21 5 3" />
                        </svg>
                      </div>
                      <div className="space-y-1.5 flex-1 min-w-0">
                        <div className="h-2 w-14 bg-pink-100/90 dark:bg-pink-900/40 rounded-full" />
                        <div className="h-1.5 w-16 bg-neutral-100 dark:bg-neutral-800 rounded-full" />
                        <div className="h-1.5 w-10 bg-neutral-100 dark:bg-neutral-800 rounded-full" />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Foreground Deliverables Checklist Card (Tilted Counter-Clockwise) */}
                  <div className="absolute left-16 sm:left-20 top-0 w-44 sm:w-48 -rotate-[3deg] bg-white dark:bg-surface border border-neutral-100 dark:border-border-theme rounded-2xl p-3.5 sm:p-4 shadow-xl shadow-black/[0.05] z-10">
                    <h4 className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold font-sans text-neutral-900 dark:text-white mb-2.5">
                      Deliverables
                    </h4>
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <CheckIcon className="w-3 h-3 text-black dark:text-white stroke-[2.5] shrink-0" />
                        <span className="text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] font-medium text-neutral-700 dark:text-neutral-300">
                          Create Content
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <CheckIcon className="w-3 h-3 text-black dark:text-white stroke-[2.5] shrink-0" />
                        <span className="text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] font-medium text-neutral-700 dark:text-neutral-300">
                          Submit for Review
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <CheckIcon className="w-3 h-3 text-black dark:text-white stroke-[2.5] shrink-0" />
                        <span className="text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] font-medium text-neutral-700 dark:text-neutral-300">
                          Get Feedback
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <div className="w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full bg-black dark:bg-white text-white dark:text-black flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                          <CheckIcon className="w-2 h-2 stroke-[3]" />
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] font-bold text-neutral-950 dark:text-white">
                          Completed
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Bottom Row: 4 Statistics Cards Integrated Inside Hero Section */}
            <div className="relative z-10 grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-2.5 sm:gap-3.5 pt-3 border-t border-pink-100/80 dark:border-pink-900/30">
              {/* Total Workspaces */}
              <div className="bg-white/95 dark:bg-surface/90 backdrop-blur-xs border border-pink-100/80 dark:border-border-theme rounded-xl sm:rounded-2xl py-2.5 px-3 sm:py-3 sm:px-4 shadow-2xs flex items-center gap-3 transition-all duration-300 ease-out hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md cursor-default">
                <div className="w-9 h-9 sm:w-10 sm:h-10 rounded-full bg-[#fce7f0] dark:bg-pink-950/40 text-black dark:text-white flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                  <WorkspaceIcon className="w-4.5 h-4.5 sm:w-5 sm:h-5 stroke-[1.8]" />
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <span className="text-[11px] sm:text-xs font-sans text-neutral-500 dark:text-text-secondary block leading-none mb-1">
                    Total Workspaces
                  </span>
                  <span className="font-sans font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-neutral-950 dark:text-white tabular-nums tracking-tight leading-none block">
                    {totalCount}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* In Progress */}
              <div className="bg-white/95 dark:bg-surface/90 backdrop-blur-xs border border-pink-100/80 dark:border-border-theme rounded-xl sm:rounded-2xl py-2.5 px-3 sm:py-3 sm:px-4 shadow-2xs flex items-center gap-3 transition-all duration-300 ease-out hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md cursor-default">
                <div className="w-9 h-9 sm:w-10 sm:h-10 rounded-full bg-[#fce7f0] dark:bg-pink-950/40 text-black dark:text-white flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                  <ClockIcon className="w-4.5 h-4.5 sm:w-5 sm:h-5 stroke-2" />
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <span className="text-[11px] sm:text-xs font-sans text-neutral-500 dark:text-text-secondary block leading-none mb-1">
                    In Progress
                  </span>
                  <span className="font-sans font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-neutral-950 dark:text-white tabular-nums tracking-tight leading-none block">
                    {inProgressCount}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Completed */}
              <div className="bg-white/95 dark:bg-surface/90 backdrop-blur-xs border border-pink-100/80 dark:border-border-theme rounded-xl sm:rounded-2xl py-2.5 px-3 sm:py-3 sm:px-4 shadow-2xs flex items-center gap-3 transition-all duration-300 ease-out hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md cursor-default">
                <div className="w-9 h-9 sm:w-10 sm:h-10 rounded-full bg-[#fce7f0] dark:bg-pink-950/40 text-black dark:text-white flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                  <CheckCircleIcon className="w-4.5 h-4.5 sm:w-5 sm:h-5 stroke-2" />
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <span className="text-[11px] sm:text-xs font-sans text-neutral-500 dark:text-text-secondary block leading-none mb-1">
                    Completed
                  </span>
                  <span className="font-sans font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-neutral-950 dark:text-white tabular-nums tracking-tight leading-none block">
                    {completedCount}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Cancelled */}
              <div className="bg-white/95 dark:bg-surface/90 backdrop-blur-xs border border-pink-100/80 dark:border-border-theme rounded-xl sm:rounded-2xl py-2.5 px-3 sm:py-3 sm:px-4 shadow-2xs flex items-center gap-3 transition-all duration-300 ease-out hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md cursor-default">
                <div className="w-9 h-9 sm:w-10 sm:h-10 rounded-full bg-[#fce7f0] dark:bg-pink-950/40 text-black dark:text-white flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                  <XCircleIcon className="w-4.5 h-4.5 sm:w-5 sm:h-5 stroke-2" />
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <span className="text-[11px] sm:text-xs font-sans text-neutral-500 dark:text-text-secondary block leading-none mb-1">
                    Cancelled
                  </span>
                  <span className="font-sans font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-neutral-950 dark:text-white tabular-nums tracking-tight leading-none block">
                    {cancelledCount}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 3. STATUS FILTERS & SEARCH CONTAINER */}
          <div className="bg-surface border border-border-theme rounded-2xl p-3 sm:p-4 shadow-xs space-y-3 sm:space-y-4">
            {/* Status Tabs */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2 overflow-x-auto custom-scrollbar py-3 ">
              {STATUS_TABS.map((tab) => {
                const isActive = activeTab === tab.id;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={tab.id}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleTabChange(tab.id)}
                    className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium transition-all shrink-0 cursor-pointer ${isActive
                        ? "bg-neutral-950 text-white font-semibold shadow-xs dark:bg-neutral-100 dark:text-neutral-950"
                        : "bg-surface-muted text-text-secondary hover:text-foreground hover:bg-surface-muted/80 border border-border-theme/60"
                      }`}
                  >
                    {tab.label}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            {/* Search Input */}
            <div className="relative">
              <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3.5 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-text-secondary">
                <SearchIcon className="w-4 h-4" />
              </div>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Search workspaces..."
                className="w-full text-xs pl-10 pr-9 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-surface-muted border border-border-theme text-foreground placeholder:text-text-secondary focus:outline-none focus:border-secondary transition-colors"
              />
              {searchQuery && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSearchQuery("")}
                  className="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 pr-3.5 flex items-center text-text-secondary hover:text-foreground cursor-pointer text-xs"
                  title="Clear search"
                >
                  ✕
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 4. ERROR BANNER */}
          {error && (
            <div className="bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/30 text-red-500 p-4 rounded-2xl text-xs font-medium flex items-center justify-between gap-4 shadow-xs">
              <span>{typeof error === "string" ? error : "Failed to load workspaces."}</span>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleRetry}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-red-500 text-white font-semibold hover:bg-red-600 transition-colors cursor-pointer shrink-0"
              >
                <RefreshIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Retry</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* 5. LOADING SKELETON STATE */}
          {loading && workspaces.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5 sm:gap-6">
              {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((idx) => (
                <div
                  key={idx}
                  className="bg-white dark:bg-surface border border-neutral-200/80 dark:border-border-theme rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-5 space-y-3.5 animate-pulse shadow-xs"
                >
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                      <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-surface-muted" />
                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        <div className="h-3 bg-surface-muted rounded-md w-24" />
                        <div className="h-2.5 bg-surface-muted rounded-md w-16" />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="h-5 bg-surface-muted rounded-full w-20" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="h-4 bg-surface-muted rounded-md w-3/4" />
                  <div className="h-3 bg-surface-muted rounded-md w-full" />
                  <div className="h-28 bg-surface-muted rounded-xl w-full" />
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                    <div className="h-12 bg-surface-muted rounded-xl" />
                    <div className="h-12 bg-surface-muted rounded-xl" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="h-10 bg-surface-muted rounded-xl w-full" />
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : !loading && displayedWorkspaces.length === 0 ? (
            /* 6. EMPTY STATE */
            <div className="bg-white dark:bg-surface border border-neutral-200/80 dark:border-border-theme rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl p-8 sm:p-12 text-center space-y-4 max-w-lg mx-auto my-8 shadow-xs">
              <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-pink-50 dark:bg-pink-950/40 text-pink-500 border border-pink-100 dark:border-pink-900/40 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto">
                <BriefcaseIcon className="w-7 h-7" />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <h3 className="font-sans font-semibold text-lg text-foreground tracking-tight">
                  No workspaces found
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-text-secondary font-sans max-w-sm mx-auto leading-relaxed">
                  {searchQuery
                    ? `No workspaces match your search query "${searchQuery}". Try searching with a different campaign or brand term.`
                    : activeTab !== "All"
                      ? `You currently have no workspaces in the "${STATUS_TABS.find((t) => t.id === activeTab)?.label || activeTab}" stage.`
                      : "Once a brand accepts your campaign application or booking proposal, your collaboration workspace will appear here."}
                </p>
              </div>
              {(searchQuery || activeTab !== "All") && (
                <div className="pt-2">
                  <button
                    type="button"

                      setSearchQuery("");

                    <span>Reset Filters</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : (
            /* 7. WORKSPACE CARDS GRID (3 cols desktop, 2 cols tablet, 1 col mobile) */
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5 sm:gap-6">

                const badge = getStatusBadge(ws.status);
                const campaignTitle = ws.campaign?.title || ws.service?.title || "Campaign Workspace";
                const brandName = ws.brand?.name || ws.brand?.email?.split("@")[0] || "Brand Partner";
                const brandInitial = brandName.charAt(0).toUpperCase() || "B";
                const brandLogo = ws.brand?.logo || ws.brand?.avatar || ws.brand?.profileImage || null;
                const showBrandLogo = Boolean(brandLogo) && !failedBrandAvatars[ws._id];
                const agreedPriceFormatted = formatPrice(ws.agreedPrice, ws.currency);
                const deadlineFormatted = formatDate(ws.deadline);
                const deliverables = Array.isArray(ws.deliverables) ? ws.deliverables : [];

                const category = ws.campaign?.category || "";
                const platform = formatPlatform(ws.campaign?.platform);
                const brandSubtitle = category && platform
                  ? `${category} • ${platform}`
                  : category
                    ? `${category} • Collaboration`
                    : platform
                      ? `${platform} • Collaboration`
                      : "Brand Partner • Collaboration";

                const campaignDescription =
                  ws.brief ||
                  ws.campaign?.description ||
                  "Collaborate with brand partner, track deliverables, and complete milestones.";

                const coverImage = ws.campaign?.coverImage || ws.campaign?.image || null;

                const bookingId =
                  typeof ws.booking === "object" && ws.booking !== null
                    ? ws.booking._id
                    : ws.booking;

                return (
                  <div
                    key={ws._id}
                    className="bg-white dark:bg-surface border border-neutral-200/80 dark:border-border-theme hover:border-neutral-300 dark:hover:border-neutral-700 rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-xs hover:shadow-sm transition-all duration-200 flex flex-col justify-between group"
                  >
                    <div>
                      {/* Top Row: Brand Info, Status Badge & Menu */}
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2.5">
                        {/* Brand Avatar & Name */}
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
                          <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-neutral-900 text-white dark:bg-neutral-100 dark:text-neutral-900 flex items-center justify-center font-sans font-semibold text-sm shrink-0 shadow-2xs overflow-hidden">
                            {showBrandLogo ? (
                              <img
                                src={brandLogo}
                                alt={brandName}
                                className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                                onError={() =>
                                  setFailedBrandAvatars((prev) => ({
                                    ...prev,
                                    [ws._id]: true,
                                  }))
                                }
                              />
                            ) : (
                              brandInitial
                            )}
                          </div>
                          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                            <span className="text-xs font-sans font-semibold text-foreground block truncate">
                              Brand: {brandName}
                            </span>
                            <span className="text-[11px] font-sans text-text-secondary block truncate mt-0.5">
                              {brandSubtitle}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* Status Badge */}
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
                          <span
                            className={`text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] font-sans font-bold tracking-wider capitalize ${badge.color}`}
                          >
                            {badge.label}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Campaign Title */}
                      <h3 className="font-sans font-semibold text-base text-foreground line-clamp-1 mt-2.5 tracking-tight">
                        {campaignTitle}
                      </h3>

                      {/* Campaign Cover Image or Title Banner */}
                      {coverImage && !failedCoverUrls[ws._id] ? (
                        <div className="h-24 sm:h-28 rounded-xl overflow-hidden relative border border-neutral-100 dark:border-border-theme/40 mt-3">
                          {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                          <img
                            src={coverImage}
                            alt={campaignTitle}
                            className="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-300 ease-out hover:scale-105 group-hover:scale-105 motion-reduce:transform-none motion-reduce:transition-none"
                            onError={() =>
                              setFailedCoverUrls((prev) => ({
                                ...prev,
                                [ws._id]: true,
                              }))

                              {deadlineFormatted}

                      {deliverables.length > 0 && (

                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                            <span className="text-xs font-sans font-semibold text-foreground">

                            </span>
                            <Link
                              href={`/creator/workspace/${ws._id}`}
                              className="text-xs font-sans font-medium text-black hover:text-neutral-700 dark:text-white dark:hover:text-neutral-300 transition-colors inline-flex items-center gap-0.5"

                              <span>View All</span>
                              <span aria-hidden="true">&rarr;</span>
                            </Link>
                          </div>

                          <div className="space-y-1.5">
                            {deliverables.slice(0, 3).map((item, idx) => {
                              const title = typeof item === "string" ? item : item?.title || "Deliverable";
                              return (
                                <div
                                  key={item?._id || idx}
                                  className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-sans text-text-secondary"
                                >
                                  <div className="w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-transparent text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                                    <CheckIcon className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                                  </div>
                                  <span className="line-clamp-1">{title}</span>
                                </div>
                              );
                            })}
                            {deliverables.length > 3 && (
                              <span className="text-xs font-sans font-medium text-black dark:text-white block pt-0.5">
                                + {deliverables.length - 3} more deliverables
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {/* Bottom Actions: Black Primary Button & Neutral Chat Button */}
                    <div className="pt-3 mt-3 border-t border-border-theme/40 flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Link
                        href={`/creator/workspace/${ws._id}`}
                        className="group/btn flex-1 inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl bg-neutral-950 text-white text-xs font-sans font-semibold tracking-wide border border-neutral-900 shadow-xs hover:bg-neutral-900 hover:border-neutral-800 hover:shadow-xs hover:shadow-pink-500/10 active:scale-[0.99] transition-all duration-200 ease-out dark:bg-neutral-100 dark:text-neutral-950 dark:border-neutral-200 dark:hover:bg-neutral-200"
                      >
                        <span>Open Workspace</span>
                        <ArrowRightIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 transition-transform duration-200 group-hover/btn:translate-x-1" />
                      </Link>
                      {bookingId && (
                        <Link
                          href={`/creator/messages?bookingId=${bookingId}`}
                          title="Message Brand"
                          className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-surface-muted hover:bg-neutral-100 dark:hover:bg-surface-muted/80 text-text-secondary hover:text-foreground border border-neutral-200/80 dark:border-border-theme transition-all cursor-pointer shrink-0 shadow-2xs"
                        >
                          <ChatBubbleIcon className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </Link>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* 8. PAGINATION CONTROLS */}
          {pagination && pagination.totalPages > 1 && (
            <div className="bg-white dark:bg-surface border border-neutral-200/80 dark:border-border-theme rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-xs flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs font-sans text-text-secondary">
              <div>
                Showing Page <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">{pagination.page || currentPage}</span> of{" "}
                <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">{pagination.totalPages}</span> ({pagination.totalItems} Total Workspaces)
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handlePageChange(currentPage - 1)}
                  disabled={currentPage <= 1 || loading}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-neutral-200/80 dark:border-border-theme bg-surface-muted hover:bg-surface text-foreground font-medium disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <ChevronLeftIcon /> Previous
                </button>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  {Array.from({ length: pagination.totalPages }, (_, i) => i + 1).map((pageNum) => (
                    <button
                      key={pageNum}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handlePageChange(pageNum)}
                      className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-xl font-semibold text-xs transition-all cursor-pointer ${pageNum === currentPage
                        ? "bg-secondary text-white shadow-xs"
                        : "bg-surface hover:bg-surface-muted text-text-secondary border border-border-theme"
                        }`}
                    >
                      {pageNum}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handlePageChange(currentPage + 1)}
                  disabled={currentPage >= pagination.totalPages || loading}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-neutral-200/80 dark:border-border-theme bg-surface-muted hover:bg-surface text-foreground font-medium disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Next <ChevronRightIcon />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </main>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import axiosInstance from "@/lib/axios";


// Gets creator workspaces with optional query parameters (page, limit, status).
const getCreatorWorkspaces = async (params = {}) => {

    const response = await axiosInstance.get(
        "/creator/workspace",
        {
            params
        }
    );

    return response.data;
};


// Gets single creator workspace by ID.
const getCreatorWorkspaceById = async (workspaceId) => {

    const response = await axiosInstance.get(
        `/creator/workspace/${workspaceId}`
    );

    return response.data;
};


// Submits work / deliverables for a creator workspace (legacy / wrapper).
const submitCreatorWorkspaceWork = async (workspaceId, submissionData) => {

    const response = await axiosInstance.post(
        `/creator/workspace/${workspaceId}/submit`,
        submissionData
    );

    return response.data;
};


// Submits work for a specific deliverable in a creator workspace.
const submitCreatorDeliverableWork = async (workspaceId, deliverableId, submissionData) => {

    const response = await axiosInstance.post(
        `/creator/workspace/${workspaceId}/deliverables/${deliverableId}/submit`,
        submissionData
    );

    return response.data;
};


export {
    getCreatorWorkspaces,
    getCreatorWorkspaceById,
    submitCreatorWorkspaceWork,
    submitCreatorDeliverableWork
};
