```javascript
import mongoose from "mongoose";

import Conversation from "./conversation.model.js";
import Message from "./message.model.js";
import Booking from "../booking/booking.model.js";
import Workspace from "../workspace/workspace.model.js";
import Auth from "../auth/auth.model.js";
import BrandProfile from "../brand/profile/profile.model.js";
import CreatorProfile from "../creator/profile/profile.model.js";
import Notification from "../notifications/notification.model.js";
import { createNotificationSafe } from "../notifications/notification.service.js";
import createApiError from "../../utils/ApiError.js";
import {
    getPagination,
    getPaginationData
} from "../../utils/pagination.js";

// Helper to enrich conversation participants with profile photo / brand logo
const attachConversationProfiles = async (conversations) => {
    if (!conversations) return conversations;
    const isSingle = !Array.isArray(conversations);
    const list = isSingle ? [conversations] : conversations;
    if (list.length === 0) return conversations;

    const participantIds = new Set();
    list.forEach((conv) => {
        const participants = conv.participants || [];
        participants.forEach((p) => {
            const pId = p?._id || (typeof p === "string" ? p : null);
            if (pId) participantIds.add(pId.toString());
        });
    });

    const idList = Array.from(participantIds).map((id) => new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(id));
    if (idList.length === 0) return conversations;

    const [brandProfiles, creatorProfiles] = await Promise.all([
        BrandProfile.find({ user: { $in: idList } }).select("user logo").lean(),
        CreatorProfile.find({ user: { $in: idList } }).select("user profileImage").lean()
    ]);

    const brandMap = new Map();
    brandProfiles.forEach((bp) => {
        if (bp.user) brandMap.set(bp.user.toString(), bp.logo || "");
    });

    const creatorMap = new Map();
    creatorProfiles.forEach((cp) => {
        if (cp.user) creatorMap.set(cp.user.toString(), cp.profileImage || "");
    });

    const enriched = list.map((conv) => {
        const convObj = conv.toObject ? conv.toObject() : { ...conv };
        if (Array.isArray(convObj.participants)) {
            convObj.participants = convObj.participants.map((p) => {
                if (!p || typeof p !== "object") return p;
                const pObj = p.toObject ? p.toObject() : { ...p };
                const pId = pObj._id?.toString();
                const brandLogo = pId ? brandMap.get(pId) : null;
                const creatorImage = pId ? creatorMap.get(pId) : null;
                const image = creatorImage || brandLogo || "";

                return {
                    ...pObj,
                    profileImage: image,
                    avatar: image,
                    logo: brandLogo || "",
                    image: image
                };
            });
        }
        return convObj;
    });

    return isSingle ? enriched[0] : enriched;
};

// Helper function to verify booking ownership, accepted status, workspace existence, and participant eligibility
const verifyBookingAccess = async (userId, bookingId, recipientId, campaignId) => {
    if (!mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(bookingId)) {
        throw createApiError(400, "Invalid booking ID");
    }

    if (!mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(recipientId)) {
        throw createApiError(400, "Invalid recipient ID");
    }

    const booking = await Booking.findById(bookingId);
    if (!booking) {
        throw createApiError(404, "Booking not found");
    }

    const brandIdStr = booking.brand.toString();
    const creatorIdStr = booking.creator.toString();
    const userIdStr = userId.toString();
    const recipientIdStr = recipientId.toString();

    // Authenticated user must be either brand or creator of this booking
    if (userIdStr !== brandIdStr && userIdStr !== creatorIdStr) {
        throw createApiError(403, "Access denied. You are not a participant in this booking.");
    }

    // Recipient must be the other participant of this booking
    const expectedRecipientId = userIdStr === brandIdStr ? creatorIdStr : brandIdStr;
    if (recipientIdStr !== expectedRecipientId) {
        throw createApiError(400, "Recipient does not match the other participant of this booking.");
    }

    // FIX 1: Booking status must be "accepted"
    if (booking.status !== "accepted") {
        throw createApiError(
            403,
            "Messaging is available only after the booking is accepted."
        );
    }

    // FIX 3: Campaign consistency check if client passed campaignId
    if (campaignId) {
        if (!booking.campaign) {
            throw createApiError(
                400,
                "Booking is not linked to a campaign."
            );
        }

        if (
            !mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(campaignId) ||
            campaignId.toString() !== booking.campaign.toString()
        ) {
            throw createApiError(
                400,
                "Campaign does not match the booking."
            );
        }
    }

    // FIX 2: Workspace must exist for this booking
    const workspace = await Workspace.findOne({
        booking: bookingId
    });

    if (!workspace) {
        throw createApiError(
            403,
            "Messaging is available only after the workspace is created."
        );
    }

    return booking;
};

// Common service to send a message
const sendMessageService = async (senderId, payload) => {
    const { recipientId, bookingId, campaignId, message, attachments } = payload;

    // 1. Verify booking access, accepted status, campaign consistency, and workspace existence
    const booking = await verifyBookingAccess(senderId, bookingId, recipientId, campaignId);

    const resolvedCampaignId = booking.campaign;

    // 2. Lookup existing conversation for this specific booking
    let conversation = await Conversation.findOne({
        booking: bookingId
    });

    if (!conversation) {
        conversation = await Conversation.create({
            participants: [senderId, recipientId],
            booking: bookingId,
            campaign: resolvedCampaignId,
            lastMessage: message.trim(),
            lastMessageAt: new Date()
        });
    } else {
        const participantStrs = conversation.participants.map((p) => p.toString());
        const senderIdStr = senderId.toString();
        const recipientIdStr = recipientId.toString();
        const brandIdStr = booking.brand.toString();
        const creatorIdStr = booking.creator.toString();

        const hasSender = participantStrs.includes(senderIdStr);
        const hasRecipient = participantStrs.includes(recipientIdStr);

        if (!hasSender || !hasRecipient) {
            throw createApiError(403, "Access denied. Both sender and recipient must be participants in this conversation.");
        }

        const hasBrand = participantStrs.includes(brandIdStr);
        const hasCreator = participantStrs.includes(creatorIdStr);

        if (!hasBrand || !hasCreator || participantStrs.length !== 2) {
            throw createApiError(403, "Access denied. Conversation participants do not match the booking brand and creator.");
        }

        conversation.lastMessage = message.trim();
        conversation.lastMessageAt = new Date();
        await conversation.save();
    }

    // 3. Create new message document
    const newMessage = await Message.create({
        conversation: conversation._id,
        sender: senderId,
        receiver: recipientId,
        message: message.trim(),
        attachments: Array.isArray(attachments) ? attachments : [],
        isRead: false
    });

    // 4. Create notification for the recipient (non-blocking)
    const isSenderBrand = senderId.toString() === booking.brand.toString();
    const verifiedRecipientId = isSenderBrand ? booking.creator : booking.brand;
    const destination = isSenderBrand
        ? `/creator/messages?conversationId=${conversation._id}`
        : `/brand/messages?conversationId=${conversation._id}`;

    let senderDisplayName = isSenderBrand ? "Brand" : "Creator";
    try {
        const senderUser = await Auth.findById(senderId).select("name");
        if (senderUser?.name && senderUser.name.trim()) {
            senderDisplayName = senderUser.name.trim();
        }
    } catch (lookupError) {
        console.error("Non-fatal sender name lookup error:", lookupError?.message || lookupError);
    }

    await createNotificationSafe({
        recipient: verifiedRecipientId,
        sender: senderId,
        type: "message:received",
        title: `New Message from ${senderDisplayName}`,
        message: message.trim().slice(0, 150),
        entityType: "message",
        entityId: conversation._id,
        destination,
        metadata: {
            conversationId: conversation._id,
            messageId: newMessage._id,
            bookingId: booking._id
        },
        idempotencyKey: `message:${newMessage._id}`
    });

    return {
        message: newMessage,
        conversationId: conversation._id
    };
};

// Common service to get conversations list for user
const getConversationsService = async (userId, query = {}) => {
    const { page, limit } = query;
    const { page: currentPage, limit: itemsPerPage, skip } = getPagination(page, limit);

    // Auto-backfill conversations for any accepted bookings belonging to this user
    const acceptedBookings = await Booking.find({
        $or: [{ brand: userId }, { creator: userId }],
        status: "accepted"
    }).select("_id brand creator campaign updatedAt");

    if (acceptedBookings.length > 0) {
        const bulkOps = acceptedBookings.map((b) => ({
            updateOne: {
                filter: { booking: b._id },
                update: {
                    $setOnInsert: {
                        participants: [b.brand, b.creator],
                        booking: b._id,
                        campaign: b.campaign,
                        lastMessage: "",
                        lastMessageAt: b.updatedAt || new Date()
                    }
                },
                upsert: true
            }
        }));
        await Conversation.bulkWrite(bulkOps);
    }

    const filter = {
        participants: userId
    };

    const [conversations, totalItems] = await Promise.all([
        Conversation.find(filter)
            .populate("participants", "name email role")
            .populate("booking", "agreedPrice status deliverables startDate deadline")
            .populate("campaign", "title category platform budget")
            .sort({ lastMessageAt: -1, updatedAt: -1 })
            .skip(skip)
            .limit(itemsPerPage),
        Conversation.countDocuments(filter)
    ]);

    const enrichedConversations = await attachConversationProfiles(conversations);

    const convIds = (conversations || []).map((c) => c._id);
    const unreadMap = new Map();

    if (convIds.length > 0) {
        const userObjId = mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(userId)
            ? new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(userId)
            : userId;

        const unreadCounts = await Message.aggregate([
            {
                $match: {
                    conversation: { $in: convIds },
                    receiver: userObjId,
                    isRead: false
                }
            },
            {
                $group: {
                    _id: "$conversation",
                    count: { $sum: 1 }
                }
            }
        ]);

        unreadCounts.forEach((item) => {
            if (item._id) {
                unreadMap.set(item._id.toString(), item.count);
            }
        });
    }

    const conversationsWithUnread = enrichedConversations.map((conv) => {
        const idStr = (conv._id || conv.id)?.toString();
        return {
            ...conv,
            unreadCount: idStr ? (unreadMap.get(idStr) || 0) : 0
        };
    });

    return {
        conversations: conversationsWithUnread,
        pagination: getPaginationData(currentPage, itemsPerPage, totalItems)
    };
};

// Common service to get single conversation and message thread
const getConversationByIdService = async (userId, conversationId) => {
    if (!mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(conversationId)) {
        throw createApiError(400, "Invalid conversation ID");
    }

    const conversation = await Conversation.findOne({
        _id: conversationId,
        participants: userId
    })
        .populate("participants", "name email role")
        .populate("booking")
        .populate("campaign");

    if (!conversation) {
        throw createApiError(404, "Conversation not found or access denied");
    }

    const enrichedConversation = await attachConversationProfiles(conversation);

    const messages = await Message.find({
        conversation: conversationId
    })
        .populate("sender", "name email role")
        .populate("receiver", "name email role")
        .sort({ createdAt: 1 });

    return {
        conversation: enrichedConversation,
        messages
    };
};

// Common service to mark unread messages in conversation as read
const markConversationReadService = async (userId, conversationId) => {
    if (!mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(conversationId)) {
        throw createApiError(400, "Invalid conversation ID");
    }

    const conversation = await Conversation.findOne({
        _id: conversationId,
        participants: userId
    });

    if (!conversation) {
        throw createApiError(404, "Conversation not found or access denied");
    }

    const result = await Message.updateMany(
        {
            conversation: conversationId,
            receiver: userId,
            isRead: false
        },
        {
            $set: { isRead: true }
        }
    );

    // Identify and mark associated unread message notifications as read
    const conversationObjId = new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(conversationId);
    const conversationIdStr = conversationId.toString();

    const unreadMessageNotifications = await Notification.find({
        recipient: userId,
        entityType: "message",
        $or: [
            { entityId: conversationObjId },
            { entityId: conversationIdStr },
            { "metadata.conversationId": conversationObjId },
            { "metadata.conversationId": conversationIdStr }
        ],
        isRead: false
    }).select("_id");

    const markedNotificationIds = unreadMessageNotifications.map((n) => n._id);

    if (markedNotificationIds.length > 0) {
        await Notification.updateMany(
            { _id: { $in: markedNotificationIds } },
            {
                $set: {
                    isRead: true,
                    readAt: new Date()
                }
            }
        );
    }

    return {
        modifiedCount: result.modifiedCount,
        markedNotificationIds
    };
};

// =========================================================
// CREATOR SERVICES
// =========================================================
const getCreatorConversationsService = (creatorId, query) =>
    getConversationsService(creatorId, query);

const getCreatorConversationByIdService = (creatorId, conversationId) =>
    getConversationByIdService(creatorId, conversationId);

const sendCreatorMessageService = (creatorId, payload) =>
    sendMessageService(creatorId, payload);

const markCreatorConversationReadService = (creatorId, conversationId) =>
    markConversationReadService(creatorId, conversationId);

// =========================================================
// BRAND SERVICES
// =========================================================
const getBrandConversationsService = (brandId, query) =>
    getConversationsService(brandId, query);

const getBrandConversationByIdService = (brandId, conversationId) =>
    getConversationByIdService(brandId, conversationId);

const sendBrandMessageService = (brandId, payload) =>
    sendMessageService(brandId, payload);

const markBrandConversationReadService = (brandId, conversationId) =>
    markConversationReadService(brandId, conversationId);

export {
    getCreatorConversationsService,
    getCreatorConversationByIdService,
    sendCreatorMessageService,
    markCreatorConversationReadService,
    getBrandConversationsService,
    getBrandConversationByIdService,
    sendBrandMessageService,
    markBrandConversationReadService
};
```

```javascript
import mongoose from "mongoose";
import createApiError from "../../utils/ApiError.js";

// Validates send message request payload
const validateSendMessage = (req, res, next) => {
    const { recipientId, bookingId, message, attachments, campaignId } = req.body;

    if (!recipientId || !mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(recipientId)) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Valid recipientId is required"
        );
    }

    if (!bookingId || !mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(bookingId)) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Valid bookingId is required"
        );
    }

    if (campaignId !== undefined && campaignId !== null && !mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(campaignId)) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Invalid campaignId format"
        );
    }

    if (!message || typeof message !== "string" || !message.trim()) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Message content is required and cannot be empty"
        );
    }

    if (attachments !== undefined && !Array.isArray(attachments)) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Attachments must be an array of file URLs"
        );
    }

    next();
};

// Validates conversation ID parameter
const validateConversationIdParam = (req, res, next) => {
    const { id } = req.params;

    if (!id || !mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(id)) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Valid conversation ID is required"
        );
    }

    next();
};

// Validates query parameters for fetching conversations list
const validateGetConversationsQuery = (req, res, next) => {
    const { page, limit } = req.query;

    if (page !== undefined) {
        const parsedPage = Number(page);
        if (!Number.isInteger(parsedPage) || parsedPage < 1) {
            throw createApiError(
                400,
                "Page must be a valid positive integer"
            );
        }
    }

    if (limit !== undefined) {
        const parsedLimit = Number(limit);
        if (!Number.isInteger(parsedLimit) || parsedLimit < 1) {
            throw createApiError(
                400,
                "Limit must be a valid positive integer"
            );
        }
    }

    next();
};

export {
    validateSendMessage,
    validateConversationIdParam,
    validateGetConversationsQuery
};
```

```jsx
"use client";

import React from "react";

function CloseIcon({ className = "w-5 h-5" }) {
  return (
    <svg className={className} fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.75}>
      <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12" />
    </svg>
  );
}

const formatPrice = (amount, currency = "INR") => {
  const numericAmount = Number(amount);
  if (!Number.isFinite(numericAmount) || numericAmount < 0) return "N/A";
  const symbol = currency === "INR" ? "₹" : `${currency} `;
  return `${symbol}${new Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN").format(numericAmount)}`;
};

const formatDateTime = (dateString) => {
  if (!dateString) return "N/A";
  try {
    const d = new Date(dateString);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return "N/A";
    return d.toLocaleString("en-IN", {
      day: "numeric",
      month: "short",
      year: "numeric",
      hour: "2-digit",
      minute: "2-digit",
    });
  } catch {
    return "N/A";
  }
};

const getStatusBadge = (status) => {
  const norm = (status || "").toLowerCase();
  switch (norm) {
    case "paid":
      return { label: "Paid", color: "bg-transparent text-emerald-500 border border-emerald-500/30" };
    case "completed":
      return { label: "Completed", color: "bg-transparent text-emerald-500 border border-emerald-500/30" };
    case "pending":
      return { label: "Pending", color: "bg-transparent text-amber-500 border border-amber-500/30" };
    case "processing":
      return { label: "Processing", color: "bg-transparent text-purple-500 border border-purple-500/30" };
    case "failed":
      return { label: "Failed", color: "bg-transparent text-red-500 border border-red-500/30" };
    default:
      return { label: status || "Unknown", color: "bg-transparent text-text-secondary border border-border-theme" };
  }
};
```

```jsx
        bg: "bg-transparent",
        text: "text-red-700 dark:text-red-400",
        border: "border-red-500/30 dark:border-red-500/30",
        iconType: "failed",
      };
    default:
      return {
        label: (status || "UNKNOWN").toUpperCase(),
        bg: "bg-transparent",
        text: "text-neutral-700 dark:text-neutral-300",
        border: "border-neutral-400/30 dark:border-neutral-500/30",
        iconType: "default",
      };
  }
};

const getCampaignInitials = (title) => {
  if (title && typeof title === "string" && title.trim()) {
    const words = title.trim().split(/\s+/);
    if (words.length >= 2) {
      return (words[0][0] + words[1][0]).toUpperCase();
    }
    return words[0].slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
  }
  return "CP";
};

function CampaignAvatar({ image, title }) {
  const [failedUrl, setFailedUrl] = useState(null);

  const initials = getCampaignInitials(title);
  const isImageValid = Boolean(image && typeof image === "string" && image.trim() && failedUrl !== image);

  if (isImageValid) {
    return (
      <div className="w-10 h-10 sm:w-11 sm:h-11 rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-secondary/10 dark:bg-secondary/15 shrink-0 border border-neutral-200/60 dark:border-border-theme">
        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
        <img
          src={image}
          alt={title || "Campaign"}
          onError={() => setFailedUrl(image)}
          className="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-300 ease-out hover:scale-[1.08] motion-reduce:transform-none motion-reduce:transition-none"
        />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div
      aria-label={title || "Campaign avatar"}
      className="w-10 h-10 sm:w-11 sm:h-11 rounded-xl bg-secondary/10 dark:bg-secondary/15 text-neutral-950 dark:text-white flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 border border-neutral-200/60 dark:border-border-theme font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm tracking-wide select-none"
    >
      {initials}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function CreatorPaymentsManager() {
  const dispatch = useDispatch();
  const { payments, pagination, loading, error } = useSelector(
    (state) => state.creatorPayments
  );

  const [mobileOpen, setMobileOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedStatus, setSelectedStatus] = useState("all");
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [selectedPaymentDetail, setSelectedPaymentDetail] = useState(null);
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const params = {
      page: currentPage,
      limit: 10,
    };
    if (selectedStatus !== "all") {
      params.status = selectedStatus;
    }
    dispatch(fetchCreatorPayments(params));
  }, [dispatch, currentPage, selectedStatus]);

  const handleRefresh = () => {
    const params = {
      page: currentPage,
      limit: 10,
    };
    if (selectedStatus !== "all") {
      params.status = selectedStatus;
    }
    dispatch(fetchCreatorPayments(params));
  };

  const handleStatusFilterChange = (status) => {
    setSelectedStatus(status);
    setCurrentPage(1);
  };

  const handleViewDetails = (payment) => {
    setSelectedPaymentDetail(payment);
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleCloseModal = () => {
    setIsModalOpen(false);
    setSelectedPaymentDetail(null);
  };

  // Calculate summary stats from current payments list
  const totalPaidAmount = payments
    .filter((p) => p.status === "paid" || p.status === "completed")
    .reduce((acc, p) => acc + (Number(p.amount) || 0), 0);

  const pendingCount = payments.filter((p) => p.status === "pending" || p.status === "processing").length;
  const hasTestModeRecord = payments.some((p) => p.isTestMode);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-background text-foreground flex flex-col font-sans">
      {/* Sidebar */}
      <CreatorSidebar mobileOpen={mobileOpen} setMobileOpen={setMobileOpen} />

      {/* Main Container Offset by Desktop Sidebar */}
      <div className="flex-1 lg:ml-64 flex flex-col min-w-0">
        {/* Header */}
        <CreatorHeader setMobileOpen={setMobileOpen} />

        {/* Main Content Area */}
        <main className="p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-6 flex-1 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto">
          {/* Header Section */}
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">

                </span>

              <h1 className="font-serif font-medium text-2xl sm:text-3xl text-foreground tracking-tight mt-1">

              </p>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleRefresh}
              disabled={loading}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl border border-border-theme bg-surface hover:bg-surface-muted text-foreground text-xs font-semibold transition-colors cursor-pointer self-start sm:self-auto disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              <RefreshIcon className={`w-4 h-4 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
              <span>Refresh</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Stats Summary Grid */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">

            {/* Pagination Controls */}
            {payments.length > 0 && (
              <div className="px-6 py-4 border-t border-neutral-100 dark:border-border-theme/40 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs">
                {(() => {
                  const totalRecords = pagination?.totalItems ?? payments.length;
                  const currentPageNum = pagination?.page || pagination?.currentPage || currentPage || 1;
                  const totalPages = pagination?.totalPages || 1;
                  const limit = pagination?.limit || 10;
                  const startRecord = totalRecords === 0 ? 0 : (currentPageNum - 1) * limit + 1;
                  const endRecord = Math.min(currentPageNum * limit, totalRecords);

                  return (

                      </span>

                          className="w-7 h-7 sm:w-8 sm:h-8 rounded-full border border-neutral-200/80 dark:border-border-theme bg-white dark:bg-surface hover:bg-neutral-50 dark:hover:bg-surface-muted text-neutral-700 dark:text-neutral-300 flex items-center justify-center transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed shadow-2xs"
                        >
                          <ChevronLeftIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />

                        <span className="w-7 h-7 sm:w-8 sm:h-8 rounded-full bg-neutral-950 text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-neutral-950 font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs">
                          {currentPageNum}
                        </span>

                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setCurrentPage((prev) => Math.min(prev + 1, totalPages))}
                          disabled={currentPageNum >= totalPages || loading}
                          aria-label="Next page"
                          className="w-7 h-7 sm:w-8 sm:h-8 rounded-full border border-neutral-200/80 dark:border-border-theme bg-white dark:bg-surface hover:bg-neutral-50 dark:hover:bg-surface-muted text-neutral-700 dark:text-neutral-300 flex items-center justify-center transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed shadow-2xs"
                        >
                          <ChevronRightIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </>
                  );
                })()}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </main>
      </div>

      {/* Payment Detail Modal */}
      <CreatorPaymentDetailModal
        isOpen={isModalOpen}
        onClose={handleCloseModal}
        payment={selectedPaymentDetail}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
import axiosInstance from "@/lib/axios";

// Creator fetches received payments list with optional pagination and status filter
const getCreatorPayments = async (params = {}) => {
    const response = await axiosInstance.get(
        "/creator/payments",
        { params }
    );
    return response.data;
};

// Creator fetches single received payment details by ID
const getCreatorPaymentById = async (paymentId) => {
    const response = await axiosInstance.get(
        `/creator/payments/${paymentId}`
    );
    return response.data;
};

export {
    getCreatorPayments,
    getCreatorPaymentById
};
```

```javascript
import {
    createAsyncThunk,
    createSlice
} from "@reduxjs/toolkit";

import {
    getCreatorPayments as getCreatorPaymentsApi,
    getCreatorPaymentById as getCreatorPaymentByIdApi
} from "./payments_api";

import {
    login,
    logout,
    clearAuth
} from "../../auth/auth_slice";

// Handles fetching received payments list for authenticated creator
const fetchCreatorPayments = createAsyncThunk(
    "creatorPayments/fetchCreatorPayments",
    async (params = {}, { rejectWithValue }) => {
        try {
            return await getCreatorPaymentsApi(params);
        } catch (error) {
            return rejectWithValue(
                error.response?.data?.message ||
                "Failed to fetch received payment history"
            );
        }
    }
);

// Handles fetching single received payment receipt details by ID
const fetchCreatorPaymentById = createAsyncThunk(
    "creatorPayments/fetchCreatorPaymentById",
    async (paymentId, { rejectWithValue }) => {
        try {
            return await getCreatorPaymentByIdApi(paymentId);
        } catch (error) {
            return rejectWithValue(
                error.response?.data?.message ||
                "Failed to fetch payment details"
            );
        }
    }
);

const initialState = {
    payments: [],
    selectedPayment: null,
    pagination: null,
    loading: false,
    detailLoading: false,
    error: null
};

const creatorPaymentsSlice = createSlice({
    name: "creatorPayments",
    initialState,
    reducers: {
        clearSelectedPayment: (state) => {
            state.selectedPayment = null;
        },
        clearPaymentState: (state) => {
            state.payments = [];
            state.selectedPayment = null;
            state.pagination = null;
            state.loading = false;
            state.detailLoading = false;
            state.error = null;
        },
        clearPaymentError: (state) => {
            state.error = null;
        }
    },
    extraReducers: (builder) => {
        builder
            // Fetch Creator Payments List
            .addCase(fetchCreatorPayments.pending, (state) => {
                state.loading = true;
                state.error = null;
            })
            .addCase(fetchCreatorPayments.fulfilled, (state, action) => {
                state.loading = false;
                state.payments = action.payload?.data?.payments || [];
                state.pagination = action.payload?.data?.pagination || null;
                state.error = null;
            })
            .addCase(fetchCreatorPayments.rejected, (state, action) => {
                state.loading = false;
                state.error = action.payload;
            })

            // Fetch Creator Payment By ID
            .addCase(fetchCreatorPaymentById.pending, (state) => {
                state.detailLoading = true;
                state.error = null;
            })
            .addCase(fetchCreatorPaymentById.fulfilled, (state, action) => {
                state.detailLoading = false;
                state.selectedPayment = action.payload?.data || null;
                state.error = null;
            })
            .addCase(fetchCreatorPaymentById.rejected, (state, action) => {
                state.detailLoading = false;
                state.error = action.payload;
            })

            // Clear state on auth events
            .addCase(login.fulfilled, (state) => {
                state.payments = [];

                state.pagination = null;
                state.loading = false;
                state.detailLoading = false;
                state.error = null;
            })

                state.payments = [];
                state.selectedPayment = null;
                state.pagination = null;
                state.loading = false;
                state.detailLoading = false;
                state.error = null;
            })
            .addCase(clearAuth, (state) => {
                state.payments = [];
                state.selectedPayment = null;
                state.pagination = null;

                state.detailLoading = false;
                state.error = null;
            });
    }
});
```

```javascript
import mongoose from "mongoose";

const paymentSchema = new mongoose.Schema(
    {
        // Reference to the workspace associated with this payment.
        workspace: {
            type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,
            ref: "Workspace",
            required: true
        },

        // Reference to the parent booking.
        booking: {
            type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,
            ref: "Booking",
            required: true
        },

        // Reference to the associated campaign.
        campaign: {
            type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,
            ref: "Campaign",
            required: true
        },

        // Auth._id of the brand making the payment.
        brand: {
            type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,
            ref: "Auth",
            required: true
        },

        // Auth._id of the creator receiving the payment context.
        creator: {
            type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,
            ref: "Auth",
            required: true
        },

        // Payment amount in major units (e.g. INR rupees).
        amount: {
            type: Number,
            required: true,
            min: 0
        },

        // Currency code.
        currency: {
            type: String,
            uppercase: true,
            trim: true,
            default: "INR",
            maxlength: 3
        },

        // Payment method used (e.g. RAZORPAY_TEST).
        paymentMethod: {
            type: String,
            trim: true,
            default: "RAZORPAY_TEST"
        },

        // Payment status.
        status: {
            type: String,
            enum: [
                "pending",
                "processing",
                "paid",
                "completed",
                "failed",
                "refunded",
                "cancelled"
            ],
            default: "pending"
        },

        // Flag indicating active payment lock/reservation (used for database-enforced unique partial indexing)
        isActive: {
            type: Boolean,
            default: true
        },

        // Razorpay order ID (e.g., order_P1234567890).
        razorpayOrderId: {
            type: String,
            trim: true,
            default: ""
        },

        // Razorpay payment ID (e.g., pay_P1234567890).
        razorpayPaymentId: {
            type: String,
            trim: true,
            default: ""
        },

        // Internal / Gateway transaction reference ID.
        transactionId: {
            type: String,
            trim: true,
            default: ""
        },

        // Flag indicating test mode simulation (never treated as real money or real payout).
        isTestMode: {
            type: Boolean,
            default: true
        },

        // Timestamp when the payment was successfully captured/verified.
        paidAt: {
            type: Date
        }
    },
    {
        timestamps: true
    }
);

// Database-enforced atomic unique constraint: prevents concurrent active/paid payments for the same workspace
paymentSchema.index(
    { workspace: 1 },
    {
        unique: true,
        partialFilterExpression: { isActive: true }
    }
);

// Useful query indexes
paymentSchema.index({ workspace: 1, status: 1 });
paymentSchema.index({ razorpayOrderId: 1 });
paymentSchema.index({ razorpayPaymentId: 1 });
paymentSchema.index({ brand: 1, createdAt: -1 });
paymentSchema.index({ creator: 1, createdAt: -1 });

const Payment = mongoose.model("Payment", paymentSchema);

export default Payment;
```

```javascript
import crypto from "crypto";
import mongoose from "mongoose";
import Razorpay from "razorpay";

import Payment from "./payment.model.js";
import Workspace from "../workspace/workspace.model.js";
import { createNotificationSafe } from "../notifications/notification.service.js";
import createApiError from "../../utils/ApiError.js";
import {
    getPagination,
    getPaginationData
} from "../../utils/pagination.js";

// Helper function to initialize Razorpay SDK using backend environment variables
const getRazorpayInstance = () => {
    const key_id = process.env.RAZORPAY_KEY_ID;
    const key_secret = process.env.RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET;

    if (!key_id || !key_secret) {
        throw createApiError(
            500,
            "Razorpay configuration missing on backend server. Please set RAZORPAY_KEY_ID and RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET in environment."
        );
    }

    if (!key_id.startsWith("rzp_test_")) {
        throw createApiError(
            500,
            "Razorpay integration is restricted to Test Mode. RAZORPAY_KEY_ID must start with 'rzp_test_'."
        );
    }

    return new Razorpay({
        key_id,
        key_secret
    });
};

// Helper function to verify HMAC SHA-256 signature for Razorpay checkout callback
const verifyRazorpaySignature = ({ razorpay_order_id, razorpay_payment_id, razorpay_signature }) => {
    const key_secret = process.env.RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET;
    if (!key_secret) {
        throw createApiError(
            500,
            "Razorpay configuration missing on backend server. Please set RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET in environment."
        );
    }

    const payload = `${razorpay_order_id}|${razorpay_payment_id}`;
    const expectedSignature = crypto
        .createHmac("sha256", key_secret)
        .update(payload)
        .digest("hex");

    const expectedBuf = Buffer.from(expectedSignature, "utf-8");
    const actualBuf = Buffer.from(razorpay_signature, "utf-8");

    if (expectedBuf.length !== actualBuf.length) {
        return false;
    }

    return crypto.timingSafeEqual(expectedBuf, actualBuf);
};

// Creates a Razorpay Order for an approved/completed workspace by Brand
const createBrandPaymentOrderService = async (brandId, payload = {}) => {
    const { workspaceId } = payload;

    if (!workspaceId || !mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(workspaceId)) {
        throw createApiError(400, "Invalid or missing workspace ID");
    }

    // 1. Fetch workspace and verify brand ownership
    const workspace = await Workspace.findOne({
        _id: workspaceId,
        brand: brandId
    });

    if (!workspace) {
        throw createApiError(
            404,
            "Workspace not found or access denied"
        );
    }

    // 2. Enforce business rule: Payment is allowed ONLY when workspace is completed (all deliverables approved)
    if (workspace.status !== "completed") {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Payment is allowed only after all workspace deliverables are approved and the workspace is completed"
        );
    }

    // 3. Currency Validation: Explicitly enforce INR only
    const currency = (workspace.currency || "INR").toUpperCase();
    if (currency !== "INR") {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            `Unsupported payment currency '${currency}'. Only INR is supported for Razorpay Test Mode.`
        );
    }

    // 4. Server-side price retrieval & strict decimal precision validation (never trust client)
    const rawAmount = Number(workspace.agreedPrice);

    if (!Number.isFinite(rawAmount) || rawAmount <= 0) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Invalid or non-positive workspace price amount for payment processing"
        );
    }

    const paiseValue = rawAmount * 100;
    if (!Number.isInteger(Math.round(paiseValue)) || Math.abs(paiseValue - Math.round(paiseValue)) > 1e-6) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Payable amount cannot have more than two decimal places"
        );
    }

    const amount = rawAmount;
    const amountInPaise = Math.round(paiseValue);

    // 5. Initialize & validate Razorpay configuration BEFORE creating database reservation
    const razorpay = getRazorpayInstance();

    // 6. Pre-check: If an active payment already exists, check if it's completed, reusable, or stale
    const existingPayment = await Payment.findOne({
        workspace: workspaceId,
        isActive: true
    });

    if (existingPayment) {
        if (existingPayment.status === "paid") {
            throw createApiError(
                400,
                "Payment has already been successfully completed for this workspace"
            );
        }

        // Reuse an existing valid pending/processing payment record & Razorpay Order ID if present
        if (
            existingPayment.status === "pending" ||
            existingPayment.status === "processing"
        ) {
            if (existingPayment.razorpayOrderId) {
                const existingCurrency = (existingPayment.currency || "").trim().toUpperCase();
                const isCurrencyMatch = existingCurrency === currency;

                const existingRawAmount = Number(existingPayment.amount);
                const isFinitePositive = Number.isFinite(existingRawAmount) && existingRawAmount > 0;
                const existingPaiseVal = existingRawAmount * 100;
                const isValidDecimalPrecision =
                    isFinitePositive &&
                    Number.isInteger(Math.round(existingPaiseVal)) &&
                    Math.abs(existingPaiseVal - Math.round(existingPaiseVal)) <= 1e-6;

                const existingPaise = isValidDecimalPrecision ? Math.round(existingPaiseVal) : null;
                const isAmountMatch = existingPaise !== null && existingPaise === amountInPaise;

                if (!isCurrencyMatch || !isAmountMatch) {
                    throw createApiError(
                        400,
                        "Active payment order amount or currency does not match current workspace price. Active reservation preserved for administrative review."
                    );
                }

                return {
                    payment: existingPayment,
                    razorpayOrder: {
                        id: existingPayment.razorpayOrderId,
                        amount: existingPaise,
                        currency: existingPayment.currency
                    },
                    keyId: process.env.RAZORPAY_KEY_ID
                };
            }

            // An active reservation exists but razorpayOrderId is not yet saved/available.
            // Never release or mark failed based on time alone. Preserve the active reservation safely.
            throw createApiError(
                400,
                "A payment reservation is currently active for this workspace, but the order ID is not yet confirmed. Please check existing payment records."
            );
        }
    }

    // 7. Atomic Reservation: Attempt to create the Payment document in MongoDB FIRST to acquire the unique database lock
    let paymentReservation;
    try {
        paymentReservation = await Payment.create({
            workspace: workspace._id,
            booking: workspace.booking,
            campaign: workspace.campaign,
            brand: brandId,
            creator: workspace.creator,
            amount: amount,
            currency: currency,
            paymentMethod: "RAZORPAY_TEST",
            status: "pending",
            isActive: true,
            razorpayOrderId: "",
            transactionId: "",
            isTestMode: true
        });
    } catch (dbError) {
        if (dbError.code === 11000 || dbError?.message?.includes("E11000")) {
            const activePayment = await Payment.findOne({ workspace: workspaceId, isActive: true });
            if (activePayment?.status === "paid") {
                throw createApiError(400, "Payment has already been successfully completed for this workspace");
            }
            throw createApiError(400, "A payment process or order is already active for this workspace");
        }
        console.error("Database Payment Reservation Error:", dbError?.message || dbError);
        throw createApiError(500, "Failed to reserve payment slot in database");
    }

    // 8. Create Razorpay Order at Gateway
    const shortId = workspaceId.toString().slice(-8);
    const timeSnippet = Date.now().toString().slice(-6);
    const receipt = `rcpt_${shortId}_${timeSnippet}`;

    let razorpayOrder;
    try {
        razorpayOrder = await razorpay.orders.create({
            amount: amountInPaise,
            currency: currency,
            receipt: receipt,
            notes: {
                workspaceId: workspaceId.toString(),
                brandId: brandId.toString(),
                bookingId: workspace.booking.toString()
            }
        });
    } catch (gatewayErr) {
        console.error("Razorpay Order Creation Error:", gatewayErr?.message || gatewayErr);
        
        const statusCode = Number(gatewayErr?.statusCode);
        const errorCode = gatewayErr?.error?.code;

        // Definitive payload rejections: Confirmed Razorpay API response (HTTP 400/422 with BAD_REQUEST_ERROR)
        // indicating Razorpay API explicitly validated and rejected the payload before order creation.
        const isDefinitiveFailure =
            (statusCode === 400 || statusCode === 422) &&
            errorCode === "BAD_REQUEST_ERROR";

        if (isDefinitiveFailure) {
            paymentReservation.status = "failed";
            paymentReservation.isActive = false;
            await paymentReservation.save().catch(() => {});
        } else {
            // Ambiguous outcome (network timeout, connection drop, 5xx server error, rate limit, missing/unverified error code):
            // Preserve active reservation in 'processing' status to prevent creating duplicate orders blindly.
            paymentReservation.status = "processing";
            paymentReservation.isActive = true;
            await paymentReservation.save().catch(() => {});
        }

        throw createApiError(
            502,
            `Failed to create Razorpay Order: ${gatewayErr?.error?.description || gatewayErr?.message || "Gateway error"}`
        );
    }

    // 9. Update Payment record with the real Razorpay Order ID
    try {
        paymentReservation.razorpayOrderId = razorpayOrder.id;
        paymentReservation.transactionId = razorpayOrder.id;
        await paymentReservation.save();
    } catch (updateErr) {
        console.error("Failed to update Payment record with Razorpay Order ID:", updateErr?.message || updateErr);
        
        try {
            paymentReservation.status = "processing";
            paymentReservation.isActive = true;
            await paymentReservation.save();
        } catch (preserveErr) {
            // Ignore secondary save error
        }

        throw createApiError(
            500,
            `Razorpay order (${razorpayOrder.id}) was created successfully, but saving order reference to database failed. The active reservation has been preserved for recovery.`
        );
    }

    return {
        payment: paymentReservation,
        razorpayOrder: {
            id: razorpayOrder.id,
            amount: razorpayOrder.amount,
            currency: razorpayOrder.currency
        },
        keyId: process.env.RAZORPAY_KEY_ID
    };
};

// Gets paginated payments for authenticated Brand
const getBrandPaymentsService = async (brandId, query = {}) => {
    const { page = 1, limit = 10, status, workspace } = query;
    const { page: currentPage, limit: itemsPerPage, skip } = getPagination(page, limit);

    const filter = { brand: brandId };
    if (status && status.trim()) {
        const normStatus = status.trim().toLowerCase();
        if (normStatus === "paid" || normStatus === "completed") {
            filter.status = { $in: ["paid", "completed"] };
        } else {
            filter.status = status.trim();
        }
    }
    if (workspace && mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(workspace.toString().trim())) {
        filter.workspace = workspace.toString().trim();
    }

    const [payments, totalItems] = await Promise.all([
        Payment.find(filter)
            .populate("creator", "name email")
            .populate("campaign", "title category budget platform coverImage")
            .populate("workspace", "status agreedPrice deadline")
            .sort({ createdAt: -1 })
            .skip(skip)
            .limit(itemsPerPage),
        Payment.countDocuments(filter)
    ]);

    return {
        payments,
        pagination: getPaginationData(currentPage, itemsPerPage, totalItems)
    };
};

// Verifies Razorpay Payment Signature and updates status for authenticated Brand
const verifyBrandPaymentService = async (brandId, payload = {}) => {
    const {
        razorpay_order_id,
        razorpay_payment_id,
        razorpay_signature
    } = payload;

    if (
        typeof razorpay_order_id !== "string" ||
        typeof razorpay_payment_id !== "string" ||
        typeof razorpay_signature !== "string"
    ) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Invalid or missing required Razorpay callback parameters. Order ID, payment ID, and signature must be non-empty strings."
        );
    }

    const orderId = razorpay_order_id.trim();
    const paymentIdVal = razorpay_payment_id.trim();
    const signature = razorpay_signature.trim();

    if (!orderId || !paymentIdVal || !signature) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Missing required fields: razorpay_order_id, razorpay_payment_id, and razorpay_signature are required."
        );
    }

    // 1. Exact lookup: Find payment record owned by authenticated brand with exact razorpayOrderId
    const payment = await Payment.findOne({
        brand: brandId,
        razorpayOrderId: orderId
    });

    if (!payment) {
        throw createApiError(
            404,
            "Payment record not found for the provided Razorpay Order ID and brand"
        );
    }

    // Confirm brand ownership
    if (payment.brand.toString() !== brandId.toString()) {
        throw createApiError(
            403,
            "Access denied: payment record does not belong to authenticated brand"
        );
    }

    // 2. Idempotency Check: Strict AND condition for already paid payments
    if (payment.status === "paid") {
        const isMatch =
            payment.razorpayOrderId === orderId &&
            payment.razorpayPaymentId === paymentIdVal;

        if (isMatch) {
            return {
                message: "Payment has already been successfully verified and marked as paid",
                payment
            };
        } else {
            throw createApiError(
                400,
                "Payment has already been completed with a different payment or order reference"
            );
        }
    }

    // 3. Signature Verification using HMAC SHA-256 with timingSafeEqual
    const isSignatureValid = verifyRazorpaySignature({
        razorpay_order_id: orderId,
        razorpay_payment_id: paymentIdVal,
        razorpay_signature: signature
    });

    if (!isSignatureValid) {
        // SECURITY FIX: Never release active reservation or mark failed on invalid signature submission
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Invalid Razorpay payment signature. Verification failed."
        );
    }

    // 4. Trusted Server-side Payment Verification with Razorpay API
    const razorpay = getRazorpayInstance();
    let fetchedPayment;
    try {
        fetchedPayment = await razorpay.payments.fetch(paymentIdVal);
    } catch (fetchErr) {
        console.error("Razorpay Payment Fetch Error:", fetchErr?.message || fetchErr);
        // Do NOT mark failed on gateway fetch error or network timeout. Preserve reservation for manual reconciliation.
        throw createApiError(
            502,
            `Failed to verify payment with Razorpay gateway: ${fetchErr?.error?.description || fetchErr?.message || "Gateway fetch error"}`
        );
    }

    if (!fetchedPayment) {
        throw createApiError(
            502,
            "Failed to retrieve payment details from Razorpay gateway"
        );
    }

    // Verify fetched Razorpay payment details against stored record
    const fetchedOrderId = (fetchedPayment.order_id || "").trim();
    const fetchedStatus = (fetchedPayment.status || "").toLowerCase();
    const fetchedCurrency = (fetchedPayment.currency || "").trim().toUpperCase();
    const fetchedAmountInPaise = Number(fetchedPayment.amount);

    const expectedPaise = Math.round(Number(payment.amount) * 100);

    const isOrderMatch = fetchedOrderId === orderId && fetchedOrderId === payment.razorpayOrderId;
    const isCurrencyMatch = fetchedCurrency === (payment.currency || "INR").trim().toUpperCase();
    const isAmountMatch = fetchedAmountInPaise === expectedPaise;

    if (!isOrderMatch || !isCurrencyMatch || !isAmountMatch) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Razorpay payment verification failed: order ID, amount, or currency mismatch."
        );
    }

    // Accept ONLY 'captured' status as paid. Do NOT treat 'authorized' as paid!
    if (fetchedStatus !== "captured") {
        if (fetchedStatus === "failed") {
            // Atomically mark failed and release lock only if payment is not already paid
            const failedPayment = await Payment.findOneAndUpdate(
                {
                    _id: payment._id,
                    status: { $ne: "paid" }
                },
                {
                    $set: {
                        status: "failed",
                        isActive: false,
                        razorpayPaymentId: paymentIdVal,
                        transactionId: payment.transactionId || paymentIdVal
                    }
                },
                { new: true }
            );

            if (!failedPayment) {
                const recheck = await Payment.findById(payment._id);

                if (recheck?.status === "paid") {
                    throw createApiError(
                        400,
                        "Payment has already been successfully verified and completed. Cannot mark a completed payment as failed."
                    );
                }

                if (recheck?.status === "failed") {
                    throw createApiError(400, "Payment failed at Razorpay checkout");
                }

                if (!recheck) {
                    throw createApiError(404, "Payment record not found");
                }

                throw createApiError(400, "Failed to update payment status");
            }

            throw createApiError(400, "Payment failed at Razorpay checkout");
        } else {
            // Status is 'authorized', 'created', etc. Preserve reservation in non-paid state.
            throw createApiError(
                400,
                `Payment status is '${fetchedStatus}' at Razorpay gateway. Payment must be captured to be marked as paid.`
            );
        }
    }

    // 5. Atomic state update to 'paid' status to prevent concurrent request race conditions
    const updatedPayment = await Payment.findOneAndUpdate(
        {
            _id: payment._id,
            status: { $ne: "paid" }
        },
        {
            $set: {
                razorpayOrderId: orderId,
                razorpayPaymentId: paymentIdVal,
                transactionId: paymentIdVal,
                status: "paid",
                isActive: true, // Keep isActive = true so partial unique index permanently blocks duplicate active payments
                paidAt: payment.paidAt || new Date(),
                isTestMode: true
            }
        },
        { new: true }
    );

    if (!updatedPayment) {
        const recheck = await Payment.findById(payment._id);

        if (recheck?.status === "paid") {
            const isMatch =
                recheck.razorpayOrderId === orderId &&
                recheck.razorpayPaymentId === paymentIdVal;

            if (isMatch) {
                return {
                    message: "Payment has already been successfully verified and marked as paid",
                    payment: recheck
                };
            }

            throw createApiError(
                400,
                "Payment has already been completed with a different payment or order reference"
            );
        }

        throw createApiError(400, "Failed to update payment status");
    }

    await createNotificationSafe({
        recipient: updatedPayment.creator,
        sender: brandId,
        type: "payment:received",
        title: "Payment Received!",
        message: `You received a payment of ₹${updatedPayment.amount} for your collaboration!`,
        entityType: "payment",
        entityId: updatedPayment._id,
        destination: "/creator/payments",
        metadata: {
            paymentId: updatedPayment._id,
            amount: updatedPayment.amount,
            currency: updatedPayment.currency,
            workspaceId: updatedPayment.workspace
        },
        idempotencyKey: `payment:received:${updatedPayment._id}`
    });

    return {
        message: "Payment successfully verified and completed",
        payment: updatedPayment
    };
};

// Reports and verifies a failed Razorpay payment attempt via Razorpay API and updates status to 'failed'
const reportBrandPaymentFailureService = async (brandId, payload = {}) => {
    const {
        razorpay_order_id,
        razorpay_payment_id
    } = payload;

    if (
        typeof razorpay_order_id !== "string" ||
        typeof razorpay_payment_id !== "string"
    ) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Invalid or missing required Razorpay order ID or payment ID"
        );
    }

    const orderId = razorpay_order_id.trim();
    const paymentIdVal = razorpay_payment_id.trim();

    if (!orderId || !paymentIdVal) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Missing required fields: razorpay_order_id and razorpay_payment_id are required"
        );
    }

    // 1. Find MongoDB Payment document for authenticated brand by razorpayOrderId
    const payment = await Payment.findOne({
        brand: brandId,
        razorpayOrderId: orderId
    });

    if (!payment) {
        throw createApiError(
            404,
            "Payment record not found for the provided Razorpay Order ID and brand"
        );
    }

    // Confirm brand ownership
    if (payment.brand.toString() !== brandId.toString()) {
        throw createApiError(
            403,
            "Access denied: payment record does not belong to authenticated brand"
        );
    }

    // Idempotency Checks
    if (payment.status === "failed") {
        return {
            message: "Payment is already marked as failed",
            payment
        };
    }

    if (payment.status === "paid") {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Payment has already been successfully verified and completed. Cannot mark a completed payment as failed."
        );
    }

    // 2. Server-side Gateway Verification with Razorpay API (never trust client input alone)
    const razorpay = getRazorpayInstance();
    let fetchedPayment;
    try {
        fetchedPayment = await razorpay.payments.fetch(paymentIdVal);
    } catch (fetchErr) {
        console.error("Razorpay Payment Fetch Error during failure report:", fetchErr?.message || fetchErr);
        throw createApiError(
            502,
            `Failed to verify payment status with Razorpay gateway: ${fetchErr?.error?.description || fetchErr?.message || "Gateway error"}`
        );
    }

    if (!fetchedPayment) {
        throw createApiError(
            502,
            "Failed to retrieve payment details from Razorpay gateway"
        );
    }

    const fetchedOrderId = (fetchedPayment.order_id || "").trim();
    const fetchedStatus = (fetchedPayment.status || "").toLowerCase();

    if (fetchedOrderId !== orderId) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Razorpay payment verification failed: order ID mismatch"
        );
    }

    if (fetchedStatus !== "failed") {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            `Razorpay gateway reports payment status as '${fetchedStatus}', not 'failed'. Payment status was not updated.`
        );
    }

    // 3. Atomic conditional update to 'failed' status to prevent overwriting concurrent 'paid' status
    const updatedPayment = await Payment.findOneAndUpdate(
        {
            _id: payment._id,
            status: { $ne: "paid" }
        },
        {
            $set: {
                status: "failed",
                isActive: false, // Release active lock so brand can re-attempt payment
                razorpayPaymentId: paymentIdVal,
                transactionId: payment.transactionId || paymentIdVal
            }
        },
        { new: true }
    );

    // If update returned null, the status was modified concurrently (e.g. marked 'paid' or 'failed')
    if (!updatedPayment) {
        const recheck = await Payment.findById(payment._id);

        if (recheck?.status === "paid") {
            throw createApiError(
                400,
                "Payment has already been successfully verified and completed. Cannot mark a completed payment as failed."
            );
        }

        if (recheck?.status === "failed") {
            return {
                message: "Payment is already marked as failed",
                payment: recheck
            };
        }

        throw createApiError(400, "Failed to update payment status");
    }

    await createNotificationSafe({
        recipient: brandId,
        sender: null,
        type: "payment:failed",
        title: "Payment Attempt Failed",
        message: `Your payment attempt of ₹${updatedPayment.amount} was not successful. Please re-attempt from your Payments dashboard.`,
        entityType: "payment",
        entityId: updatedPayment._id,
        destination: "/brand/payments",
        metadata: {
            paymentId: updatedPayment._id,
            amount: updatedPayment.amount,
            currency: updatedPayment.currency,
            workspaceId: updatedPayment.workspace
        },
        idempotencyKey: `payment:failed:${updatedPayment._id}:${paymentIdVal || updatedPayment.razorpayOrderId || updatedPayment._id}`
    });

    return {
        message: "Payment status updated to failed based on gateway verification",
        payment: updatedPayment
    };
};

export {
    createBrandPaymentOrderService,
    verifyBrandPaymentService,
    reportBrandPaymentFailureService,
    getBrandPaymentsService,
    getBrandPaymentByIdService,
    getCreatorPaymentsService,
    getCreatorPaymentByIdService
};
```

```jsx
// =========================================================
// HELPER UTILITIES
// =========================================================
const formatPrice = (amount, currency = "INR") => {
  const numericAmount = Number(amount);
  if (!Number.isFinite(numericAmount) || numericAmount < 0) return null;
  const symbol = currency === "INR" ? "₹" : `${currency} `;
  return `${symbol}${new Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN").format(numericAmount)}`;
};

const formatDate = (dateString) => {
  if (!dateString) return "N/A";
  try {
    const d = new Date(dateString);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return "N/A";
    const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
    const month = d.toLocaleDateString("en-IN", { month: "short" });
    const year = d.getFullYear();
    return `${day} ${month} ${year}`;
  } catch {
    return "N/A";
  }
};

const formatMonthYear = (dateString) => {
  if (!dateString) return "N/A";
  try {
    const d = new Date(dateString);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return "N/A";
    const month = d.toLocaleDateString("en-IN", { month: "short" });
    const year = d.getFullYear();
    return `${month} ${year}`;
  } catch {
    return "N/A";
  }
};

const getInitials = (name) => {
  if (name && typeof name === "string" && name.trim()) {
    const parts = name.trim().split(/\s+/);
    if (parts.length >= 2) {
      return (parts[0][0] + parts[parts.length - 1][0]).toUpperCase();
    }
    return parts[0][0].toUpperCase();
  }
  return "BP";
};

  const currentPageReviewCount = reviews?.length || 0;

                >
```
