              </span>
              <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2 pt-0.5">
                <span className="font-sans font-semibold text-[22px] sm:text-[28px] text-amber-500 tracking-tight">
                  {avgRatingValue > 0 ? avgRatingValue.toFixed(1) : "0.0"}
                </span>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 text-amber-400">
                  {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((star) => (
                    <StarIcon
                      key={star}
                      className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400"
                      filled={star <= Math.round(avgRatingValue)}
                    />
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Decorative mini bar graphic on right */}
              <div className="hidden xl:flex items-end gap-1 h-8 shrink-0 opacity-60" aria-hidden="true">
                <span className="w-1.5 h-3 rounded-full bg-neutral-200 dark:bg-neutral-700" />
                <span className="w-1.5 h-5 rounded-full bg-neutral-200 dark:bg-neutral-700" />
                <span className="w-1.5 h-7 rounded-full bg-neutral-200 dark:bg-neutral-700" />
                <span className="w-1.5 h-9 rounded-full bg-neutral-300 dark:bg-neutral-600" />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* 2. Total Reviews */}
            <div className="bg-surface border border-border-theme p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-2xl shadow-xs space-y-1">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-secondary uppercase tracking-wider block">
                Total Received Reviews
              </span>
              <span className="font-sans font-semibold text-[22px] sm:text-[28px] text-foreground tracking-tight block pt-0.5">
                {totalReviewsCount}
              </span>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-text-secondary block">
                Verified brand client endorsements
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* 3. Page 5-Star Share */}
            <div className="bg-surface border border-border-theme p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-2xl shadow-xs space-y-1">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-secondary uppercase tracking-wider block">
                Page 5-Star Share
              </span>
              <span className="font-sans font-semibold text-[22px] sm:text-[28px] text-emerald-500 tracking-tight block pt-0.5">
                {currentPageReviewCount > 0 ? `${currentPageFiveStarPercentage}%` : "0%"}
              </span>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-text-secondary block">
                5-star reviews on current page
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Rating Filter Tabs */}
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-surface border border-neutral-200/80 dark:border-border-theme rounded-2xl p-2 sm:p-2.5 shadow-xs flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-2.5 overflow-x-auto custom-scrollbar py-3">
            {[
              { id: "all", label: "All Reviews" },
              { id: "5", label: "5 Stars Only" },
              { id: "4", label: "4 Stars Only" },
              { id: "3", label: "3 Stars Only" },
            ].map((tab) => {
              const isActive = ratingFilter === tab.id;
             const count =
  tab.id === "all"
    ? totalReviewsCount
    : (reviews || []).filter(
        (review) => Number(review.rating) === Number(tab.id)
      ).length;

              return (
                <button
                  key={tab.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleFilterChange(tab.id)}
                  className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2.5 px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs ${
                    isActive
                      ? "bg-neutral-950 text-white shadow-xs dark:bg-white dark:text-neutral-950"
                      : "bg-neutral-100/90 dark:bg-surface-muted text-neutral-800 dark:text-neutral-200 hover:bg-neutral-200/70 hover:text-neutral-950 dark:hover:text-white"
                  }`}
                >
                  <span>{tab.label}</span>
                  <span
                    className={`inline-flex items-center justify-center min-w-[20px] h-5 px-1.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold tabular-nums leading-none ${
                      isActive
                        ? "bg-neutral-700/70 text-white dark:bg-neutral-200 dark:text-neutral-950"
                        : "bg-white dark:bg-surface text-neutral-700 dark:text-neutral-300 border border-neutral-200/70 dark:border-border-theme shadow-2xs"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {count}
                  </span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {/* Reviews Content Area */}
          {loading ? (
            /* Loading Skeleton */
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5 sm:gap-6 animate-pulse">
              {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((i) => (
                <div
                  key={i}
                  className="h-80 bg-surface-muted/60 rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl border border-border-theme/40"
                />
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : filteredReviews.length === 0 ? (
            /* Empty State */
            <div className="bg-surface border border-border-theme rounded-2xl p-12 text-center space-y-3 shadow-xs">
              <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-secondary/10 text-secondary flex items-center justify-center mx-auto border border-secondary/20">
                <StarIcon className="w-7 h-7 text-secondary" filled={true} />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <h3 className="font-sans font-semibold text-lg text-foreground tracking-tight">
                  No Client Reviews Found
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-text-secondary max-w-sm mx-auto leading-relaxed">
                  {ratingFilter === "all"
                    ? "You haven't received any client reviews yet. Once brands complete collaboration workspaces with you and submit their ratings, reviews will appear here."
                    : `No reviews match the ${ratingFilter}-star filter.`}
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="pt-2">
                <Link
                  href="/creator/workspace"
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-secondary hover:bg-secondary-dark text-white text-xs font-semibold shadow-xs transition-all cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <span>View Active Workspaces</span>
                </Link>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            /* Reviews Card Grid */
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5 sm:gap-6">
              {filteredReviews.map((review) => {
                const brandName =
                  review.reviewer?.companyName ||
                  review.reviewer?.name ||
                  "Brand Partner";
                const initials = getInitials(brandName);
                const rawRating = Number(review.rating);
                const hasValidRating =
                  Number.isFinite(rawRating) && rawRating >= 1 && rawRating <= 5;
                const ratingNum = hasValidRating ? rawRating : null;
                const campaignTitle = review.campaign?.title || "Collaboration Campaign";
                const agreedPriceFormatted = formatPrice(
                  review.workspace?.agreedPrice,
                  review.workspace?.currency
                );
                const reviewDate = formatDate(review.createdAt);
                const monthYearDate = formatMonthYear(
                  review.workspace?.createdAt || review.createdAt
                );

                const coverImage =
                  review.campaign?.coverImage ||
                  review.campaign?.image ||
                  review.workspace?.coverImage ||
                  review.coverImage ||
                  null;

                const brandAvatar =
                  review.reviewer?.avatar ||
                  review.reviewer?.profileImage ||
                  review.reviewer?.logo ||
                  review.reviewer?.image ||
                  review.brandProfile?.logo ||
                  review.brand?.logo ||
                  null;

                const isVerified = Boolean(
                  review.reviewer?.isVerified ||
                  review.reviewer?.verified ||
                  review.brand?.isVerified
                );

                const targetWorkspaceId =
                  review.workspace?._id ||
                  (typeof review.workspace === "string" ? review.workspace : null);
                const workspaceHref = targetWorkspaceId
                  ? `/creator/workspace/${targetWorkspaceId}`
                  : "/creator/workspace";

                return (
                  <div
                    key={review._id}
                    className="bg-white dark:bg-surface border border-neutral-200/90 dark:border-border-theme rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl p-4 sm:p-5 flex flex-col justify-between shadow-2xs hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200"
                  >
                    <div className="space-y-3.5">
                      {/* Top Cover-Image Banner */}
                      <div className="h-28 sm:h-32 rounded-xl sm:rounded-2xl overflow-hidden relative border border-neutral-200/70 dark:border-border-theme/40 bg-pink-50 dark:bg-surface-muted group/banner">
                        {coverImage && !failedCoverUrls[review._id] ? (
                          /* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */
                          <img
                            src={coverImage}
                            alt={campaignTitle}
                            className="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-500 group-hover/banner:scale-105"
                            onError={() => setFailedCoverUrls((prev) => ({ ...prev, [review._id]: true }))}
                          />
                        ) : (
                          <div className="w-full h-full bg-gradient-to-br from-pink-50 via-rose-50 to-pink-100 dark:from-pink-950/20 dark:via-rose-950/15 dark:to-surface flex items-center justify-between px-4 sm:px-5 relative overflow-hidden">
                            {/* Ambient Graphic in Fallback Banner */}
                            <div className="absolute -right-8 -bottom-8 w-28 h-28 rounded-full bg-pink-200/40 dark:bg-pink-500/10 blur-xl pointer-events-none" />
                            <div className="min-w-0 pr-8">
                              <span className="font-serif font-bold tracking-wider text-base sm:text-lg text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-100 uppercase truncate block">
                                {brandName}
                              </span>
                              <span className="text-[10px] text-neutral-600 dark:text-neutral-400 tracking-wider font-sans uppercase mt-0.5 block truncate">
                                {campaignTitle}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        )}

                        {/* Top-Right Open/External Link Icon */}
                        <Link
                          href={workspaceHref}
                          title="Open workspace"
                          className="absolute top-2.5 right-2.5 w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-black/45 hover:bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-xs text-white/90 hover:text-white flex items-center justify-center transition-colors shadow-2xs cursor-pointer z-10"
                        >
                          <ExternalLinkIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </Link>
                      </div>

                      {/* Brand Info & Rating Row */}
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2.5 pt-0.5">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
                          {/* Brand Avatar */}
                          {brandAvatar ? (
                            /* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */
                            <img
                              src={brandAvatar}
                              alt={brandName}
                              onError={(e) => {
                                e.currentTarget.style.display = "none";
                                const fallback = e.currentTarget.parentElement?.querySelector(".avatar-fallback");
                                if (fallback) fallback.classList.remove("hidden");
                              }}
                              className="w-10 h-10 sm:w-11 sm:h-11 rounded-full object-cover border border-neutral-200 dark:border-neutral-700 shrink-0 shadow-2xs"
                            />
                          ) : null}
                          <div
                            className={`avatar-fallback w-10 h-10 sm:w-11 sm:h-11 rounded-full bg-neutral-950 dark:bg-neutral-800 text-white font-sans font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm flex items-center justify-center border border-neutral-200 dark:border-neutral-700 shrink-0 shadow-2xs uppercase tracking-wider ${
                              brandAvatar ? "hidden" : ""
                            }`}
                          >
                            {initials}
                          </div>

                          <div className="min-w-0">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                              <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm sm:text-base text-neutral-900 dark:text-white truncate">
                                {brandName}
                              </h3>
                              {isVerified && (
                                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-medium bg-transparent text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30 dark:border-emerald-500/30 leading-none">
                                  <CheckCircleIcon className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
                                  <span>Verified</span>
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                            <span className="text-xs text-neutral-500 dark:text-neutral-400 flex items-center gap-1 mt-0.5">
                              <CalendarIcon className="w-3 h-3 text-neutral-400 dark:text-neutral-500 shrink-0" />
                              <span>{reviewDate}</span>
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* Star Rating Badge */}
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-transparent px-2.5 py-1 sm:py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-amber-500/30 dark:border-amber-500/30 shrink-0">
                          <span className="font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 tabular-nums">
                            {hasValidRating ? ratingNum.toFixed(1) : "N/A"}
                          </span>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 text-amber-400 dark:text-amber-300">
                            {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((star) => (
                              <StarIcon
                                key={star}
                                className="w-3 h-3 sm:w-3.5 sm:h-3.5 text-amber-400 dark:text-amber-300"
                                filled={hasValidRating && star <= Math.round(ratingNum)}
                              />
                            ))}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Quotation Panel with Review Comment */}
                      <div className="bg-neutral-50/90 dark:bg-surface-muted/50 border border-neutral-200/60 dark:border-border-theme/60 rounded-xl sm:rounded-2xl p-3.5 sm:p-4 flex items-start gap-2.5">
                        <QuoteIcon className="w-4 h-4 text-neutral-400 dark:text-neutral-500 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                        <p className="text-xs sm:text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-neutral-700 dark:text-neutral-300 italic line-clamp-3">
                          {review.comment ? `“${review.comment}”` : "“No written review provided.”"}
                        </p>
                      </div>

                      {/* Compact Metadata Row */}
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 pt-0.5">
                        {/* Campaign Name */}
                        <div
                          title={campaignTitle}
                          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-neutral-200/70 dark:border-border-theme/70 bg-neutral-50/80 dark:bg-surface-muted/40 text-[11px] sm:text-xs font-medium text-neutral-700 dark:text-neutral-300 shadow-2xs"
                        >
                          <FolderIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-neutral-500 dark:text-neutral-400 shrink-0" />
                          <span className="truncate max-w-[130px] sm:max-w-[150px]">
                            {campaignTitle}
                          </span>
                        </div>

                        {/* Agreed Price / Currency */}
                        {agreedPriceFormatted && (
                          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-neutral-200/70 dark:border-border-theme/70 bg-neutral-50/80 dark:bg-surface-muted/40 text-[11px] sm:text-xs font-medium text-neutral-700 dark:text-neutral-300 shadow-2xs">
                            <CashIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-neutral-500 dark:text-neutral-400 shrink-0" />
                            <span>{agreedPriceFormatted}</span>
                          </div>
                        )}

                        {/* Relevant Date (Month & Year) */}
                        <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-neutral-200/70 dark:border-border-theme/70 bg-neutral-50/80 dark:bg-surface-muted/40 text-[11px] sm:text-xs font-medium text-neutral-700 dark:text-neutral-300 shadow-2xs">
                          <CalendarIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-neutral-500 dark:text-neutral-400 shrink-0" />
                          <span>{monthYearDate}</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Bottom Action Row: View workspace & 3-dot menu */}
                    <div className="mt-4 pt-3.5 border-t border-neutral-100 dark:border-border-theme/60 flex items-center justify-between relative">
                      <Link
                        href={workspaceHref}
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold text-neutral-900 dark:text-white hover:text-neutral-600 dark:hover:text-neutral-300 transition-colors group/link"
                      >
                        <span>View workspace</span>
                        <ArrowRightIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 sm:w-4 sm:h-4 text-neutral-900 dark:text-white transition-transform group-hover/link:translate-x-1" />
                      </Link>

                      {/* Three-Dot Menu Button with functional dropdown */}
                      <div className="relative">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          aria-label="Review actions"
                          aria-haspopup="true"
                          aria-expanded={activeMenuId === review._id}
                          onClick={() =>
                            setActiveMenuId((prev) => (prev === review._id ? null : review._id))
                          }
                          className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl border border-neutral-200/80 dark:border-border-theme bg-white dark:bg-surface hover:bg-neutral-100 dark:hover:bg-surface-muted text-neutral-600 dark:text-neutral-300 flex items-center justify-center transition-colors cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
                        >
                          <DotsHorizontalIcon className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </button>

                        {activeMenuId === review._id && (
                          <>
                            <div
                              className="fixed inset-0 z-20"
                              onClick={() => setActiveMenuId(null)}
                            />
                            <div className="absolute right-0 bottom-10 w-44 bg-white dark:bg-surface border border-neutral-200/80 dark:border-border-theme rounded-2xl shadow-lg p-1.5 z-30 font-sans text-xs space-y-0.5 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
                              <Link
                                href={workspaceHref}
                                onClick={() => setActiveMenuId(null)}
                                className="w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-neutral-700 dark:text-neutral-300 hover:text-foreground hover:bg-neutral-100 dark:hover:bg-surface-muted transition-colors text-left cursor-pointer"
                              >
                                <FolderIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-neutral-400" />
                                <span>Open Workspace</span>
                              </Link>
                              {review.comment && (
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={() => {
                                    setActiveMenuId(null);
                                    if (typeof navigator !== "undefined" && navigator.clipboard) {
                                      navigator.clipboard.writeText(review.comment);
                                    }
                                  }}
                                  className="w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-neutral-700 dark:text-neutral-300 hover:text-foreground hover:bg-neutral-100 dark:hover:bg-surface-muted transition-colors text-left cursor-pointer"
                                >
                                  <DocumentTextIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-neutral-400" />
                                  <span>Copy Review</span>
                                </button>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Pagination Controls */}
          {pagination && pagination.totalPages > 1 && (
            <div className="bg-surface border border-border-theme rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs text-text-secondary shadow-xs">
              <span>
                Showing page <strong className="text-foreground">{pagination.page}</strong> of{" "}
                <strong className="text-foreground">{pagination.totalPages}</strong> ({pagination.totalItems} total reviews)
              </span>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  disabled={pagination.page <= 1 || loading}
                  onClick={() => setCurrentPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-border-theme bg-surface hover:bg-surface-muted text-foreground font-medium disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <ChevronLeftIcon className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Previous</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  disabled={pagination.page >= pagination.totalPages || loading}
                  onClick={() => setCurrentPage((p) => p + 1)}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-border-theme bg-surface hover:bg-surface-muted text-foreground font-medium disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <span>Next</span>
                  <ChevronRightIcon className="w-4 h-4" />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </main>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

```javascript
import {
    createAsyncThunk,
    createSlice
} from "@reduxjs/toolkit";

import {
    getCreatorReviews as getCreatorReviewsApi
} from "./reviews_api";

import {
    login,
    logout,
    clearAuth
} from "../../auth/auth_slice";

// Handles fetching received reviews list for authenticated creator
const fetchCreatorReviews = createAsyncThunk(
    "creatorReviews/fetchCreatorReviews",
    async (params = {}, { rejectWithValue }) => {
        try {
            return await getCreatorReviewsApi(params);
        } catch (error) {
            return rejectWithValue(
                error.response?.data?.message ||
                "Failed to fetch creator reviews"
            );
        }
    }
);

const initialState = {
    reviews: [],
    stats: {
        totalReviews: 0,
        averageRating: 0
    },
    pagination: null,
    loading: false,
    error: null
};

const creatorReviewsSlice = createSlice({
    name: "creatorReviews",
    initialState,
    reducers: {
        clearReviewsState: (state) => {
            state.reviews = [];
            state.stats = {
                totalReviews: 0,
                averageRating: 0
            };
            state.pagination = null;
            state.loading = false;
            state.error = null;
        },
        clearReviewsError: (state) => {
            state.error = null;
        }
    },
    extraReducers: (builder) => {
        builder
            // Fetch Creator Reviews List
            .addCase(fetchCreatorReviews.pending, (state) => {
                state.loading = true;
                state.error = null;
            })
            .addCase(fetchCreatorReviews.fulfilled, (state, action) => {
                state.loading = false;
                state.reviews = action.payload?.data?.reviews || [];
                state.stats = action.payload?.data?.stats || {
                    totalReviews: 0,
                    averageRating: 0
                };
                state.pagination = action.payload?.data?.pagination || null;
                state.error = null;
            })
            .addCase(fetchCreatorReviews.rejected, (state, action) => {
                state.loading = false;
                state.error =
                    action.payload ||
                    action.error?.message ||
                    "Failed to fetch creator reviews";
            })

            // Clear state on auth events
            .addCase(login.fulfilled, (state) => {
                state.reviews = [];
                state.stats = {
                    totalReviews: 0,
                    averageRating: 0
                };
                state.pagination = null;
                state.loading = false;
                state.error = null;
            })
            .addCase(logout.fulfilled, (state) => {
                state.reviews = [];
                state.stats = {
                    totalReviews: 0,
                    averageRating: 0
                };
                state.pagination = null;
                state.loading = false;
                state.error = null;
            })
            .addCase(clearAuth, (state) => {
                state.reviews = [];
                state.stats = {
                    totalReviews: 0,
                    averageRating: 0
                };
                state.pagination = null;
                state.loading = false;
                state.error = null;
            });
    }
});

export const {
    clearReviewsState,
    clearReviewsError
} = creatorReviewsSlice.actions;

export {
    fetchCreatorReviews
};

export default creatorReviewsSlice.reducer;

import mongoose from "mongoose";

const reviewSchema = new mongoose.Schema(
    {
        // Reference to the workspace where collaboration took place
        workspace: {
            type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,
            ref: "Workspace",
            required: true
        },

        // Reference to the booking
        booking: {
            type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,
            ref: "Booking"
        },

        // Reference to the campaign
        campaign: {
            type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,
            ref: "Campaign"
        },

        // User giving the review (Brand or Creator)
        reviewer: {
            type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,
            ref: "Auth",
            required: true
        },

        // User receiving the review (Creator or Brand)
        reviewee: {
            type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,
            ref: "Auth",
            required: true
        },

        // Star rating from 1 to 5
        rating: {
            type: Number,
            required: true,
            min: 1,
            max: 5
        },

        // Detailed review text feedback
        comment: {
            type: String,
            trim: true,
            maxlength: 1000,
            default: ""
        }
    },
    {
        timestamps: true
    }
);

// Enforce at most one review per reviewer per workspace
reviewSchema.index({ workspace: 1, reviewer: 1 }, { unique: true });

// Optimize lookups for reviews given or received
reviewSchema.index({ reviewer: 1, createdAt: -1 });
reviewSchema.index({ reviewee: 1, createdAt: -1 });

const Review = mongoose.model("Review", reviewSchema);

export default Review;
```

import mongoose from "mongoose";
import Review from "./reviews.model.js";
import Workspace from "../workspace/workspace.model.js";
import BrandProfile from "../brand/profile/profile.model.js";
import Profile from "../creator/profile/profile.model.js";
import { createNotificationSafe } from "../notifications/notification.service.js";
import createApiError from "../../utils/ApiError.js";
import {
    getPagination,
    getPaginationData
} from "../../utils/pagination.js";

// Helper to enrich reviews with BrandProfile (logo, companyName) and Creator Profile (profileImage)
const attachReviewProfiles = async (reviews) => {
    if (!reviews) return reviews;
    const isSingle = !Array.isArray(reviews);
    const reviewList = isSingle ? [reviews] : reviews;
    if (reviewList.length === 0) return reviews;

    const userIds = new Set();
    reviewList.forEach((rev) => {
        const revObj = rev.toObject ? rev.toObject() : rev;
        const reviewerId = revObj.reviewer?._id || (typeof revObj.reviewer === "string" ? revObj.reviewer : null);
        const revieweeId = revObj.reviewee?._id || (typeof revObj.reviewee === "string" ? revObj.reviewee : null);
        if (reviewerId) userIds.add(reviewerId.toString());
        if (revieweeId) userIds.add(revieweeId.toString());
    });

    const idList = Array.from(userIds).map((id) => new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(id));

    const [brandProfiles, creatorProfiles] = await Promise.all([
        idList.length > 0
            ? BrandProfile.find({ user: { $in: idList } }).select("user logo companyName").lean()
            : [],
        idList.length > 0
            ? Profile.find({ user: { $in: idList } }).select("user profileImage").lean()
            : []
    ]);

    const brandMap = new Map();
    brandProfiles.forEach((bp) => {
        if (bp.user) brandMap.set(bp.user.toString(), bp);
    });

    const creatorMap = new Map();
    creatorProfiles.forEach((cp) => {
        if (cp.user) creatorMap.set(cp.user.toString(), cp);
    });

    const enriched = reviewList.map((rev) => {
        const revObj = rev.toObject ? rev.toObject() : { ...rev };

        if (revObj.reviewer && typeof revObj.reviewer === "object") {
            const rId = revObj.reviewer._id?.toString();
            const bp = rId ? brandMap.get(rId) : null;
            if (bp) {
                revObj.reviewer = {
                    ...revObj.reviewer,
                    logo: bp.logo || "",
                    avatar: bp.logo || "",
                    profileImage: bp.logo || "",
                    ...(bp.companyName ? { companyName: bp.companyName } : {})
                };
            }
            const cp = rId ? creatorMap.get(rId) : null;
            if (cp) {
                revObj.reviewer = {
                    ...revObj.reviewer,
                    profileImage: cp.profileImage || "",
                    avatar: cp.profileImage || ""
                };
            }
        }

        if (revObj.reviewee && typeof revObj.reviewee === "object") {
            const reId = revObj.reviewee._id?.toString();
            const cp = reId ? creatorMap.get(reId) : null;
            if (cp) {
                revObj.reviewee = {
                    ...revObj.reviewee,
                    profileImage: cp.profileImage || "",
                    avatar: cp.profileImage || "",
                    image: cp.profileImage || ""
                };
            }
            const bp = reId ? brandMap.get(reId) : null;
            if (bp) {
                revObj.reviewee = {
                    ...revObj.reviewee,
                    logo: bp.logo || "",
                    avatar: bp.logo || "",
                    profileImage: bp.logo || "",
                    ...(bp.companyName ? { companyName: bp.companyName } : {})
                };
            }
        }

        return revObj;
    });

    return isSingle ? enriched[0] : enriched;
};

// Brand submits a review for a completed workspace
const createBrandReviewService = async (brandId, payload) => {
    const targetWorkspaceId = payload.workspaceId || payload.workspace;
    const { rating, comment } = payload;

    const workspace = await Workspace.findById(targetWorkspaceId);
    if (!workspace) {
        throw createApiError(
            404,
            "Workspace not found"
        );
    }

    // Verify brand ownership of the workspace
    if (workspace.brand.toString() !== brandId.toString()) {
        throw createApiError(
            403,
            "You are not authorized to submit a review for this workspace"
        );
    }

    // Verify workspace completion
    if (workspace.status !== "completed") {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Reviews can only be submitted for completed collaborations"
        );
    }

    // Verify user has not already submitted a review for this workspace
    const existingReview = await Review.findOne({
        workspace: workspace._id,
        reviewer: brandId
    });
    if (existingReview) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "You have already submitted a review for this workspace"
        );
    }

    // Create review using trusted workspace relationships and authenticated reviewer ID
    const newReview = new Review({
        workspace: workspace._id,
        booking: workspace.booking,
        campaign: workspace.campaign,
        reviewer: brandId,
        reviewee: workspace.creator,
        rating: Number(rating),
        comment: comment ? String(comment).trim() : ""
    });

    try {
        await newReview.save();
    } catch (error) {
        if (error.code === 11000) {
            throw createApiError(
                400,
                "You have already submitted a review for this workspace"
            );
        }
        throw error;
    }

    const populatedReview = await Review.findById(newReview._id)
        .populate({
            path: "reviewer",
            select: "name role"
        })
        .populate({
            path: "reviewee",
            select: "name role"
        })
        .populate({
            path: "campaign",
            select: "title coverImage"
        })
        .populate({
            path: "workspace",
            select: "status agreedPrice currency"
        });

    await createNotificationSafe({
        recipient: newReview.reviewee,
        sender: brandId,
        type: "review:received",
        title: "New Review Received",
        message: `A brand reviewed your collaboration with a ${newReview.rating}-star rating!`,
        entityType: "review",
        entityId: newReview._id,
        destination: "/creator/reviews",
        metadata: {
            reviewId: newReview._id,
            rating: newReview.rating,
            workspaceId: newReview.workspace,
            comment: newReview.comment || ""
        },
        idempotencyKey: `review:received:${newReview._id}`
    });

    const enrichedReview = await attachReviewProfiles(populatedReview);
    return enrichedReview;
};

// Brand fetches reviews submitted by them
const getBrandReviewsService = async (brandId, query = {}) => {
    const { page, limit } = query;
    const { page: currentPage, limit: itemsPerPage, skip } = getPagination(page, limit);

    const filter = { reviewer: brandId };

    const totalReviews = await Review.countDocuments(filter);

    const reviews = await Review.find(filter)
        .sort({ createdAt: -1 })
        .skip(skip)
        .limit(itemsPerPage)
        .populate({
            path: "reviewee",
            select: "name role"
        })
        .populate({
            path: "campaign",
            select: "title coverImage"
        })
        .populate({
            path: "workspace",
            select: "status agreedPrice currency"
        });

    const pagination = getPaginationData(currentPage, itemsPerPage, totalReviews);
    const enrichedReviews = await attachReviewProfiles(reviews);

    return {
        reviews: enrichedReviews,
        pagination
    };
};

// Creator fetches reviews received by them
const getCreatorReviewsService = async (creatorId, query = {}) => {
    if (!creatorId || !mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(creatorId)) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Invalid Creator ID format"
        );
    }

    const creatorObjectId = new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(creatorId);

    const { page, limit } = query;
    const { page: currentPage, limit: itemsPerPage, skip } = getPagination(page, limit);

    const filter = { reviewee: creatorObjectId };

    const totalReviews = await Review.countDocuments(filter);

    const reviews = await Review.find(filter)
        .sort({ createdAt: -1 })
        .skip(skip)
        .limit(itemsPerPage)
        .populate({
            path: "reviewer",
            select: "name role"
        })
        .populate({
            path: "campaign",
            select: "title coverImage"
        })
        .populate({
            path: "workspace",
            select: "status agreedPrice currency"
        });

    // Calculate average rating for creator
    let averageRating = 0;
    if (totalReviews > 0) {
        const stats = await Review.aggregate([
            { $match: { reviewee: creatorObjectId } },
            { $group: { _id: "$reviewee", avgRating: { $avg: "$rating" } } }
        ]);
        if (stats.length > 0 && stats[0].avgRating) {
            averageRating = Number(stats[0].avgRating.toFixed(1));
        }
    }

    const pagination = getPaginationData(currentPage, itemsPerPage, totalReviews);
    const enrichedReviews = await attachReviewProfiles(reviews);

    return {
        reviews: enrichedReviews,
        stats: {
            totalReviews,
            averageRating
        },
        pagination
    };
};

// Fetch review details for a specific workspace (checking user authorization)
const getWorkspaceReviewService = async (workspaceId, userId) => {
    const workspace = await Workspace.findById(workspaceId);
    if (!workspace) {
        throw createApiError(
            404,
            "Workspace not found"
        );
    }

    const isBrand = workspace.brand.toString() === userId.toString();
    const isCreator = workspace.creator.toString() === userId.toString();

    if (!isBrand && !isCreator) {
        throw createApiError(
            403,
            "You do not have permission to view reviews for this workspace"
        );
    }

    // Find the review submitted for this workspace where the requesting user is a participant
    const review = await Review.findOne({
        workspace: workspaceId,
        $or: [{ reviewer: userId }, { reviewee: userId }]
    })
        .populate({
            path: "reviewer",
            select: "name role"
        })
        .populate({
            path: "reviewee",
            select: "name role"
        })
        .populate({
            path: "campaign",
            select: "title coverImage"
        })
        .populate({
            path: "workspace",
            select: "status agreedPrice currency"
        });

    const enrichedReview = review ? await attachReviewProfiles(review) : null;
    return enrichedReview;
};

export {
    createBrandReviewService,
    getBrandReviewsService,
    getCreatorReviewsService,
    getWorkspaceReviewService
};

import mongoose from "mongoose";
import createApiError from "../../utils/ApiError.js";

// Validates review creation payload
const validateCreateReview = (req, res, next) => {
    const { workspaceId, workspace, rating, comment } = req.body;
    const targetWorkspaceId = workspaceId || workspace;

    if (!targetWorkspaceId) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Workspace ID is required"
        );
    }

    if (!mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(targetWorkspaceId)) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Invalid Workspace ID format"
        );
    }

    if (rating === undefined || rating === null) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Rating is required"
        );
    }

    const numRating = Number(rating);
    if (!Number.isInteger(numRating) || numRating < 1 || numRating > 5) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Rating must be an integer between 1 and 5"
        );
    }

    if (comment !== undefined && comment !== null) {
        if (typeof comment !== "string") {
            throw createApiError(
                400,
                "Comment must be a string"
            );
        }
        if (comment.trim().length > 1000) {
            throw createApiError(
                400,
                "Comment cannot exceed 1000 characters"
            );
        }
    }

    next();
};

// Validates query parameters for fetching reviews
const validateGetReviewsQuery = (req, res, next) => {
    const { page, limit } = req.query;

    if (page !== undefined) {
        const parsedPage = Number(page);
        if (!Number.isInteger(parsedPage) || parsedPage < 1) {
            throw createApiError(
                400,
                "Page must be a valid positive integer"
            );
        }
    }

    if (limit !== undefined) {
        const parsedLimit = Number(limit);
        if (!Number.isInteger(parsedLimit) || parsedLimit < 1 || parsedLimit > 100) {
            throw createApiError(
                400,
                "Limit must be an integer between 1 and 100"
            );
        }
    }

    next();
};

// Validates workspaceId route parameter
const validateWorkspaceIdParam = (req, res, next) => {
    const { workspaceId } = req.params;

    if (!workspaceId || !mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(workspaceId)) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Invalid Workspace ID format"
        );
    }

    next();
};

export {
    validateCreateReview,
    validateGetReviewsQuery,
    validateWorkspaceIdParam
};

// =========================================================
// TIME FORMATTER

function formatTimeAgo(dateString) {
  if (!dateString) return "";
  try {
    const date = new Date(dateString);
    const now = new Date();
    const diffInSeconds = Math.floor((now - date) / 1000);
    if (Number.isNaN(diffInSeconds) || diffInSeconds < 0) return "";
    if (diffInSeconds < 60) return "Just now";
    const minutes = Math.floor(diffInSeconds / 60);
    if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes}m ago`;
    const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
    if (hours < 24) return `${hours}h ago`;
    const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);
    if (days < 7) return `${days}d ago`;
    return date.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: "short", day: "numeric" });
  } catch {
    return "";
  }
}

export default function CreatorNotificationDropdown({
  isOpen = false,
  onToggle = () => {},
  onClose = () => {}
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const dispatch = useDispatch();
  const dropdownRef = useRef(null);
  const [markingIds, setMarkingIds] = useState([]);
  const [actionError, setActionError] = useState(null);

  const {
    dropdownNotifications: notifications = [],
    unreadCount = 0,
    dropdownLoading: loading = false,
    markingAllRead = false,
    dropdownError: error = null
  } = useSelector((state) => state.creatorNotifications || {});

  const authUser = useSelector((state) => state.auth?.user);
  const creatorProfile = useSelector((state) => state.profile?.profile);
  const currentUserId =
    authUser?._id ||
    authUser?.id ||
    creatorProfile?.user?._id ||
    (typeof creatorProfile?.user === "string" ? creatorProfile.user : null);

  const currentUserIdRef = useRef(currentUserId);
  useEffect(() => {
    currentUserIdRef.current = currentUserId;
  }, [currentUserId]);

  const consumerId = useId();

  // Connect socket and listen for real-time notifications
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!currentUserId) {
      unregisterSocketConsumer(consumerId);
      return;
    }

    registerSocketConsumer(consumerId, currentUserId);

    const handleNewNotification = (notification) => {
      if (!notification || !notification._id) return;

      const targetRecipient =
        notification.recipient?._id ||
        notification.recipient?.id ||
        notification.recipient;

      if (
        !currentUserIdRef.current ||
        !targetRecipient ||
        String(targetRecipient) !== String(currentUserIdRef.current)
      ) {
        return;
      }

      dispatch(addRealtimeCreatorNotification(notification));
    };

    const handleConnectError = async (err) => {
      await handleSocketConnectionError(err, dispatch, refreshToken);
    };

    const handleConnectSuccess = () => {
      confirmSocketAuthSuccess();
    };

    socket.on("connect", handleConnectSuccess);
    socket.on("notification:new", handleNewNotification);
    socket.on("connect_error", handleConnectError);

    return () => {
      unregisterSocketConsumer(consumerId);
      socket.off("connect", handleConnectSuccess);
      socket.off("notification:new", handleNewNotification);
      socket.off("connect_error", handleConnectError);
    };
  }, [dispatch, currentUserId, consumerId]);

  // Fetch unread count on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    dispatch(fetchCreatorUnreadNotificationCount());
  }, [dispatch]);

  // Fetch latest 10 notifications whenever opened
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      dispatch(fetchCreatorDropdownNotifications());
      dispatch(fetchCreatorUnreadNotificationCount());
    }
  }, [dispatch, isOpen]);

  // Close on outside click and Escape key
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;

    function handleClickOutside(event) {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
        onClose();
      }
    }

    function handleKeyDown(event) {
      if (event.key === "Escape") {
        onClose();
      }
    }

    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  const handleDropdownRetry = () => {
    setActionError(null);
    dispatch(fetchCreatorDropdownNotifications());
    dispatch(fetchCreatorUnreadNotificationCount());
  };

  const handleItemClick = async (item) => {
    if (!item) return;

    if (item._id && !item.isRead) {
      if (markingIds.includes(item._id)) return;
      setActionError(null);
      setMarkingIds((prev) => [...prev, item._id]);
      try {
        await dispatch(markCreatorNotificationRead(item._id)).unwrap();
      } catch (err) {
        setActionError(
          typeof err === "string" ? err : "Failed to mark notification as read"
        );
        return;
      } finally {
        setMarkingIds((prev) => prev.filter((id) => id !== item._id));
      }
    }

    onClose();

    // Safe internal route navigation
    if (
      typeof item?.destination === "string" &&
      item.destination.startsWith("/") &&
      !item.destination.startsWith("//")
    ) {
      router.push(item.destination);
    }
  };

  const handleMarkItemRead = async (e, item) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!item?._id || item?.isRead || markingIds.includes(item._id)) return;
    setActionError(null);
    setMarkingIds((prev) => [...prev, item._id]);
    try {
      await dispatch(markCreatorNotificationRead(item._id)).unwrap();
    } catch (err) {
      setActionError(
        typeof err === "string" ? err : "Failed to mark notification as read"
      );
    } finally {
      setMarkingIds((prev) => prev.filter((id) => id !== item._id));
    }
  };

  const handleMarkAllRead = async () => {
    if (unreadCount > 0 && !markingAllRead) {
      setActionError(null);
      try {
        await dispatch(markAllCreatorNotificationsRead()).unwrap();
      } catch (err) {
        setActionError(
          typeof err === "string" ? err : "Failed to mark all notifications as read"
        );
      }
    }
  };

  const numUnread = Number(unreadCount) || 0;

  return (
    <div className="relative" ref={dropdownRef}>
      {/* Bell Button */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={onToggle}
        aria-label={`Notifications${numUnread > 0 ? ` (${numUnread} unread)` : ""}`}
        aria-expanded={isOpen}
        aria-haspopup="true"
        className="relative p-2 rounded-xl text-text-secondary hover:text-foreground hover:bg-surface-muted border border-border-theme transition-colors cursor-pointer"
      >
        <BellIcon />
        {numUnread > 0 && (
          <span className="absolute -top-1.5 -right-1.5 min-w-[18px] h-[18px] px-1 rounded-full bg-secondary text-white text-[10px] font-bold font-sans flex items-center justify-center ring-2 ring-surface shadow-sm">
            {numUnread > 99 ? "99+" : numUnread}
          </span>
        )}
      </button>

      {/* Floating Dropdown Panel */}
      {isOpen && (
        <div className="absolute right-[-3.5rem] sm:right-0 top-full mt-2 w-[calc(100vw-1.5rem)] sm:w-96 max-w-sm sm:max-w-md bg-surface border border-border-theme rounded-2xl shadow-xl z-50 text-foreground font-sans select-none animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-1 duration-150 overflow-hidden flex flex-col">
          {/* Header */}
          <div className="px-4 py-3 border-b border-border-theme flex items-center justify-between gap-2 bg-surface">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
              <h2 className="font-semibold text-sm text-foreground">Notifications</h2>
              {numUnread > 0 && (
                <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-secondary/15 text-secondary border border-secondary/30 shrink-0">
                  {numUnread} unread
                </span>
              )}
            </div>

            {numUnread > 0 && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleMarkAllRead}
                disabled={markingAllRead}
                className="text-xs font-medium text-secondary hover:underline cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 transition-colors shrink-0"
              >
                {markingAllRead ? "Marking..." : "Mark all read"}
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* List Area */}
          <div className="max-h-[380px] overflow-y-auto divide-y divide-border-theme/40 overscroll-contain">
            {actionError && (
              <div className="p-2.5 bg-red-500/10 border-b border-red-500/20 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 px-4">
                <span className="text-[11px] text-red-500 truncate">{actionError}</span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setActionError(null)}
                  className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-secondary hover:text-foreground cursor-pointer shrink-0"
                >
                  Dismiss
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
            {error && notifications.length > 0 && (
              <div className="p-2.5 bg-red-500/10 border-b border-red-500/20 text-center flex items-center justify-between gap-2 px-4">
                <span className="text-[11px] text-red-500 truncate">{error}</span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleDropdownRetry}
                  className="text-xs font-semibold text-secondary hover:underline cursor-pointer shrink-0"
                >
                  Retry
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
            {loading && notifications.length === 0 ? (
              // Loading Skeleton
              <div className="p-4 space-y-3.5">
                {[1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
                  <div key={i} className="animate-pulse flex items-start gap-3">
                    <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-surface-muted shrink-0" />
                    <div className="flex-1 space-y-2">
                      <div className="h-3.5 bg-surface-muted rounded w-2/3" />
                      <div className="h-3 bg-surface-muted rounded w-full" />
                      <div className="h-2.5 bg-surface-muted rounded w-1/4" />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            ) : error && notifications.length === 0 ? (
              // Error State
              <div className="p-6 text-center">
                <p className="text-xs text-red-500 mb-2">{error}</p>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleDropdownRetry}
                  className="text-xs font-semibold text-secondary hover:underline cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Try again
                </button>
              </div>
            ) : notifications.length === 0 ? (
              // Empty State
              <div className="py-10 px-4 text-center flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
                <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-surface-muted flex items-center justify-center text-text-secondary mb-2.5">
                  <BellIcon className="w-5 h-5 opacity-40" />
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">No notifications yet</p>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-text-secondary mt-0.5">
                  You&apos;re all caught up! Updates will appear here.
                </p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              // Notification Items
              notifications.slice(0, 10).map((item) => {
                const isUnread = !item.isRead;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={item._id}
                    onClick={() => handleItemClick(item)}
                    className={`p-3 sm:p-3.5 flex items-start gap-3 transition-colors cursor-pointer text-left ${
                      isUnread
                        ? "bg-secondary/5 hover:bg-secondary/10"
                        : "hover:bg-surface-muted"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 bg-surface-muted text-neutral-800 dark:text-neutral-200 border border-border-theme">
                      <NotificationTypeIcon
                        entityType={item.entityType}
                        className="w-4 h-4 text-neutral-800 dark:text-neutral-200"
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-1.5">
                        <h3
                          className={`text-xs leading-snug truncate ${
                            isUnread
                              ? "font-semibold text-foreground"
                              : "font-medium text-foreground/90"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {item.title}
                        </h3>
                        {isUnread && (
                          <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-secondary shrink-0 mt-1" />
                        )}
                      </div>

                      <p className="text-[11px] text-text-secondary line-clamp-2 mt-0.5 leading-relaxed">
                        {item.message}
                      </p>

                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mt-1.5 text-[10px] text-text-secondary">
                        <span>{formatTimeAgo(item.createdAt)}</span>

                        {isUnread && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={(e) => handleMarkItemRead(e, item)}
                            disabled={markingIds.includes(item._id)}
                            title="Mark as read"
                            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 hover:text-secondary p-0.5 rounded transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                          >
                            <CheckIcon className="w-3 h-3" />
                            <span>{markingIds.includes(item._id) ? "Marking..." : "Mark read"}</span>
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Footer: Link to Full Notifications Center */}
          <div className="p-2 border-t border-border-theme bg-surface-muted/20 text-center">
            <Link
              href="/creator/notifications"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold text-secondary hover:underline py-1 px-3 transition-colors"
            >
              <span>View all notifications</span>
              <span aria-hidden="true">→</span>
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// =========================================================
// TIME FORMATTER

function formatTimeAgo(dateString) {
  if (!dateString) return "";
  try {
    const date = new Date(dateString);
    const now = new Date();
    const diffInSeconds = Math.floor((now - date) / 1000);
    if (Number.isNaN(diffInSeconds) || diffInSeconds < 0) return "";
    if (diffInSeconds < 60) return "Just now";
    const minutes = Math.floor(diffInSeconds / 60);
    if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes}m ago`;
    const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
    if (hours < 24) return `${hours}h ago`;
    const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);
    if (days === 1) return "1 day ago";
    if (days < 30) return `${days} days ago`;
    const months = Math.floor(days / 30);
    if (months === 1) return "1 month ago";
    if (months < 12) return `${months} months ago`;
    return date.toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
      month: "short",
      day: "numeric",
      year: date.getFullYear() !== now.getFullYear() ? "numeric" : undefined
    });
  } catch {
    return "";
  }
}
