```jsx
      setActionError(null);
      try {
        await dispatch(markAllCreatorNotificationsRead()).unwrap();
        dispatch(fetchCreatorUnreadNotificationCount());
      } catch (err) {
        setActionError(
          typeof err === "string" ? err : "Failed to mark all notifications as read"
        );
      }
    }
  };

  const isNotificationRead = (item) => Boolean(item?.isRead || item?.readAt);

  const handleItemClick = async (item) => {
    if (!item) return;

    const isItemUnread = !isNotificationRead(item);
    if (item._id && isItemUnread) {
      if (markingIds.includes(item._id)) return;
      setActionError(null);
      setMarkingIds((prev) => [...prev, item._id]);
      try {
        await dispatch(markCreatorNotificationRead(item._id)).unwrap();
        dispatch(fetchCreatorUnreadNotificationCount());
      } catch (err) {
        setActionError(
          typeof err === "string" ? err : "Failed to mark notification as read"
        );
        return;
      } finally {
        setMarkingIds((prev) => prev.filter((id) => id !== item._id));
      }
    }

    if (
      typeof item?.destination === "string" &&
      item.destination.startsWith("/") &&
      !item.destination.startsWith("//")
    ) {
      router.push(item.destination);
    }
  };

  const handleMarkSingleRead = async (e, item) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const isItemRead = isNotificationRead(item);
    if (!item?._id || isItemRead || markingIds.includes(item._id)) {
      return;
    }
    setActionError(null);
    setMarkingIds((prev) => [...prev, item._id]);
    try {
      await dispatch(markCreatorNotificationRead(item._id)).unwrap();
      dispatch(fetchCreatorUnreadNotificationCount());
    } catch (err) {
      setActionError(
        typeof err === "string" ? err : "Failed to mark notification as read"
      );
    } finally {
      setMarkingIds((prev) => prev.filter((id) => id !== item._id));
    }
  };

  // Exclude newly read items when in unread tab and filter by category if set
  const displayedNotifications = notifications.filter((item) => {
    const isItemRead = isNotificationRead(item);
    if (readFilter === "unread" && isItemRead) return false;
    if (categoryFilter !== "all" && item?.entityType !== categoryFilter) return false;
    return true;
  });

  const currentPage = pagination?.page ?? page;
  const numUnread = Number(unreadCount) || 0;
  const totalItems =
    readFilter === "unread"
      ? numUnread
      : (pagination?.totalItems ?? notifications.length);
  const totalPages =
    readFilter === "unread"
      ? Math.max(1, Math.ceil(numUnread / limit))
      : (pagination?.totalPages || 1);
  const hasPrevPage = pagination?.hasPrevPage ?? (currentPage > 1);
  const hasNextPage = pagination?.hasNextPage ?? (currentPage < totalPages);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#f8f9fa] dark:bg-background text-foreground flex flex-col font-sans">
      {/* Sidebar Component */}
      <CreatorSidebar mobileOpen={mobileOpen} setMobileOpen={setMobileOpen} />

      {/* Main Content Area Offset by Desktop Sidebar */}
      <div className="flex-1 lg:ml-64 flex flex-col min-w-0">
        {/* Header Bar */}
        <CreatorHeader setMobileOpen={setMobileOpen} />

        {/* Notifications Center Container */}
        <main className="flex-1 p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-5 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto">
          {/* Header Title & Actions Banner */}
          <div className="bg-surface border border-border-theme rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-xs flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 mb-2">
                <span className="font-bold text-[11px] tracking-wider uppercase text-[#ff2d6c] dark:text-[#ff4f87] font-sans">
                  NOTIFICATION CENTER
                </span>
                {numUnread > 0 && (
                  <span className="inline-block px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-[#252525] text-white">
                    {numUnread} Unread
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
              <h1 className="font-serif font-medium text-2xl sm:text-3xl text-foreground tracking-tight">
                Notifications
              </h1>
              <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-text-secondary mt-1">
                Stay updated on campaign proposals, workspace progress, escrow receipts, and collaboration activities.
              </p>
            </div>

            {numUnread > 0 && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleMarkAllRead}
                disabled={markingAllRead}
                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-neutral-950 hover:bg-neutral-800 text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-neutral-950 dark:hover:bg-neutral-100 text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed shrink-0 shadow-xs"
              >
                <CheckIcon className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>{markingAllRead ? "Marking all..." : "Mark all as read"}</span>
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Filter Bar: Tabs & Categories in separate white rounded container */}
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-surface border border-neutral-200/80 dark:border-border-theme rounded-2xl p-2 sm:p-2.5 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-3 shadow-2xs">
            {/* All vs Unread Tabs */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleTabChange("all")}
                className={`px-5 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  readFilter === "all"
                    ? "bg-neutral-950 text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-neutral-950 shadow-2xs"
                    : "bg-white dark:bg-surface text-neutral-700 dark:text-neutral-300 border border-neutral-200/80 dark:border-border-theme hover:bg-neutral-50 dark:hover:bg-surface-muted"
                }`}
              >
                All
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleTabChange("unread")}
                className={`px-5 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                  readFilter === "unread"
                    ? "bg-neutral-950 text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-neutral-950 shadow-2xs"
                    : "bg-white dark:bg-surface text-neutral-700 dark:text-neutral-300 border border-neutral-200/80 dark:border-border-theme hover:bg-neutral-50 dark:hover:bg-surface-muted"
                }`}
              >
                <span>Unread</span>
                {numUnread > 0 && (
                  <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-pink-500 shrink-0" />
                )}
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Category Filter Pills */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1 md:pb-0 scrollbar-none">
              {CATEGORY_FILTERS.map((cat) => {
                const isActive = categoryFilter === cat.value;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={cat.value}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleCategoryChange(cat.value)}
                    className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                      isActive
                        ? "bg-neutral-950 text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-neutral-950 shadow-2xs"
                        : "bg-white dark:bg-surface text-neutral-700 dark:text-neutral-300 border border-neutral-200/80 dark:border-border-theme hover:bg-neutral-50 dark:hover:bg-surface-muted"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {cat.label}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Main Feed Content */}
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {actionError && (
              <div className="bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/20 text-red-500 rounded-2xl p-4 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold">{actionError}</p>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setActionError(null)}
                  className="text-xs font-semibold text-text-secondary hover:text-foreground cursor-pointer shrink-0"
                >
                  Dismiss
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            {error && notifications.length > 0 && (
              <div className="bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/20 text-red-500 rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 text-center sm:text-left">
                <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold">{error}</p>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleRetry}
                  className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-red-500/20 hover:bg-red-500/30 text-red-500 text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide transition-all cursor-pointer shrink-0"
                >
                  Try again
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            {loading && notifications.length === 0 ? (
              // Loading Skeleton State
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((i) => (
                  <div
                    key={i}
                    className="animate-pulse bg-white dark:bg-surface border border-neutral-200/80 dark:border-border-theme rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-5 flex items-start gap-3.5 shadow-2xs"
                  >
                    <div className="w-11 h-11 rounded-full bg-neutral-100 dark:bg-surface-muted shrink-0" />
                    <div className="flex-1 space-y-2">
                      <div className="h-4 bg-neutral-100 dark:bg-surface-muted rounded w-1/3" />
                      <div className="h-3 bg-neutral-100 dark:bg-surface-muted rounded w-3/4" />
                      <div className="h-2.5 bg-neutral-100 dark:bg-surface-muted rounded w-1/4" />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            ) : error && notifications.length === 0 ? (
              // Error Alert State
              <div className="bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/20 text-red-500 rounded-2xl p-6 text-center space-y-2">
                <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold">{error}</p>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleRetry}
                  className="text-xs font-semibold text-secondary hover:underline cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Try loading again
                </button>
              </div>
            ) : displayedNotifications.length === 0 ? (
              // Empty State
              <div className="bg-white dark:bg-surface border border-neutral-200/80 dark:border-border-theme rounded-2xl py-16 px-6 text-center flex flex-col items-center justify-center shadow-2xs">
                <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-neutral-100 dark:bg-surface-muted flex items-center justify-center text-neutral-400 mb-3">
                  <BellIcon className="w-6 h-6" />
                </div>
                <h3 className="font-semibold text-base text-foreground">No notifications found</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-text-secondary mt-1 max-w-sm">
                  {readFilter === "unread"
                    ? "You have marked all your notifications as read. Check the 'All' tab for past activity."
                    : categoryFilter !== "all"
                    ? `No notifications found under the '${categoryFilter}' category.`
                    : "When brands send you booking proposals or approve deliverables, updates will appear here."}
                </p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              // Notifications Card List
              displayedNotifications.map((item) => {
                const isUnread = !isNotificationRead(item);
                const hasValidDestination =
                  typeof item?.destination === "string" &&
                  item.destination.startsWith("/") &&
                  !item.destination.startsWith("//");

                return (
                  <div
                    key={item._id}
                    onClick={() => handleItemClick(item)}
                    className={`group bg-surface border rounded-xl sm:rounded-2xl py-2.5 px-3.5 sm:py-3 sm:px-4 transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 ${
                      isUnread
                        ? "border-secondary/30 bg-secondary/5 hover:border-secondary/60 hover:bg-secondary/10"
                        : "border-border-theme hover:border-border-theme hover:bg-surface-muted/50"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {/* Left: Icon + Content */}
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <div className="w-8.5 h-8.5 sm:w-9 sm:h-9 rounded-lg sm:rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 transition-colors bg-surface-muted text-neutral-800 dark:text-neutral-200 border border-border-theme">
                        <NotificationTypeIcon
                          entityType={item.entityType}
                          className="w-4 h-4 sm:w-4.5 sm:h-4.5 text-neutral-800 dark:text-neutral-200"
                        />
                      </div>

                      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-0.5">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                          <h3
                            className={`text-sm tracking-tight truncate ${
                              isUnread ? "font-bold text-foreground" : "font-medium text-foreground"
                            }`}
                          >
                            {item.title}
                          </h3>

                          {/* Entity Type Badge */}
                          {item.entityType && (
                            <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md tracking-wider bg-surface-muted text-text-secondary border border-border-theme">
                              {item.entityType}
                            </span>
                          )}

                          {/* Sender name badge if populated */}
                          {item.sender?.name && (
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-text-secondary font-medium">
                              from {item.sender.name}
                            </span>
                          )}

                          {isUnread && (
                            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-secondary shrink-0" />
                          )}
                        </div>

                        {item.message && (
                          <p className="text-xs text-text-secondary leading-normal">
                            {item.message}
                          </p>
                        )}

                        <div className="text-[11px] text-text-secondary/80">
                          {formatTimeAgo(item.createdAt)}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Right: Actions */}
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:self-center shrink-0 border-t sm:border-t-0 border-border-theme/40 pt-1.5 sm:pt-0">
                      {isUnread && (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={(e) => handleMarkSingleRead(e, item)}
                          disabled={markingIds.includes(item._id)}
                          title="Mark as read"
                          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold text-text-secondary hover:text-secondary hover:bg-secondary/10 transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                        >
                          <CheckIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          <span>{markingIds.includes(item._id) ? "Marking..." : "Mark read"}</span>
                        </button>
                      )}

                      {hasValidDestination && (
                        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-secondary group-hover:translate-x-0.5 transition-transform inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                          <span>View Details</span>
                          <span aria-hidden="true">→</span>
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Pagination Controls */}
          {pagination && (totalPages > 1 || totalItems > 0) && (
            <div className="bg-surface border border-border-theme rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 min-w-0 w-full overflow-hidden shadow-xs">
              <span className="text-xs text-text-secondary">
                Showing page <strong className="text-foreground">{currentPage}</strong> of{" "}
                <strong className="text-foreground">{totalPages}</strong> ({totalItems} total)
              </span>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar max-w-full">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
                  disabled={!hasPrevPage}
                  className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-border-theme text-xs font-semibold text-text-secondary hover:text-foreground hover:bg-surface-muted transition-colors disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed cursor-pointer shrink-0"
                >
                  Previous
                </button>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                  {Array.from({ length: totalPages }, (_, i) => i + 1).map((pageNum) => (
                    <button
                      key={pageNum}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setPage(pageNum)}
                      className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold transition-colors cursor-pointer shrink-0 ${
                        currentPage === pageNum
                          ? "bg-[#252525] text-white"
                          : "text-text-secondary hover:bg-surface-muted hover:text-foreground"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {pageNum}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.min(totalPages, p + 1))}
                  disabled={!hasNextPage}
                  className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-border-theme text-xs font-semibold text-text-secondary hover:text-foreground hover:bg-surface-muted transition-colors disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed cursor-pointer shrink-0"
                >
                  Next
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </main>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
import axiosInstance from "@/lib/axios";

// Creator fetches notifications list with optional pagination and isRead filter.
const getCreatorNotifications = async (params = {}) => {
    const response = await axiosInstance.get(
        "/creator/notifications",
        {
            params
        }
    );

    return response.data;
};

// Creator fetches unread notifications count for header badge.
const getCreatorUnreadNotificationCount = async () => {
    const response = await axiosInstance.get(
        "/creator/notifications/unread-count"
    );

    return response.data;
};

// Creator marks a single notification as read by ID.
const markCreatorNotificationRead = async (notificationId) => {
    const response = await axiosInstance.patch(
        `/creator/notifications/${notificationId}/read`
    );

    return response.data;
};

// Creator marks all unread notifications in a specific category as read.
const markCreatorCategoryNotificationsRead = async (category) => {
    const response = await axiosInstance.patch(
        "/creator/notifications/read-all",
        {},
        {
            params: { category }
        }
    );

    return response.data;
};

// Creator marks all unread notifications as read.
const markAllCreatorNotificationsRead = async () => {
    const response = await axiosInstance.patch(
        "/creator/notifications/read-all"
    );

    return response.data;
};

export {
    getCreatorNotifications,
    getCreatorUnreadNotificationCount,
    markCreatorNotificationRead,
    markCreatorCategoryNotificationsRead,
    markAllCreatorNotificationsRead
};
```

```javascript
import {
    createAsyncThunk,
    createSlice
} from "@reduxjs/toolkit";

import {
    getCreatorNotifications as getCreatorNotificationsApi,
    getCreatorUnreadNotificationCount as getCreatorUnreadNotificationCountApi,
    markCreatorNotificationRead as markCreatorNotificationReadApi,
    markCreatorCategoryNotificationsRead as markCreatorCategoryNotificationsReadApi,
    markAllCreatorNotificationsRead as markAllCreatorNotificationsReadApi
} from "./notifications_api";

import {
    login,
    logout,
    clearAuth
} from "../../auth/auth_slice";

// Handles fetching creator notifications list with optional params (page, limit, isRead).
const fetchCreatorNotifications = createAsyncThunk(
    "creatorNotifications/fetchCreatorNotifications",
    async (params = {}, { rejectWithValue }) => {
        try {
            return await getCreatorNotificationsApi(params);
        } catch (error) {
            return rejectWithValue(
                error.response?.data?.message ||
                "Unable to fetch notifications"
            );
        }
    }
);

// Handles fetching unread notifications count for creator.
const fetchCreatorUnreadNotificationCount = createAsyncThunk(
    "creatorNotifications/fetchCreatorUnreadNotificationCount",
    async (_, { rejectWithValue }) => {
        try {
            return await getCreatorUnreadNotificationCountApi();
        } catch (error) {
            return rejectWithValue(
                error.response?.data?.message ||
                "Unable to fetch unread notification count"
            );
        }
    }
);

// Handles fetching latest notifications for creator header dropdown.
const fetchCreatorDropdownNotifications = createAsyncThunk(
    "creatorNotifications/fetchCreatorDropdownNotifications",
    async (_, { rejectWithValue }) => {
        try {
            return await getCreatorNotificationsApi({ page: 1, limit: 10 });
        } catch (error) {
            return rejectWithValue(
                error.response?.data?.message ||
                "Unable to fetch notifications"
            );
        }
    }
);

// Handles marking single notification as read for creator.
const markCreatorNotificationRead = createAsyncThunk(
    "creatorNotifications/markCreatorNotificationRead",
    async (notificationId, { dispatch, getState, rejectWithValue }) => {
        try {
            const response = await markCreatorNotificationReadApi(notificationId);

            // Check if notification is present in either loaded list
            const currentList = getState()?.creatorNotifications?.notifications || [];
            const dropdownList = getState()?.creatorNotifications?.dropdownNotifications || [];
            const targetId = response?.data?._id || notificationId;
            const wasInList = currentList.some(
                (item) => item._id && String(item._id) === String(targetId)
            );
            const wasInDropdown = dropdownList.some(
                (item) => item._id && String(item._id) === String(targetId)
            );

            // If not found in either loaded list, fetch authoritative count from backend
            if (!wasInList && !wasInDropdown) {
                await dispatch(fetchCreatorUnreadNotificationCount());
            }

            return response;
        } catch (error) {
            return rejectWithValue(
                error.response?.data?.message ||
                "Unable to mark notification as read"
            );
        }
    }
);

// Handles marking all notifications for a specific category as read for creator.
const markCreatorCategoryNotificationsRead = createAsyncThunk(
    "creatorNotifications/markCreatorCategoryNotificationsRead",
    async (category, { rejectWithValue }) => {
        try {
            return await markCreatorCategoryNotificationsReadApi(category);
        } catch (error) {
            return rejectWithValue(
                error.response?.data?.message ||
                "Unable to mark category notifications as read"
            );
        }
    }
);

// Handles marking all notifications as read for creator.
const markAllCreatorNotificationsRead = createAsyncThunk(
    "creatorNotifications/markAllCreatorNotificationsRead",
    async (_, { rejectWithValue }) => {
        try {
            return await markAllCreatorNotificationsReadApi();
        } catch (error) {
            return rejectWithValue(
                error.response?.data?.message ||
                "Unable to mark all notifications as read"
            );
        }
    }
);

const initialCountsByCategory = {
    booking: 0,
    workspace: 0,
    campaign: 0,
    payment: 0,
    review: 0,
    message: 0
};

const initialState = {
    notifications: [],
    dropdownNotifications: [],
    unreadCount: 0,
    countsByCategory: { ...initialCountsByCategory },
    pagination: null,
    loading: false,
    dropdownLoading: false,
    unreadCountLoading: false,
    markingRead: false,
    markingAllRead: false,
    markingCategoryRead: false,
    currentRequestId: null,
    error: null,
    dropdownError: null
};

const creatorNotificationsSlice = createSlice({
    name: "creatorNotifications",
    initialState,

    reducers: {
        // Adds real-time incoming notification with deduplication.
        addRealtimeCreatorNotification: (state, action) => {
            const notification = action.payload;
            if (!notification || !notification._id) return;

            const notifIdStr = String(notification._id);
            const inNotifications = state.notifications.some(
                (item) => item._id && String(item._id) === notifIdStr
            );

            if (!inNotifications) {
                state.notifications.unshift(notification);
                if (state.pagination && typeof state.pagination.totalItems === "number") {
                    state.pagination.totalItems += 1;
                }
            }

            const inDropdown = state.dropdownNotifications.some(
                (item) => item._id && String(item._id) === notifIdStr
            );
            if (!inDropdown) {
                state.dropdownNotifications.unshift(notification);
                if (state.dropdownNotifications.length > 10) {
                    state.dropdownNotifications = state.dropdownNotifications.slice(0, 10);
                }
            }

            if (!notification.isRead && !inNotifications && !inDropdown) {
                state.unreadCount += 1;
                const cat = notification.entityType;
                if (cat && typeof state.countsByCategory[cat] === "number") {
                    state.countsByCategory[cat] += 1;
                } else if (cat) {
                    state.countsByCategory[cat] = 1;
                }
            }
        },

        clearNotificationsState: () => initialState,

        clearNotificationsError: (state) => {
            state.error = null;
            state.dropdownError = null;
        }
    },

    extraReducers: (builder) => {
        builder
            // Fetch Notifications List (Full Manager) with request ID checking
            .addCase(fetchCreatorNotifications.pending, (state, action) => {
                state.loading = true;
                state.currentRequestId = action.meta.requestId;
                state.error = null;
            })
            .addCase(fetchCreatorNotifications.fulfilled, (state, action) => {
                if (state.currentRequestId === action.meta.requestId) {
                    state.loading = false;
                    state.notifications = action.payload?.data?.notifications || [];
                    state.pagination = action.payload?.data?.pagination || null;
                    state.error = null;
                    state.currentRequestId = null;
                }
            })
            .addCase(fetchCreatorNotifications.rejected, (state, action) => {
                if (state.currentRequestId === action.meta.requestId) {
                    state.loading = false;
                    state.error = action.payload || "Unable to fetch notifications";
                    state.currentRequestId = null;
                }
            })

            // Fetch Latest Notifications (Dropdown)
            .addCase(fetchCreatorDropdownNotifications.pending, (state) => {
                state.dropdownLoading = true;
                state.dropdownError = null;
            })
            .addCase(fetchCreatorDropdownNotifications.fulfilled, (state, action) => {
                state.dropdownLoading = false;
                state.dropdownNotifications = action.payload?.data?.notifications || [];

            .addCase(fetchCreatorDropdownNotifications.rejected, (state, action) => {

                        ...initialCountsByCategory,

            .addCase(markCreatorNotificationRead.fulfilled, (state, action) => {

                const updatedNotification = action.payload?.data;
                const updatedId = updatedNotification?._id || action.meta?.arg;

                if (updatedId) {

                    let wasUnread = false;

                    const index = state.notifications.findIndex(
                        (item) => item._id && String(item._id) === targetIdStr
                    );
                    if (index !== -1) {
                        if (!state.notifications[index].isRead) {
                            wasUnread = true;
                        }
                        const existingSender = state.notifications[index].sender;
                        state.notifications[index] = {
                            ...state.notifications[index],
                            ...updatedNotification,
                            sender:
                                existingSender && typeof existingSender === "object"
                                    ? existingSender
                                    : updatedNotification?.sender || existingSender,
                            isRead: true,
                            readAt: updatedNotification?.readAt || new Date().toISOString()
                        };
                    }

                    const dropIndex = state.dropdownNotifications.findIndex(
                        (item) => item._id && String(item._id) === targetIdStr
                    );
                    if (dropIndex !== -1) {
                        if (!state.dropdownNotifications[dropIndex].isRead) {
                            wasUnread = true;
                        }
                        const existingSender = state.dropdownNotifications[dropIndex].sender;
                        state.dropdownNotifications[dropIndex] = {
                            ...state.dropdownNotifications[dropIndex],
                            ...updatedNotification,
                            sender:
                                existingSender && typeof existingSender === "object"

                                    : updatedNotification?.sender || existingSender,
                            isRead: true,
                            readAt: updatedNotification?.readAt || new Date().toISOString()
                        };

                    if (wasUnread) {
                        state.unreadCount = Math.max(0, (Number(state.unreadCount) || 0) - 1);

                        if (cat && typeof state.countsByCategory[cat] === "number" && state.countsByCategory[cat] > 0) {
                            state.countsByCategory[cat] = Math.max(0, state.countsByCategory[cat] - 1);

            .addCase(markCreatorNotificationRead.rejected, (state, action) => {
                state.markingRead = false;

            // Mark All Read
            .addCase(markAllCreatorNotificationsRead.pending, (state) => {
                state.markingAllRead = true;

            .addCase(markAllCreatorNotificationsRead.fulfilled, (state) => {

                    ...item,
                    isRead: true,
                    readAt: item.readAt || nowIso

                state.dropdownNotifications = state.dropdownNotifications.map((item) => ({
                    ...item,
                    isRead: true,
                    readAt: item.readAt || nowIso

                state.markingCategoryRead = true;
                state.error = null;

            .addCase(markCreatorCategoryNotificationsRead.fulfilled, (state, action) => {
                state.markingCategoryRead = false;
                const categoryParam = action.payload?.data?.category || action.meta?.arg;
                const markedIds = (action.payload?.data?.markedNotificationIds || []).map(String);
                const modifiedCount = action.payload?.data?.modifiedCount || markedIds.length;

                const rawList = Array.isArray(categoryParam)
                    ? categoryParam
                    : String(categoryParam || "").split(",").map((s) => s.trim().toLowerCase());

                const aliasMap = {
                    bookings: "booking",
                    campaigns: "campaign",
                    workspaces: "workspace",
                    payments: "payment",
                    reviews: "review",
                    messages: "message"
                };

                const categoriesToClear = rawList.map((item) => aliasMap[item] || item);
                const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

                state.notifications = state.notifications.map((item) => {
                    if (
                        !item.isRead &&
                        (markedIds.includes(String(item._id)) || categoriesToClear.includes(item.entityType))
                    ) {
                        return {
                            ...item,
                            isRead: true,
                            readAt: item.readAt || nowIso
                        };
                    }
                    return item;
                });

                state.dropdownNotifications = state.dropdownNotifications.map((item) => {
                    if (
                        !item.isRead &&
                        (markedIds.includes(String(item._id)) || categoriesToClear.includes(item.entityType))
                    ) {
                        return {
                            ...item,
                            isRead: true,
                            readAt: item.readAt || nowIso
                        };
                    }
                    return item;
                });

                categoriesToClear.forEach((cat) => {
                    if (typeof state.countsByCategory[cat] === "number") {
                        state.countsByCategory[cat] = 0;
                    }
                });

            .addCase("creatorMessages/markCreatorConversationRead/fulfilled", (state, action) => {

                    action.payload?.response?.data?.markedNotificationIds ||
                    action.payload?.response?.markedNotificationIds ||
                    [];
                const markedIdStrs = markedIds.map(String);

                let markedCount = 0;

                state.notifications = state.notifications.map((item) => {
                    if (
                        !item.isRead &&
                        item.entityType === "message" &&
                        (markedIdStrs.includes(String(item._id)) ||
                         (targetConversationId &&
                          (String(item.entityId) === String(targetConversationId) ||
                           String(item.metadata?.conversationId) === String(targetConversationId))))
                    ) {
                        markedCount += 1;

                            ...item,
                            isRead: true,
                            readAt: new Date().toISOString()
                        };
                    }
                    return item;
                });

                state.dropdownNotifications = state.dropdownNotifications.map((item) => {
                    if (
                        !item.isRead &&
                        item.entityType === "message" &&
                        (markedIdStrs.includes(String(item._id)) ||
                         (targetConversationId &&
                          (String(item.entityId) === String(targetConversationId) ||
                           String(item.metadata?.conversationId) === String(targetConversationId))))
                    ) {
                        return {
                            ...item,
                            isRead: true,
                            readAt: new Date().toISOString()
                        };
                    }
                    return item;
                });

                if (markedIds.length > 0) {
                    state.unreadCount = Math.max(0, (Number(state.unreadCount) || 0) - markedIds.length);
                    state.countsByCategory.message = Math.max(0, (state.countsByCategory.message || 0) - markedIds.length);
                } else if (markedCount > 0) {
                    state.unreadCount = Math.max(0, (Number(state.unreadCount) || 0) - markedCount);
                    state.countsByCategory.message = Math.max(0, (state.countsByCategory.message || 0) - markedCount);
                }
            })

            .addCase(login.fulfilled, () => initialState)
            .addCase(logout.fulfilled, () => initialState)
            .addCase(clearAuth, () => initialState);
    }
});

export const {

    clearNotificationsState,
    clearNotificationsError

    fetchCreatorUnreadNotificationCount,
    markCreatorNotificationRead,

};
```

```javascript
    );
```

```javascript
import mongoose from "mongoose";

const notificationSchema = new mongoose.Schema(
    {
        // Auth._id of the user receiving the notification.
        recipient: {
            type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,
            ref: "Auth",
            required: true,
            index: true
        },

        // Auth._id of the user who initiated the event (null if system-generated).
        sender: {
            type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,
            ref: "Auth",
            default: null
        },

        // Category/event identifier.
        type: {
            type: String,
            required: true,
            trim: true
        },

        // Short descriptive title for the notification card.
        title: {
            type: String,
            required: true,
            trim: true,
            maxlength: 200
        },

        // Detailed human-readable notification message.
        message: {
            type: String,
            required: true,
            trim: true,
            maxlength: 1000
        },

        // Related domain entity type.
        entityType: {
            type: String,
            enum: [
                "booking",
                "workspace",
                "campaign",
                "payment",
                "review",
                "message"
            ],
            required: true
        },

        // ID of the related entity.
        entityId: {
            type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,
            required: true
        },

        // Internal frontend navigation route.
        destination: {
            type: String,
            required: true,
            trim: true
        },

        // Read status indicator.
        isRead: {
            type: Boolean,
            default: false
        },

        // Timestamp when notification was marked as read.
        readAt: {
            type: Date,
            default: null
        },

        // Contextual payload snapshot (e.g. titles, amounts, feedback snippet).
        metadata: {
            type: mongoose.Schema.Types.Mixed,
            default: {}
        },

        // Unique key for deterministic deduplication of lifecycle event notifications.
        idempotencyKey: {
            type: String,
            trim: true,
            default: null
        }
    },
    {
        timestamps: true
    }
);

// Compound index for optimal feed querying and unread badge count calculations.
notificationSchema.index({
    recipient: 1,
    isRead: 1,
    createdAt: -1
});

// Index for entity-based lookups.
notificationSchema.index({
    recipient: 1,
    type: 1,
    entityId: 1
});

// Database-enforced atomic uniqueness for string idempotency keys.
// Uses partialFilterExpression to safely ignore null/unspecified keys without migration conflicts.
notificationSchema.index(
    { idempotencyKey: 1 },
    {
        unique: true,
        partialFilterExpression: { idempotencyKey: { $type: "string" } }
    }
);

const Notification = mongoose.model("Notification", notificationSchema);

export default Notification;
```

```javascript
import express from "express";
import authenticateUser from "../../middleware/auth.middleware.js";
import {
    getNotifications,
    getUnreadNotificationCount,
    markNotificationRead,
    markAllNotificationsRead
} from "./notification.controller.js";
import {
    validateNotificationIdParam,
    validateGetNotificationsQuery
} from "./notification.validation.js";

const notificationRouter = express.Router();

// Enforce authentication on all notification endpoints.
notificationRouter.use(authenticateUser);

// Fetch paginated notification feed.
notificationRouter.get(
    "/",
    validateGetNotificationsQuery,
    getNotifications
);

// Fetch unread count for header/sidebar badges.
notificationRouter.get(
    "/unread-count",
    getUnreadNotificationCount
);

// Mark all unread notifications as read (supports ?category= query param).
// Registered BEFORE `/:id/read` so `:id` does not match the literal `read-all`.
notificationRouter.patch(
    "/read-all",
    markAllNotificationsRead
);

// Mark unread notifications for a specific category as read.
notificationRouter.patch(
    "/category/:category/read",
    markAllNotificationsRead
);

// Mark single notification as read.
notificationRouter.patch(
    "/:id/read",
    validateNotificationIdParam,
    markNotificationRead
);

export default notificationRouter;
```

```javascript
import mongoose from "mongoose";
import Notification from "./notification.model.js";
import { emitNotificationToUser } from "../../socket/socket.js";
import createApiError from "../../utils/ApiError.js";
import {
    getPagination,
    getPaginationData
} from "../../utils/pagination.js";

// Creates and dispatches a notification record and Socket.IO real-time event.
// Delivery semantics:
// 1. Persistent storage: Guaranteed in MongoDB. This is the canonical source of truth.
// 2. Real-time push: Best-effort over active Socket.IO connections to room `user:${recipient}`.
//    If the recipient is offline, disconnected, or Socket.IO is uninitialized, the notification
//    remains safely stored in MongoDB and is delivered when the user fetches their feed via API.
// 3. Idempotency: Enforced by a unique partial index on `idempotencyKey`. Retries return the
//    existing document without creating duplicates or re-emitting duplicate realtime events.
const createNotificationService = async (payload) => {
    const {
        recipient,
        sender = null,
        type,
        title,
        message,
        entityType,
        entityId,
        destination,
        metadata = {},
        idempotencyKey = null
    } = payload;

    if (!recipient || !mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(recipient)) {
        throw createApiError(400, "Valid recipient ID is required");
    }

    if (sender !== null && sender !== undefined && !mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(sender)) {
        throw createApiError(400, "Valid sender ID is required when sender is provided");
    }

    if (!type || !title || !message || !entityType || !entityId || !destination) {
        throw createApiError(400, "Missing required notification fields");
    }

    const trimmedIdempotencyKey =
        idempotencyKey && typeof idempotencyKey === "string" && idempotencyKey.trim()
            ? idempotencyKey.trim()
            : null;

    if (trimmedIdempotencyKey) {
        const existing = await Notification.findOne({
            idempotencyKey: trimmedIdempotencyKey
        });
        if (existing) {
            // Verify that the existing notification belongs to the requested recipient
            if (existing.recipient.toString() !== recipient.toString()) {
                console.error(
                    `Idempotency key recipient mismatch! Key "${trimmedIdempotencyKey}" belongs to recipient ${existing.recipient}, but was requested for ${recipient}.`
                );
                throw createApiError(
                    409,
                    "Idempotency key collision: this key is already associated with a different recipient"
                );
            }
            return existing;
        }
    }

    let notification;
    try {
        notification = await Notification.create({
            recipient,
            sender: sender || null,
            type,
            title,
            message,
            entityType,
            entityId,
            destination,
            metadata,
            idempotencyKey: trimmedIdempotencyKey
        });
    } catch (error) {
        if (error?.code === 11000 && trimmedIdempotencyKey) {
            const existing = await Notification.findOne({
                idempotencyKey: trimmedIdempotencyKey
            });
            if (existing) {
                // Verify recipient in concurrent duplicate collision recovery path
                if (existing.recipient.toString() !== recipient.toString()) {
                    console.error(
                        `Idempotency key duplicate race recipient mismatch! Key "${trimmedIdempotencyKey}" belongs to recipient ${existing.recipient}, but was requested for ${recipient}.`
                    );
                    throw createApiError(
                        409,
                        "Idempotency key collision: this key is already associated with a different recipient"
                    );
                }
                return existing;
            }
        }
        throw error;
    }

    // Populate sender details in-memory if sender exists, avoiding a redundant findById query.
    try {
        if (notification.sender) {
            await notification.populate("sender", "name email");
        }

        const socketPayload = typeof notification.toObject === "function"
            ? notification.toObject()
            : notification;

        // Push real-time event to recipient's personal socket room (best-effort).
        emitNotificationToUser(recipient, socketPayload);
    } catch (socketOrPopulateError) {
        console.error(
            "Non-fatal error preparing/emitting real-time notification:",
            socketOrPopulateError?.message || socketOrPopulateError
        );
    }

    return notification;
};

// Failure-safe wrapper for business event triggers.
// Ensures that notification failures never abort or revert the primary business transaction.
const createNotificationSafe = async (payload) => {
    try {
        return await createNotificationService(payload);
    } catch (error) {
        console.error("Non-fatal notification creation error:", error?.message || error);
        return null;
    }
};

// Gets paginated notifications for the authenticated user, newest first.
const getNotificationsService = async (userId, query = {}) => {
    const { page = 1, limit = 10, isRead, entityType } = query;

    const {
        page: currentPage,
        limit: itemsPerPage,
        skip
    } = getPagination(page, limit);

    const filter = {
        recipient: userId
    };

    if (isRead !== undefined && isRead !== null && isRead !== "") {
        const normalized = String(isRead).toLowerCase();
        if (normalized === "true") {
            filter.isRead = true;
        } else if (normalized === "false") {
            filter.isRead = false;
        } else {
            throw createApiError(
                400,
                "isRead filter must be 'true' or 'false'"
            );
        }
    }

    if (entityType !== undefined && entityType !== null && entityType !== "") {
        const normalizedEntityType = String(entityType).trim().toLowerCase();
        if (normalizedEntityType !== "all") {
            filter.entityType = normalizedEntityType;
        }
    }

    const [notifications, totalItems] = await Promise.all([
        Notification.find(filter)
            .populate("sender", "name email")
            .sort({ createdAt: -1 })
            .skip(skip)
            .limit(itemsPerPage)
            .lean(),
        Notification.countDocuments(filter)
    ]);

    return {
        notifications,
        pagination: getPaginationData(
            currentPage,
            itemsPerPage,
            totalItems
        )
    };
};

// Gets the count of unread notifications for the authenticated user (total and grouped by entityType).
const getUnreadNotificationCountService = async (userId) => {
    const userObjectId = new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(userId);

    const [totalUnread, groupedCounts] = await Promise.all([
        Notification.countDocuments({
            recipient: userObjectId,
            isRead: false
        }),
        Notification.aggregate([
            {
                $match: {
                    recipient: userObjectId,
                    isRead: false
                }
            },
            {
                $group: {
                    _id: "$entityType",
                    count: { $sum: 1 }
                }
            }
        ])
    ]);

    const countsByCategory = {
        booking: 0,
        workspace: 0,
        campaign: 0,
        payment: 0,
        review: 0,
        message: 0
    };

    if (Array.isArray(groupedCounts)) {
        groupedCounts.forEach((group) => {
            if (group._id) {
                countsByCategory[group._id] = group.count;
            }
        });
    }

    return {
        unreadCount: totalUnread,
        countsByCategory
    };
};

// Marks a single notification as read, strictly scoped to the authenticated recipient.
const markNotificationReadService = async (userId, notificationId) => {
    if (!mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(notificationId)) {
        throw createApiError(400, "Invalid notification ID");
    }

    const notification = await Notification.findOne({
        _id: notificationId,
        recipient: userId
    });

    if (!notification) {
        throw createApiError(404, "Notification not found");
    }

    if (!notification.isRead) {
        notification.isRead = true;
        notification.readAt = new Date();
        await notification.save();
    }

    return notification;
};

// Marks unread notifications as read for the authenticated recipient, optionally filtered by category/entityType.
const markAllNotificationsReadService = async (userId, category = null) => {
    const userObjectId = new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(userId);

    const filter = {
        recipient: userObjectId,
        isRead: false
    };

    const validCategories = [
        "booking",
        "workspace",
        "campaign",
        "payment",
        "review",
        "message"
    ];

    if (category && category !== "all") {
        const rawList = Array.isArray(category)
            ? category
            : String(category).split(",").map((s) => s.trim().toLowerCase());

        const aliasMap = {
            bookings: "booking",
            campaigns: "campaign",
            workspaces: "workspace",
            payments: "payment",
            reviews: "review",
            messages: "message"
        };

        const resolvedList = rawList.map((item) => aliasMap[item] || item);

        for (const item of resolvedList) {
            if (!validCategories.includes(item)) {
                throw createApiError(
                    400,
                    `Invalid notification category '${item}'. Allowed types: ${validCategories.join(", ")}`
                );
            }
        }

        if (resolvedList.length === 1) {
            filter.entityType = resolvedList[0];
        } else {
            filter.entityType = { $in: resolvedList };
        }
    }

    // Identify matching unread notification IDs first
    const unreadNotifs = await Notification.find(filter).select("_id entityType");
    const markedNotificationIds = unreadNotifs.map((n) => n._id);

    if (markedNotificationIds.length > 0) {
        await Notification.updateMany(
            { _id: { $in: markedNotificationIds } },
            {
                $set: {
                    isRead: true,
                    readAt: new Date()
                }
            }
        );
    }

    return {
        modifiedCount: markedNotificationIds.length,
        markedNotificationIds,
        category: category || "all"
    };
};

export {
    createNotificationService,
    createNotificationSafe,
    getNotificationsService,
    getUnreadNotificationCountService,
    markNotificationReadService,
    markAllNotificationsReadService
};
```

```javascript
import mongoose from "mongoose";
import createApiError from "../../utils/ApiError.js";

// Validates notification ID in URL parameters.
const validateNotificationIdParam = (req, res, next) => {
    const { id } = req.params;

    if (!id || !mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(id)) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Valid notification ID is required"
        );
    }

    next();
};

const ALLOWED_ENTITY_TYPES = [
    "booking",
    "workspace",
    "campaign",
    "payment",
    "review",
    "message"
];

// Validates query parameters for fetching notifications feed.
const validateGetNotificationsQuery = (req, res, next) => {
    const { page, limit, isRead, entityType } = req.query;

    if (page !== undefined) {
        const parsedPage = Number(page);
        if (!Number.isInteger(parsedPage) || parsedPage < 1) {
            throw createApiError(
                400,
                "Page must be a valid positive integer"
            );
        }
    }

    if (limit !== undefined) {
        const parsedLimit = Number(limit);
        if (!Number.isInteger(parsedLimit) || parsedLimit < 1 || parsedLimit > 100) {
            throw createApiError(
                400,
                "Limit must be an integer between 1 and 100"
            );
        }
    }

    if (isRead !== undefined && isRead !== null && isRead !== "") {
        const normalized = String(isRead).toLowerCase();
        if (normalized !== "true" && normalized !== "false") {
            throw createApiError(
                400,
                "isRead filter must be 'true' or 'false'"
            );
        }
    }

    if (entityType !== undefined && entityType !== null && entityType !== "") {
        const normalizedEntityType = String(entityType).trim().toLowerCase();
        if (normalizedEntityType !== "all" && !ALLOWED_ENTITY_TYPES.includes(normalizedEntityType)) {
            throw createApiError(
                400,
                `Invalid entityType filter. Allowed types: ${ALLOWED_ENTITY_TYPES.join(", ")} or 'all'`
            );
        }
    }

    next();
};

export {
    validateNotificationIdParam,
    validateGetNotificationsQuery
};
```

```javascript
const app = express();

    process.env.FRONTEND_URL,
    "http://192.168.1.213005",
    "http://localhost3005"
].filter(Boolean);

// Allows the frontend to communicate with the backend.
app.use(
    cors({
        origin: (origin, callback) => {
            if (!origin || allowedOrigins.includes(origin)) {
                return callback(null, true);

);

// Reads JSON data from requests.
app.use(express.json());

        success: true,
        message: "CreatorLink API is running"
    });
});
```

```javascript
import createApiError from "../utils/ApiError.js";
import Auth from "../modules/auth/auth.model.js";
import {
    verifyAccessToken
} from "../utils/helpers/token.helper.js";


// Verifies the access token stored in the HttpOnly cookie
// and ensures it has not been revoked by a subsequent password change.

const authenticateUser = async (req, res, next) => {

    try {
        // Get access token from the HttpOnly cookie.
        const token = req.cookies?.accessToken;

        // Check if access token exists.
        if (!token) {
            throw createApiError(
                401,
                "Access token is required"
            );
        }

        let decodedToken;
        try {
            // Verify cryptographic signature and expiry of access token.
            decodedToken = verifyAccessToken(token);
        } catch (jwtError) {
            throw createApiError(
                401,
                "Invalid or expired access token"
            );
        }

        // Verify user exists and access token version matches user's current password version.
        const user = await Auth.findById(decodedToken.userId).select("passwordVersion");

        if (!user) {
            throw createApiError(
                401,
                "User not found or account no longer exists"
            );
        }

        const currentVersion = user.passwordVersion || 0;
        const tokenVersion = decodedToken.tokenVersion ?? 0;

        // Immediately reject access tokens issued prior to a password change.
        if (tokenVersion !== currentVersion) {
            throw createApiError(
                401,
                "Session expired due to password change. Please log in again."
            );
        }

        // Store authenticated user information for downstream controllers and services.
        req.user = decodedToken;

        next();

    } catch (error) {
        next(error);
    }
};


export default authenticateUser;
```

```javascript
import createApiError from "../utils/ApiError.js";


// Checks whether the authenticated user
// has permission to access a specific role-based route.

const authorizeRoles = (...allowedRoles) => {

    return (req, res, next) => {

        // User must be authenticated first.
        if (!req.user) {
            throw createApiError(
                401,
                "Authentication is required"
            );
        }


        // Check whether user's role is allowed.
        if (!allowedRoles.includes(req.user.role)) {
            throw createApiError(
                403,
                "You do not have permission to access this resource"
            );
        }


        next();
    };
};


export default authorizeRoles;
```

```javascript
import asyncHandler from "../../utils/asyncHandler.js";
import sendResponse from "../../utils/response.js";
import createApiError from "../../utils/ApiError.js";
import {
    uploadImageToCloudinary,
    uploadMultipleImagesToCloudinary,
    uploadVideoToCloudinary
} from "../../utils/helpers/cloudinary.helper.js";

// Approved upload folders in Cloudinary.
const ALLOWED_FOLDERS = [
    "creatorlink/general",
    "creatorlink/profiles",
    "creatorlink/portfolios",
    "creatorlink/brands",
    "creatorlink/deliverables",
    "creatorlink/services",
    "creatorlink/campaigns"
];

const DEFAULT_FOLDER = "creatorlink/general";

/**
 * Validates and resolves the upload folder against an approved allowlist.
 *
 * @param {string} [requestedFolder]
 * @param {string} [defaultFolder="creatorlink/general"]
 * @returns {string}
 */
const resolveUploadFolder = (requestedFolder, defaultFolder = DEFAULT_FOLDER) => {
    if (!requestedFolder) {
        return defaultFolder;
    }

    if (ALLOWED_FOLDERS.includes(requestedFolder)) {
        return requestedFolder;
    }

    throw createApiError(
        400,
        `Invalid upload folder. Allowed folders: ${ALLOWED_FOLDERS.join(", ")}`
    );
};

/**
 * Handles single video upload to Cloudinary.
 * Expects req.file populated by uploadSingleVideo middleware.
 * Default folder for videos is "creatorlink/deliverables".
 */
const uploadSingleVideoHandler = asyncHandler(async (req, res) => {
    if (!req.file || !req.file.buffer) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Please provide a video file under the 'video' field"
        );
    }

    const folder = resolveUploadFolder(req.body.folder, "creatorlink/deliverables");
    const result = await uploadVideoToCloudinary(req.file.buffer, folder);

    return sendResponse(
        res,
        200,
        "Video uploaded successfully",
        result
    );
});

/**
 * Handles single image upload to Cloudinary.
 * Expects req.file populated by uploadSingleImage middleware.
 */
const uploadSingleImageHandler = asyncHandler(async (req, res) => {
    if (!req.file || !req.file.buffer) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Please provide an image file under the 'image' field"
        );
    }

    const folder = resolveUploadFolder(req.body.folder);
    const result = await uploadImageToCloudinary(req.file.buffer, folder);

    return sendResponse(
        res,
        200,
        "Image uploaded successfully",
        result
    );
});

/**
 * Handles multiple image upload to Cloudinary.
 * Expects req.files populated by uploadMultipleImages middleware.
 */
const uploadMultipleImagesHandler = asyncHandler(async (req, res) => {
    if (!req.files || !Array.isArray(req.files) || req.files.length === 0) {
        throw createApiError(
            400,
            "Please provide image files under the 'images' field"
        );
    }

    const folder = resolveUploadFolder(req.body.folder);
    const buffers = req.files.map((file) => file.buffer);
    const results = await uploadMultipleImagesToCloudinary(buffers, folder);

    return sendResponse(
        res,
        200,
        "Images uploaded successfully",
        results
    );
});

export {
    uploadSingleImageHandler,
    uploadMultipleImagesHandler,
    uploadSingleVideoHandler
};
```

```javascript
import { configureStore, createListenerMiddleware, isAnyOf } from "@reduxjs/toolkit";

import rootReducer from "./root_reducer.js";
import { clearAuth, login, logout, getMe, refreshToken } from "./auth/auth_slice.js";
import { clearSocketSession, startNewSocketSession } from "@/lib/socket";

const authSocketListenerMiddleware = createListenerMiddleware();

// Session initiation on successful login or getMe hydration
authSocketListenerMiddleware.startListening({
    matcher: isAnyOf(login.fulfilled, getMe.fulfilled),
    effect: (action) => {
        const user = action.payload?.data?.user || action.payload?.data;
        const userId = user?._id || user?.id;
        if (userId) {
            startNewSocketSession(userId);
        }
    }
});

// Session termination on explicit logout, clearAuth, or definitive auth failure (HTTP 401/403)
authSocketListenerMiddleware.startListening({
    matcher: (action) => {
        if (isAnyOf(clearAuth, logout.fulfilled, logout.rejected)(action)) {
            return true;
        }
        if (isAnyOf(refreshToken.rejected, getMe.rejected)(action)) {
            return Boolean(action.meta?.isAuthFailure);
        }
        return false;
    },
    effect: () => {
        clearSocketSession();
    }
});

const store = configureStore({
    reducer: rootReducer,
    middleware: (getDefaultMiddleware) =>
        getDefaultMiddleware().prepend(authSocketListenerMiddleware.middleware)
});

export default store;
```
